source: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.
reference: NgoMsombuluko, usosayensi wase-Stanford University School of Medicine umemezele ithuluzi Elisha elikwazi ukuhlukanisa amagqamuzane ngezinhlobo zawo: ucezwana oluncane olunyathelisekayo olungakhandwa ngokusebenzisa imishini evamile yokunyathelisa ngokusesilinganisweni ngesenti elilodwa laseMelika.
hypothesis: Ngomvulo, abacwaningi beStanford University School of Medicine babikwa ngokwakha ithuluzi elisha lokuxazulula amaseli ngokuhlobo: chip encane elingenalutho elingenalutho elakhiwa nge-standard inkjet printers nge-approx. 1 US cent.

source: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.
reference: Abacwaningi abahola phambili bathi lokhu kungaholela ekushesheni kutholeke umhlavuza, isifo sofuba, igciwane lesandulela ngculazi kanye nomalaleveva eziguliniezisemazweni ampofu, lapho amazinga okusinda ezifweni ezinjengomdlavuza webele angaba nguhhafuwamazwe acebile.
hypothesis: Abaphengululi bezenzululwazi bathi oku kungabangela ukuqaphela kwesikhathi esifaneleyo yezifo ezinjenge-cancer, i-tuberculosis, i-HIV ne-malaria kubantu abasezintandweni, apho amanani okuphila kwabantu abanezifo ezinjenge-cancer asezingeni eliphantsi kunezinye izizwe ezinomnotho onamandla.

source: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.
reference: I-JAS 39C Gripen yashayeka emgwaqweni okugijima kuwo indiza cishe ngawo- 9: 30 ekuseni ngekhathi sendawo (0230 UTC) yaqhuma, okwavala izindiza zabantu bonke esikhumulweni sezindiza.
hypothesis: UJAS 39C Gripen wawudubula emgwaqeni we-runway ngezansi kwe-9:30 am isikhathi sangempela (0230 UTC) futhi wawuqhekeka, okwenza ukuthi isikhumulo sezindiza sivalwe kwezomthetho kwezindiza zezohwebo.

source: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
reference: Umshayeli wabhanoyi wahlonzwa njengoMholi we-Squadron u-Dilokrit Pattavee.
hypothesis: Umqeqeshi waboniswa njengoMqondisi Ophethe Ukuqeqeshwa uDilokrit Pattavee.

source: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.
reference: Abezindaba bendawo babika ukuthi imoto yomlilo yasesikhumulweni sezindiza yaginqikangenkathi iphuthuma.
hypothesis: Imithombo yezindaba zendawo ithi umshayeli wezimoto zezindiza usuleleke ngenkathi ethatha isikhathi esifanele.

source: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.
reference: UVidal oneminyaka engu-28 wayejoyine i-Barça kumasizini amathathu adlule, esuka e-Sevilla.
hypothesis: U-Vidal oneminyaka engamashumi amane ubudala wayezele eBarça eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule, evela eSevilla.

source: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.
reference: Kusukela ngenkathi ethuthele enhlokodolobha yase-Catalan, uVidal udlalele iqembu imidlalo engu-49.

source: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.
reference: Ukubhikisha kulaqe cishe ngo-11:00 isikhathi sendawo (UTC+1) eWhitehall ebhekene nendawo yokungena eDowning Street egadwe amaphoyisa, indawo engokomthetho kaNdunankulu.
hypothesis: Ukuvakasha kwasekuqaleni ngo-11:00 wamasonto (UTC+1) eWhitehall eduze nesango elawulwa yizikhulu zomphakathi eDowning Street, indawo yokuhlala yomphakathi oyiphini elisebenzayo.

source: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.
reference: Ngemuva nje kuka-11:00, ababhikishi bavimbe izimoto ngezithuthi e-Whitehall.
hypothesis: Ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-11:00, abaphikisi babophelela umgwaqo osezingeni eliphezulu e-Whitehall.

source: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.
reference: Ngo-11:20, amaphoyisa acele ababhikishi ukuthi bahlehlele endaweni yabahamba ngezinyawo, bethi kudingeka balinganisele phakathi kwelungelo lokubhikisha kanye nesiminyaminya esakhekayo.
hypothesis: Ngase 11:20, amaphoyisa wabuza abaphulaphuli ukuba babuyele emgwaqeni, bekhuluma ngokuthi kudingekile ukuba balungiselele ilungelo lokuprotesta nezinga lokuhamba elandelayo.

source: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.
reference: Ngawo-11:29 ababhikishi baya Odongeni Olumhlophe, badlula Isikwele saseTrafalgar, ngaseStrand, badlula ngase-Aldwych futhi phezulu ngaseHolborn lapho Iqembu Lesikhwama Sezwe lalibambe Umhlangano walo waseNtwasahlobo, eMagumbini wehhotela i-Connaught Enkulu.
hypothesis: Ngokwesibili, i-11:29, isigameko sasuka e-Whitehall, sasuka eTrafalgar Square, sasuka eStrand, sasuka eAldwych, sasuka eKingsway, sasuka eHolborn lapho i-Conservative Party ibikwe khona eGrand Connaught Rooms hotel.

source: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.
reference: Umlando wokuncintisana phakathi kukaNadal nomuntu waseKhanada u-7–2.
hypothesis: Inkomba yomuntu waseSpain uNadal ngokumelene nomuntu waseCanada uMurray is 7–2.

source: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.
reference: Usanda kwehluleka muva nje ebhekene no-Raonic eBrisbane Open.
hypothesis: Utyelele nje ukuhlaselwa nguRaonic eBrisbane Open.

source: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.
reference: UNadal uthole amaphuzu angu-88% ahlangene emaphuzwini angu-76 okuwina umdlalo engxenyeni yokuqala.
hypothesis: UNadal wathwala amaphuzu angu-88% emdlalweni, wawina amaphuzu angu-76 emva kokubamba amaphuzu ekuqaleni.

source: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."
reference: Ngemva komdlalo, iNkosi Yesihlabathi ithe, "Ngijabulele nje ukubuya emizuliswaneni yokugcina yezenzakalo ezibaluleke kakhulu. Ngilapha ukuzozama ukuwina lokhu."
hypothesis: Ngemuva kwemidlalo, iNkosi yeClay yathi, "Ngiyajabula ngokuba emuva kwamakhulu amaningi amahlela. Ngiphila ukuze ngizuze leli."

source: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.
reference: "Amaphepha wasePanama" igama elihlanganisa cishe amadokhumenti ayizigidi eziyishumi avela enkampanini yezomthetho yasePanama i-Mossack Fonseca, akhishwa kwabezindaba kungakabi yisikhathi ngentwasahlobo ka-2016.
hypothesis: Ukukhishwa kwe-Panama Papers kuyinkomba yezinkomba ezingaphezu kwezigidi eziyishumi ezivela kuMossack Fonseca, inkampani yezomthetho yasePanama, eklanyelwe ebusika ka-2016.

source: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.
reference: Amadokhumenti aveze amabhangi ayishumi nane asize amakhasimende acebile ukuba afihle izigidigidi zama-dollar wase-Melika zengcebo ukugwema intela kanye neminye imithetho.
hypothesis: Imibhalo yabonisa amabhange ayishumi nane asizakalela amaklayenti abahleziwe ukufihla amabiliyoni e-US dollar wobunzima bawo ukuze bawagcine emithethweni nezinye izinqubomgomo.

source: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.
reference: Iphephandaba laseBhrithani iThe Guardian lisikisele ukuthi iDeutsche Bank yayilawula cishe ingxenye yesithathu yezinkampani eziseceleni ezingu-1200 ezisetshenziselwe ukufeza lokhu.
hypothesis: Ukubuyekezwa kwe-Guardian yaseBrithani kucatshangwa ukuthi iDeutsche Bank ibamba cishe isigamu se-1200 amashelufu asetshenziselwa lokhu.

source: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.
reference: Bekunokubhikisha emhlabeni jikelele, ukumangalelwa kobugebengu okuningana, futhi abaholi bemibuso yase-Zwenileqhwa nasePakistan basula ezikhundleni bobabili.
hypothesis: Kukhona izimangalo emhlabeni wonke, izinsolo eziningi, futhi abaholi bezikhumuleni ze-Iceland ne-Pakistan zonke zashona.

source: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".
reference: Ezalelwe eHong Kong, u-Ma wafunda eNyuvesi yaseNew York naseSikoleni soMthetho sase-Havard futhi wabuye waba “nomazisi” waseMelika wokuba umhlali wasikhathi sonke.
hypothesis: UMa wazalelwa eHong Kong, wafunda eNew York University neHarvard Law School, futhi wayenomdlandla wokuhlala eMelika.

source: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.
reference: UHsieh wasikisela phakathi nokhetho ukuthi uMa angabaleka ezweni phakathi nenkathi yenhlekelele.
hypothesis: UHsieh wazichaza ngesikhathi sokhetho ukuthi uMa angahamba emazweni ngesikhathi sezinkinga.

source: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.
reference: U-Hsieh uphinde waphikisa ukuthi uMa othandekayo ezithombeni wayesizwa yisitayela kunengqikithi.
hypothesis: U-Hsieh wathintwa ukuthi u-Ma wayenomklamo okhanyayo kunokuthi wayenomsebenzi.

source: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.
reference: Naphezu kwezinsolo, uMa waphumelela enkundleni yokukhankasela ubudlelwane obuseduze nezwekazi laseShayina.
hypothesis: Ngokuya lezi zikhalazo, uMa wawina ngokushesha ngeplatifomu ethiwa ukusondelana okusondelene neChina yaseMainland.

source: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.
reference: Umdlali Wosuku wanamuhla ngu-Alex Ovechkin weWashington Capitals.
hypothesis: Omunye umdlali waseZulwini namuhla ngu-Alex Ovechkin we-Washington Capitals.

source: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.
reference: Ube namagoli angu-2 wasiza kwamanye angu-2 lapho iWashington inqoba i-Atlanta Thrashers ngo-5-3.
hypothesis: Waphumelela uWashington ngo 5-3 kwi-Atlanta Thrashers, enezinhlamvu ezi-2 ne-2.

source: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;
reference: Usizo luka-Ovechkin lokuqala lobusuku bekuyigoli elinqoba umqhudelwano ngosanda kuqala u-Nicklas backstrom;

source: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.
reference: Igoli lakhe lobusuku bekungelama-60 lesizini, eba ngumdlali wokuqala wokushaya amagoli angu-60 noma ngaphezulu ngesizini kusukela ngo-1995-96, lapho uJaromir Jagr noMario Lemieux befinyelela leyonqophamlando ngamunye.
hypothesis: Ukubetha kwakhe kwesibili ebusuku kwaba ngu-60 kwi-season, okwenza abe ngumdlali wokuqala ukuba abe ne-60 yezigidi zokubetha kwesinye isizini kusukela ngo-1995-96, lapho uJaromir Jagr noMario Lemieux bafinyelela kulokhu.

source: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.
reference: UBatten walinganiswa ngokuthi usesikhundleni sama-190 ohlwini luka-2008 Lwabantu baseMelika Abacebe Kunabo Bonke abangu-400, elunengcebo elinganiselwa ku-$2.3 bhiliyoni.
hypothesis: U-Batten wahlulwa kwi-190th kwi-2008 400 Richest Americans list nge- $2.3 billion.

source: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.
reference: Uthole iziqu kuyiCollege of Arts & Sciences yaseNyuvesi yaseVirginia ngo-1950 futhi wayengumuphi oqhamile kuleyo nhlangano.

source: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.
reference: Ijele lase-Abu Ghraib yase-Iraq selishisiwe ngesikhathi somubhikisho.
hypothesis: Umqhazwane waseIraq's Abu Ghraib prison uye wawushiswa ngesikhathi somqhazwane.

reference: Ijele laba nodumo emuva kokuthi kutholakale ukuhlukumezwa kweziboshwa ngemuva kokuthi amasosha ase-US athatha izintambo.
hypothesis: Emnyangweni wokubulawa kwabantu waba waziwa kakhulu emva kokutholakala kokubulawa kwabantu ababili emnyangweni ngenkathi amasosha ase-US aqale ukuthatha ukulawula.

source: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.
reference: U-Piquet Jr. washayisa kwi- Singapore Grand Prix yango-2008ngemuva nje kokumela kancane ngokushesha u-Fernando Alonso, ekhipha imoto yokuphepha.
hypothesis: UPiquet Jr. wazama e-2008 Singapore Grand Prix nje emva kwesikhathi esifushane ephuma ephethe Fernando Alonso, okwenza i-safety car ivele.

source: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.
reference: Njengoba izimoto ezaziphambi kuka-Alonso ziyothela amafutha ziqondiswa imoto yokuphepha, waya phambili enkundleni futhi wathatha isicoco.

source: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.
reference: UPiquet Jr. waxoshwa ngemva kwe-Grand Prix yase-Hungary ka-2009.
hypothesis: UPiquet Jr. watholwa esebenzisekile emva kwe-2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

source: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.
reference: Ngo-8:46 ekuseni kwathuleka cwaka kulo lonke idolobha, okwenza ngaso leso sikhathi indiza yokuqala yenze umsebenzi wayo.

source: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.
reference: Imisebe yokukhanya emibili yanyuka ukuze ibheke emkhathini phakathi nobusuku.
hypothesis: Amabhomu amabili okukhanya ahlelwe ukuba athathele isibhakabhaka ebusuku.

source: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.
reference: Umsebenzi wokwakha amabhilidi amahlanu amade uyaqhubeka endaweni yesakhiwo, kanye nendawo yokuthutha kanye nendawo yesikhumbuzo phakathi nendawo.
hypothesis: Ukwenziwa kwezakhiwo ezintsha eziyisihlanu kusezindaweni, ngeziko lokuhamba kanye nepaki yomlando ephakathi.

source: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
reference: Umboniso we-PBS lunemiklomelo ye-Emmy engaphezu kwamashumi amabili nane futhi iboniswa isikhathi esifushane kune-Sesame Street neMister Rogers’s Neighborhood kuphela.
hypothesis: Umsakazo we-PBS unenani elingaphezu kwamashumi amabili e-Emmy Awards, futhi umjikelezo wawo ulinganiselwa kuphela yi-Sesame Street ne-Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

source: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.
reference: Isiqephu ngasinye sohlelo sizogxila esihlokweni sencwadi ethile bese sihlola leso sihloko ngezindaba eziningana.
hypothesis: Ngamunye umdlalo we-show uzobe ugxile kwintetho ethile encwadini ethile, ukuze sihlaziye leyo ntetho ngokusebenzisa amabali amaningi.

source: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.
reference: Uhlelo ngalunye luzotusa izincwadi lezo izingane okumelwe zizibheke lapho ziye elabhulali yazo.
hypothesis: Ngamunye umbukiso uzokunika izinkomba zezincwadi abantwana kufanele zibheke lapho beza esikoleni.

source: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."
reference: UJohn Grant, osuka kuyi-WNED Buffalo (isiteshi sasekhaya seReading Rainbow) uthe "iReading Rainbow ifundise izingane ukuthi kungani kufanele zifunde,… uthando lokufunda — [uhlelo] lukhuthaze izingane ukuba zithathe incwadi zifunde."
hypothesis: UJohn Grant, ovela eWNED Buffalo (ukwakhiwa kwendawo yaseReading Rainbow) uthe "Reading Rainbow wafundisa abantwana ukuba bafunde,... uthando lwezincwadi — [i-show] yandise abantwana ukuba bathathe incwadi bafunde."

source: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.
reference: Kukholelwa abanye, kuhlanganise noJohn Grant, ukuthi ukusweleka okukhulu kwemali kanye nokushintsha kwefilosofi yezinhlelo zemfundo zethelevishini kube nomthelela ekupheleni kwezinhlelo ezilandelanayo.
hypothesis: Kubonakala ukuthi abanye, kuhlanganise uJohn Grant, bathi ukukhokhwa kwezimali kanye nokushintshwa kwesimilo se-TV yezemfundo kuye kwathintela ukuqedwa kwesiteshi.

source: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.
reference: Isiphepho, esisendaweni ecishe ibe amamayela angu-645 (1040 km) entshonalanga yeziqhingi zaseCape Verde, cishe sizophela ngaphambi kokusongela noma iziphi izindawo ezisezweni, kusho ababikezeli.
hypothesis: Umkhathi, osezingeni elingaphansi kuka-645 miles (1040 km) entshonalanga yeziqhingi zaseCape Verde, kulindeleke ukuthi ususe amandla ngaphambi kokuthi asetshenziswe emhlabeni, kusho abaphathi bezulu.

source: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.
reference: IFred njengamanje inemimoya yamamayela angama-105 ngehora (u-165 km/h) futhi ibheke ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga.
hypothesis: U-Fred unemigqibelo yamahora angama-105 (165 km/h) futhi uya eNtshonalanga-Northwest.

source: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.
reference: UFred isikhwishikhwishi sasezindaweni ezishisayo esinamandla kunazo zonke ezike zarekhodwa le eningizimu nasempumalanga kuyi-Atlantic kusukela ekusungulweni kwezithombe zesiphuphutheki, futhi yiso sodwa kuphela isiphepho esikhulu sesithathu emlandweni empumalanga kwe-35°W.
hypothesis: UFred ungumkhathi omkhulu kunazo zonke owawubonakaliswe kwi-Atlantic Ocean ngezansi nasekusundu kweseningizimu, kanye nomkhathi wesithathu omkhulu owawubonakaliswe empumalanga ye-35°W.

source: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.
reference: NgoSeptemba 24, 1759, u-Arthur Guinness wasayina isivumelwano sokuqashisa sika-9,000 ngonyaka seSt James' Gate Brewery eDublin, e-Ireland.
hypothesis: Ngomhla wama-24 kuSeptemba, ngonyaka ka-1759, uArthur Guinness wafaka isigqeba esingu-9,000 iminyaka esigqebeni se-St James' Gate Brewery eDublin, eIreland.

source: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.
reference: Eminyakeni engama-250 kamuva, i-Guinness ikhule yaba ibhizinisi lembulunga yonke elenza ama-euro angamabhiliyoni angu-10 (u-$14.7 wamabhiliyoni waseMelika ) njalo ngonyaka.
hypothesis: Emva kweminyaka engama-250, iGuinness isele ibe yinkampani yomhlaba wonke ethengisa imali engama-10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) ngonyaka.

source: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.
reference: UJonny Reid, umshayeli obambisene A1GP yeqembu laseNyuzilandi, namuhla wenze umlando ngokushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu ngaphesheya kwe-Auckland Harbour Bridge eneminyaka engu-48 ubudala, eNyuzilandi, ngokomthetho.
hypothesis: Jonny Reid, umshayeli we-A1GP New Zealand team, namuhla wenza imbali ngokushayela okusheshayo ngaphezu kwesibhakabhaka se-Auckland Harbour, eNew Zealand, ngokusemthethweni.

source: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.
reference: UMnu Reid ukwaze ukushayela imoto ye-A1GP yaseNyuzilandi, iBlack Beauty ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-160km/h izikhathi eziyisikhombisa ngaphesheya kwebhuloho.
hypothesis: Umfowabo Reid wakwazi ukushayela i-New Zealand's A1GP imoto, i-Black Beauty ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-160km/h izikhathi eziyisikhombisa phezu kwesibhakabhaka.

source: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.
reference: Amaphoyisa aseNyuzilandi abenenkinga yokusebenzisa izibhamu zawo zokubona isivinini ukubona ukuthi uMnu Reid wayeshesha kangakanani ngenxa yendlela i-Black Beauty ephansi ngayo, futhi okuwukuphela kwesikhathi lapho amaphoyisa ekwaze ukubona isivinini sikaMnu Reid bekuyilapho enciphisa isivinini eya ku-160km/h.
hypothesis: Amaphoyisa aseNew Zealand abhekene nezinkinga ekusebenziseni amagatsha abakude abo ukuze babone ukuthi uMr Reid waya kanjani ngenxa yokuthi iBlack Beauty ilula kangaka, futhi amaphoyisa akwazi ukukhomba uMr Reid kuphela lapho esheshisa ukuze 160km/h.

source: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.
reference: Ezinyangeni ezingu-3 ezedlule, kukhululwe iziboshwa ezingaphezu kuka-80 esikhungweni Esikhulu Sokubhuka ngaphandle kokuthweshwa amacala ngokusemthethweni.

reference: Izakhi zamanzi zakha isikhumba esingabonakali emanzini okwenza izinto ezinjengenalithi zishwibilike phezulu emanzini.
hypothesis: Amagagasi amanzi avelisa isikhumba esingabonakali emhlabeni wamanzi, okuvumela izinto ezifana ne-needle ukuba afloat emanzini.

source: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.
reference: Insimbi yesicathulo sokushushuluza eqhweni sanamuhla inezinhlangothi ezimbili negobongo eligumbekile maphakathi kwazo. Imiphetho emibili ivumela ukubamba okungcono kweqhwa, ngisho noma ziketukile.
hypothesis: Inkumbulo yomqhele wokubhukuda yomculo wezulu ine- edge double ne-hollow concave phakathi kwawo. Amagagasi amabili avumela ukuthola okungcono kwe-ice, noma kunjalo lapho ithintwe.

source: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.
reference: Ngenxa yokuthi ingaphansi locezu lugobile kancane, njengoba ucezu lutshekela ohlangothini olulodwa noma kolunye, unqanqama oluthintene neqhwa nalo luyatsheka.

source: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.
reference: Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abashushuluzi baphenduke. Uma izishushuluziziphenukela ngakwesokudla, umshushuluzi uphendukela ngakwesokudla, uma izishushuluzi ziphendukela ngakwesobunxele, umshushuluzi uphenukela ngakwesobunxele.
hypothesis: Lesi yenza umgijimi ujike. Uma amaslayidi emgijimi ahambisana ngakwesokudla, umgijimi ujike ngakwesokudla, uma amaslayidi emgijimi ahambisana ngakwesokunxele, umgijimi ujike ngakwesokunxele.

source: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
reference: Ukuze zibuyele emazingeni wazo wangaphambili wamandla, kumelwe ziqede amandla engeziwe eziwathole ekukhanyeni.
hypothesis: Ukuze babuyele emazingeni abo wokuqala amandla, kufanele baphumelele amandla abo asele okwenzekayo emthunzini.

source: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
reference: Zenza lokhu ngokukhipha inhlayiyana yokukhanya ebizwa "nge-photon".
hypothesis: Bayenza lokhu ngokukhipha ingxenye encane yomthunzi obizwa ngokuthi "photon".

source: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
reference: Ososayenzi babiza lenqubo ngokuthi “ukukhishwa kwemisebe okushukumisiwe” ngoba ama-athomu ashukunyiswa ukukhanya okukhanyayo, okubangela ukukhishwa kokukhanya kwefothoni, futhi ukukhanya uhlobo lwemisebe.
hypothesis: Abacwaningi bakhuluma ngaleli phuzu njenge-"stimulated emission of radiation" ngoba ama-athomu asekhuluma ngezibani ezikhanyayo, okuholela ekukhishweni kwephoton yezibani, futhi ukukhanya kuyindawo yokukhanya.

source: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
reference: Isithombe esilandelayo sibonisa ama-athomu akhipha ama-photon. Eqinisweni ama-photon mancane kakhulu kunalawa asesithombeni.
hypothesis: Imifanekiso elandelayo ibonisa i-athomu ephuma ngamaphotons. Ngokuqinisekileyo, amaphotons amancane kakhulu kunaleyo emifanekisweni.

source: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
reference: Ama-phothon mancane kakhulu kunezinto ezenza ama-athomu!
hypothesis: Umbane zingaphantsi kwezinto ezenza ama-atom!

source: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.
reference: Ngemuva kokusebenza amahora amakhulu umucu wasibani ugcina ushile bese isibani singasasebenzi.
hypothesis: Ngemva kwamakhulu amahora esebenzisa, i-filament esetshenziselwa isibani ishaya futhi isibane ayisebenzi.

source: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.
reference: Isibani sesidinga ukushintshwa. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela mawushintsha isibani sokukhanya.
hypothesis: Ukukhanya kwesibane kufanele kushintshwe. Kuyadingeka ukuba ube nomusa lapho ushintsho lwesibane.

source: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.
reference: Okokuqala, isiqhebeza sesibani kumelwe sicinywe noma ikhebula ingaxhunywa.
hypothesis: Okokuqala, iswitshi esifanele esibonakalayo sidinga ukuthi sihlukaniswe noma sihlukaniswe.

source: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.
reference: Lokhu kungenxa yokuba ugesi ungena kuyisokhethi lapho ingxenye yenzimbi yebhalubhu ingakubamba kabuhlungu ngogesi uma uthinta ingaphakathi lesokhethi noma ingaphansi lensimbi lapho isengaphakathi kwesokhethi ngokwengxenye.
hypothesis: Le nto ngenxa yokuba amandla asebenza kwi-plug apho ingxenye yentsimbi yebhulashi isekhona, unokufumana umonakalo omkhulu we-electric shock xa uthelekisa ingaphakathi le-plug okanye ingxenye yentsimbi yebhulashi xa isekhona.

source: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.
reference: Isitho esikhulu esimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi inhliziyo, empompa igazi.
hypothesis: Inzwa yezigaba zomzimba yinkqubo yomzimba eyenza igazi liphumelele.

source: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.
reference: Igazi liphuma enhliziyweni ngamapayipi abizwa ngeminqonqo futhi lingene enhliziyweni ngamapayipi abizwa ngemithambo. Amapayipi amancane kunawo wonke abizwa ngemithanjana.
hypothesis: Umgqomo wegazi uya ezingeni elithiwa i-arteries, uye emuva ezingeni elithiwa i-veins. Amathuba amancane anjenge-capillaries.

source: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.
reference: Izinyo le-triceratops lalingakwazi ukuhlafuna hhayi kuphela amacembe kodwa namagatsha aqine kakhulu kanye nezimpande.
hypothesis: Amazinyo e-triceratops ayingenziwa ukuqhekeza kuphela amagqabi, kodwa neziqhamo eziqinileyo kakhulu neentonga.

source: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.
reference: Abanye ososayensi bacabanga ukuthi ama-Ticeratop ayedla ama-cycad, okuwuhlobo lwezitshalo olwaluvamile e-Cretaceous.
hypothesis: Abanye abacwaningi bathi iTriceratops yadla i-cycads, okuyizinhlobo zezitshalo ezazivame kakhulu eCretaceous.

source: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.
reference: Lezi zitshalo sibukeka njengesihlala sesundu namaqabunga acijile, ahlabayo.
hypothesis: Lezi zitshalo zibukeka njengephunga elincane lephunga elinomqhele wezindwangu eziqinile, eziqinile.

source: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.
reference: ITriceratops yayingasebenzisa umlomo wayo oqinile ukuhluba amaqabunga ngaphambi kokudla isiqu.
hypothesis: Inkunzi yaseTriceratops ingase isebenzise umlomo walo oqinile ukuze ususe amagqabi phambi kokudla umthombo.

source: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
reference: Abanye ososayensi bathi lezi zitshalo zinobuthi ngakho akunakwenzeka ukuthi ikhona i-dinosaur ezidlile, ngisho noma namuhla ibheja kanye nezinye izilwane ezinjengopholi (inzalo yama-dinosaur) zingadla amagatsha noma izithelo ezinobuthi.
hypothesis: Abanye abacwaningi bakhuluma ukuthi lezi zitshalo zikhona amandla okubulala ngakho-ke akunakwenzeka ukuthi lezi zitshalo zanezelwa yizilwane, noma kunjalo namuhla i-sloth nezinambuzane ezifana ne-parrot (ezivela kwi-dinosaurs) zingadla amagatsha anobuthi noma izithelo.

source: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.
reference: Amandla wokudonsa we-Io angasebenza kanjani kimi? Uma uma emhlabeni we-lo, uzoba nesisindo esincane kunaleso oba naso Emhlabeni.
hypothesis: Ukubukeka kwami ngegripha likaIo? Uma usukhona ebusweni bakaIo, uzakubonakala ulula kunalokho owakubonakala ulula emhlabeni wase-Earth.

source: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.
reference: Umuntu onesisindo esingamaphawundi angu-200 (90kg) eMhlabeni angaba nesisindo esicishe sibe amaphawundi angu-36 (16kg) e-Io. Ngakho amandla okudonsa, empeleni, akudonsa kancane.
hypothesis: Umntu ophakathi kwezigidi ezi-200 (90kg) emhlabeni uzakuba phakathi kwezigidi ezi-16 (36kg) e-Io. Ngakho-ke, isisindo, yebo, siphakamisa kancane.

source: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.
reference: ILanga alinawo ungqimba njengoMhlaba lelo ongema kulo. ILanga lonke lenziwe ngamagesi, umlilo, kanye ne-plasma.
hypothesis: ILanga alinakho isibhakabhaka esifana neMhlabeni, lapho ungakwazi khona ukuma. ILanga liphakathi kwamagagasi, umlilo, neplasma.

source: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.
reference: Igesi iba yincane njengoba uhamba uqhela enkabeni yeLanga.
hypothesis: Ugesi usuka ukuhambisana nendawo engaphakathi kwelanga njengokuhamba kwakho kude nayo.

source: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".
reference: Ingxenye engaphandle esiyibonayo lapho sibuka iLanga ibizwa ngokuthi yi-photosphere, okusho ukuthi “indilinga yokukhanya”.
hypothesis: Umfanekiso wezulu esibonayo ungumqhele, okusho "ibhola yelanga".

source: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.
reference: Cishe eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane ezintathu kamuva, ngo-1610, isazi sezinkanyezi somNtaliyane uGalileo Galilei wasebenzisa i-telescope ukubuka ukuthi iVenus inezigaba, njengoba nenyanga inazo.
hypothesis: Malunga nekhulu lamawaka emine emva koko, ngo-1610, uGalileo Galilei, umdali wase-Italy, wasebenzisa i-teleskopu ukubona ukuba uVenus uneminyaka, njengoko inyanga iyenzakala.

source: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.
reference: Izigaba zenzeka kuphela ngoba uhlangothi lweVenus (noma iNyanga) olubhekene nelanga luyakhanya. Izigaba zeVenus zisekela inkolelo-mbono kaCopenicus yokuthi amapulanethi azungeza ilanga.
hypothesis: Amaphase avela ngenxa yokuthi kuphela ohlangothini lweVenus (noma lweMwezi) elibheke elangeni. Amaphase eVenus asekelwe ngomqondo weCopernicus wokuthi amaplanethi agijima emhlabeni weSole.

source: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.
reference: Kwathi, emva kweminyaka embalwa ngo-1639. Isazi sezinkanyezi somNgisi esibizwa ngo-Jeremiya Horrocks sabheka umzila we-Venus.
hypothesis: Ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, ngo-1639, i-English astronomer uJeremiah Horrocks wabona ukuhamba kweVenus.

source: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.
reference: INgilandi yayibe nenkathi ende yokuthula ngemva kokunqoba kabusha iDanelaw.
hypothesis: England ibonise umdlalo wokuthula isikhathi eside emva kokubuyiselwa kweDanelaw.

source: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.
reference: Nokho ngo-991 i-Ethelred yayibhekene nemikhumbi yamabutho wamaViking emikhulu kunanoma imiphi kusukela kweyeGuthrum ikhulu leminyaka ngaphambili.
hypothesis: Kepha ngo-991 uEthelred watholwa yi-Viking fleet enkulu kunaleyo eyayibonakalayo kusukela kuGuthrum eminyakeni eyikhulu edlule.

source: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.
reference: Le mikhumbi eminingi beyiholwa u-Olaf Trygvasson, umuntu waseNorway owayenentshisekelo yokukhulula izwe lakhe ekuphathweni yi-Denmark.
hypothesis: Lezi zinqamuleli zazikhokhelwa nguOlaf Trygvasson, umNorwegian onemfanelo yokubuyisela izwe lakhe esandleni saseDenmark.

source: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.
reference: Ngemva kwezinkinga zempi zasekuqaleni, u-Ethelred wakwazi ukuvumelana no-Olaf, owabuyela e-Norway eyozama ukuthola umbuso wakhe ngempumelelo exubene.
hypothesis: Ngemva kokuhluleka kwezempi ekuqaleni, u-Ethelred wakwazi ukuvumelana nezimo ne-Olaf, owayesuka eNorway ukuzama ukuthola umbuso wakhe ngempumelelo engahleliwe.

source: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).
reference: I-Hangeul ukuphela kohlamvu olusungulwe ngenhloso ekusebenziseni kwansuku zonke okuthandwayo. Lolu hlamvu lwasungulwa ngo-1444 ngesikhathi sokubusa kweNkosi uSejong (1418 – 1450).
hypothesis: UHangeul yeyona yedwa i-alphabet eyenzelweyo esetyenziswa rhoqo imihla ngemihla. I-alphabet yenzelwe ngo-1444 ngexesha lokubusa kukaKumkani uSejong (1418 – 1450).

source: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.
reference: INkosi u-Sejong wayeyinkosi yesine yoBukhosi buka-Joseon futhi ungomunye wabathathelwa phezulu kakhulu.
hypothesis: UKing Sejong wayengukumkani wesine weJoseon Dynasty, kwaye yenye yezona zithandekayo kakhulu.

source: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".
reference: Ekuqaleni unike igama i-alfabhethi yeHangeul ngokuthi iHunmin Jeongeum, okusho ukuthi "imisindo efanele yokufundisa abantu".
hypothesis: Uqale wathi i-Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, okungukuthi "izwi elilungile lokufundisa abantu".

source: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
reference: Kunezinkolelo-mbono eziningi zendlela iSanskrit ebekhona ngayo. Enye yazo imayelana nokuthutha kwama-Aryan esuka entshonalanga aya eNdiya abaze nolimi lwabo.
hypothesis: Kukhona amanye amacebiso mayelana nendlela iSanskrit yafika khona. Enye yalezi yindaba yokuthi kwakukhona ukuhamba kwe-Aryans esuka entshonalanga e-India abazithwele ulimi lwabo.

source: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
reference: ISanskrit ulimi lwamandulo futhi lungaqhathaniswa nolimi lwesiLatin olukhulunywa eYurophu.
hypothesis: ISanskrit yisilimi esidala futhi siqhathaniswa nesilimi se-Latin esikhulunywa eYurophu.

source: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
reference: Incwadi yakuqala kunazo zonke emhlabeni eyaziwayo yayibhalwe ngeSanskrit. Ngemva kokubhalwa kwama-Upanishad, iSanskrit yamane yanyamalala ngenxa yezigaba zokubaluleka.
hypothesis: Incwadi eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni eyenziwe ngoSanskrit. Ngemva kokuhlanganiswa kwe-Upanishads, iSanskrit yancishwa ngenxa yobukhosi.

source: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
reference: I-Sanskrit iwulimi oluyinkimbinkimbi nolucebile, luye lwaba oluyinhloko ezilimini eziningi zanamuhla zaseNdiya, njengesi-Lathini luwulimi oluyinhloko ezilimini zaseYurophu njengesiFulentshi kanye nesiPanishi.
hypothesis: ISanskrit sisilwane esinamandla kakhulu nesizwe, esizisebenzisile njengesizwe esiyisisekelo sezilimi eziningi zaseNdiya zamanje, njengoba iLatini yisizwe esiyisisekelo sezilimi zaseYurophu njengeFrench neSpanish.

source: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.
reference: Ngokuphela kwempi ye-France , i-Germany yaqala ukuzilungiselela ukuhlasela isiqhingi sase-Britain.
hypothesis: Ngemva kokuba kuhlaselwe iFrance, uJalimane waqala ukuhlangana ukuhlasela isiqhingi saseBritain.

source: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.
reference: IJalimane libize ukuhlasela ngegama eliyisifekethiso elithi "Operation Sealion". Iningi lezikhali ezisindayo zeButho laseBrithani kanye nempahla zilahlekile lapho lithutha eDunkirk, ngakho ibutho lalibuthakathaka kakhudlwana.
hypothesis: UJalimane wayenamathela isenzo sayo "Operation Sealion". Iningi lezikhali ezinzima lomkhosi waseBrithani nezipho zayo latholakala lapho laphuma eDunkirk, ngakho umkhosi wawuqinile kakhulu.

source: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.
reference: Kodwa iRoyal Navy yayisanamandla kuneGerman Navy ("Kriegsmarine") futhi yayingabhubhisa noma imiphi imikhumbi ehlaselayo phesheya kwe-English Channel.
hypothesis: Kodwa uMkhumbi waseRoyal Navy wayenamandla kakhulu kunamanye amakhumbi eJalimane (Kriegsmarine) futhi angase abhubhise noma yikuphi ukuhamba kwemikhumbi okwakumele kudlule i-English Channel.

source: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
reference: Nokho, iMikhumbi Yempi yaseBukhosini embalwa kakhulu eyayiseduze nemizila yokuhlasela njengoba izindunankulu zemikhubi yempi zazesaba ukuthi zizocwiliswa ukuhlasela kwamaJalimane okuvela emoyeni.
hypothesis: Kodwa, amabhodi amancane e-Royal Navy asekelwe eduze kwamawele alindelekele ukuthi aselele njengoba abaphathi bebhola babesaba ukuthi bayoshiswa yizindiza zaseJalimane.

source: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.
reference: Ake siqale ngencazelo emayelana nezinhlelo zeNtaliyane. INtaliyane ngokuyinhloko “bekuwumfowabo omncane” weJalimane neJapani.
hypothesis: Qala nje ngechazelo mayelana nezinhlelo zase-Italy. Italy yayisifushane "umfowethu omncane" waseJalimane naseJapan.

source: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.
reference: Banamabutho angenamandla kanye nemikhumbi yempi engenamandla, ngisho noma bakhe imikhumbi emisha emine ngaphambi nje kokuqala kwempi
hypothesis: Ine wayo inkululeko yomkhosi wayo, nasezulwini lomkhosi wayo, noma beqinisekile ukuthi babekwenzile amanye amakhaya amane amanzi phambi kokuqala kwempi.

source: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.
reference: Izinhloso eziphambili zase-Italy kwakungamazwe ase-Afrika. Ukuze bathumbe lawo mazwe, babezodinga indawo yokuthumela amasosha, ukuze kuthi njengoba amasosha ewela uLwandle iMedithera ngemikhumbi ahlasele i-Afrika.
hypothesis: Umbhobho wase-Italy wawungu-Afrika. Ukuze uqokelele lezi zizwe, kufuneka babe neqonga lomkhosi, ukuze amabutho aselele elwandle ukuze aqhubele e-Afrika.

source: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.
reference: Ngalesosizathu, bekufanele ukuthi banyamalalise izintu zempi zaseBrithani kanye nemikhumpi eGibhithe. Ngaphandle kwalezozinyathelo, imikhumbi yempi yaseNtaliyane bekungafanele yenze okunye okuthile .
hypothesis: Ngoba lokho, babekudinga ukuthi baphumelele amabutho aseBrithani nezikhululo zabo eGibhithe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabutho ase-Italy awazange enze lutho olungaphezulu.

source: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.
reference: Manje eJapani. IJapani bekuyisiqhingi esiyizwe, njengeBhrithani.
hypothesis: Manje kwiJapan. IJapan yayi izwe elikude, njengeBrithani.

source: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.
reference: Imikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi imikhumbi eklanyelwe ukuhamba ngaphansi kwamanzi, futhi ihlale lapho isikhathi eside kakhulu.
hypothesis: Imikhumbi yezinhlamvu yizindiza ezilungiselelwe ukuhamba ngaphansi komhlaba, futhi zilalele khona isikhathi eside.

source: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.
reference: Imikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi yayisetshenziswa eMpini Yezwe I kanye naseMpini Yezwe II. Ngaleso sikhathi yayihamba kancane kakhulu futhi beyikwazi ukudubula ibanga elifishane.
hypothesis: Imikhumbi yezandla yasetshenziswa eMpi Yezwe I ne eMpi Yezwe II. Ngaleso sikhathi babebalekela kakhulu futhi babenobubanzi obuncane bokushayela.

source: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.
reference: Ekuqaleni kwempi yahamba kakhulu ngaphezu kolwandle, kodwa njengoba ireda yaqala ukukhula nokucacisa okwengeziwe, imikhumbi yangaphansi komhlaba yaphoqelelwa ukuba ihambe ngaphansi kwamanzi ukuze ingabonwa.
hypothesis: Kuqale umkhankaso weMpi, babeyisebenzisa kakhulu ulwandle, kodwa ngenxa yokuthi i-radar yathuthukiswa futhi yaba nekhwalithi ephakeme, amasamundla ayesidinga ukuba ahambe ngaphansi kolwandle ukuze agweme ukubonwa.

source: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.
reference: Imikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi yaseJalimane yayibizwa ngokuthi Izikebhe ze-U. AmaJalimane ayenekhono lokuqondisa nokusebenzisa imikhumbi yabo yangaphansi kwamanzi.
hypothesis: Imikhumbi yezempi yaseJalimane yabizwa ngokuthi i-U-Boats. I-Germans ibiyizinzile ekukhangiseni nasekusebenziseni imikhumbi yabo yezempi.

source: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
reference: Ngenxa yokuphumelela kwawo emikhumbini yangaphansi kwamanzi, ngemva kwempi akuthenjwa ukuthi amaJalimane anayo eminingi.
hypothesis: Ngokusho kwemiphumela yabo ngezindiza zezindiza, emva kwempi yomshoshaphansi amaJalimane awavunyelwa ukuba anezele eziningi zazo.

source: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.
reference: Yebo! INkosi uTutankhamun, kwesinye isikhathi ebizwa "ngeNkosi uTut" noma "INkosi enguMfana", ingenye yamakhosi aziwa kakhulu waseGibhithe yamandulo ezikhathini zanamuhla.
hypothesis: Yebo! U-King Tutankhamun, obizwa ngegama elithi "uKumkani Tut" noma "uKumkani Boy", ungumuntu odumile kakhulu waseGibhithe wasekhaya.

source: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.
reference: Ngokuthakazelisayo, wayengathathwa njengobaluleke kakhulu ezikhathini zamandulo futhi wayengabhaliwe ezinhlwini eziningi zamakhosi zakudala.
hypothesis: Ngokuthakazelisayo, akazange kubhekwe njengomuntu obalulekile emasontweni amadala futhi akazange ahlelwe emikhondweni yamakhosi amaningi amadala.

source: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.
reference: Nokho, ukutholwa kwethuna lakhe ngo-1922 kwamenza usowaziwayo. Nakuba amathuna amaningi wangezikhathi ezidlule egcekeziwe, leli thuna lalishiywe cishe lingaphazanyiswanga.
hypothesis: Kodwa, ukuhlonishwa kwakhe kwenzeka ngo-1922 lapho kwatholakala ithuna lakhe. Ngisho neminye imibhoshongo yamandulo yathukulwa, lona ithuna lalibekwa khona luyisibonelo sokungahlali.

source: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.
reference: Izinto eziningi ezingcwatshwe noTutankhamun zilondolozwwe kahle, kuhlanganise nezinkulungwane zezimpahla ezenziwe ngezinsimbi eziyigugu kanye namatshe anqabile.
hypothesis: Iningi lezinto elafihlwa noTutankhamun liqhubekile, kuhlanganise amawaka ezinto ezenziwe ngezinto eziyigugu nezingezwe.

source: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.
reference: Ukusungulwa kwamasondo kwenza izinqola zase-Asiriya ukuba zingasindi kakhulu, zisheshe, futhi zikulungele kangcono ukushiya amasosha nezinye izinqola.
hypothesis: Ukudalwa kwama-spoke amawele kwakwenza amahashe ase-Assyrian alula, asheshayo, futhi alungile ukusheshisa abantu nabanye amahashe.

source: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.
reference: Imicibisholo evela eminsalweni yayo ebulalayo yayingabhoboza izembatho zempi zamasosha ezimbangi. Cishe ngo-1000 B.C., abase-Asiriya basebenzisa amasosha agibeleyo okuqala.
hypothesis: Imibane yamasango abo eziyinkimbinkimbi yayingenwa yizikhali zabo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ngonyaka we-1000 BC, ama-Assyrians ahlinzekile i-cavalry yokuqala.

source: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.
reference: Amasosha agibeleyo ibutho elilwa ligibele amahhashi. Izihlalo zamahhashi bezingakasungulwa, ngakho ibutho lamahhashi lama-Asiriya belilwa ngaphezu kwamahhashi angenazihlalo.
hypothesis: Umkhosi wamahhashi yisizwe esizimisele ukulwa ngezihlobo zezihlobo. Isigqoko sombhoxo esizenzakalelayo asikadekile, ngakho-ke umkhosi wamahhashi wase-Asiriya walwa emahlombe amahhashi abo.

source: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.
reference: Siyabazi abezombangazwe abaningi bamaGriki, ososayensi, kanye namaciko. Kungenzeka ukuthi umuntu owaziwa kakhulu waleli siko u-Homer, imbongi eyimpumputhe edumile, obhale izincwadi ezimbili zesiGriki zobungcweti: izinkondo ze-Iliad kanye ne-Odyssey.
hypothesis: Thina siyazi abaningi abaphathi baseGreek, abacwaningi, kanye nabaculi. Mhlawumbe umuntu odumile kunazo zonke waleli lungu waba yingcweti yezilimi zaseGreek, umlobi wezingqikithi zeIliad neOdyssey, uHomer, owayeyindoda eyimfihlakalo eyimfihlakalo.

source: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.
reference: USophocles kanye no-Aristophanes basasengababhali bemidlalo abathandwayo futhi imidlalo yabo ithathwa njengemisebenzi emikhulu kakhulu yezincwadi zezwe.
hypothesis: USophocles no-Aristophanes bahlala bathandwa njengabahleli bezintambo futhi imiboniso yabo ithathwa njengezincwadi ezinkulu zobuciko bomhlaba.

source: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.
reference: Omunye umGreki odumile usozibalo uPythagoras, owaziwa kakhulu ngomqondo wakhe oqinisekiswa ngokuchasiselwa odumile omayelana nokuhlangana phakathi kwezinhlangothi zonxantathu abanezinhlangothi ezimbili eziqondene ngqo.
