source: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
reference: IsiHindi nesi-Urdu ziyafana ngohlelo lwamagama kodwa ziyahluka ngokubhala; ekukhulumeni kwansuku zonke, izikhulumi zezilimi zombili ngokuvamile ziyakwazi ukuzwisisana.
hypothesis: Imithetho ye-Hindi ne-urdu ifana kakhulu, kodwa zihluke ngokuphawulekayo ngezincwadi; emibuthanweni yansuku zonke, abasebenzisi bezi zilimi bangase baziqonde kahle elinye kwenye.

source: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
reference: Cishe ngekhulu lama-15 leminyaka, inyakatho Estonia beyingaphansi kwethonya elikhulu lesiko laseJalimane.
hypothesis: Ngokwemvelo, ezingxenyeni enyakatho ye-Estonia kwakukhona umthelela omkhulu wocwaningo lwaseJalimane ngekhulu le-15.

source: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
reference: Ezinye izindela zamaJalimane bezifuna ukusondeza uNkulunkulu ebantwini bomdabu, ngakho zasungula ulimi lokubhala lwase-Estonia.
hypothesis: Abanye amadoda amonki aseGerman abefuna ukuzithola kakhulu noNkulunkulu kwabantu abasendaweni, ngakho bathuthukisa ulimi lwase-Estonian olwesimweni esiqondile.

source: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
reference: Belusekelwe kuma-alfabhethi wesiJalimane futhi uhlamvu olulodwa "u-Õ/õ" lwanezelwa.
hypothesis: Kwakuhambisana ne-alphabet yaseJalimane futhi kwanezelwa umlingisi "Õ/õ".

source: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
reference: Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, amagama amaningi ayebolekwe kwelaseJalimane ahlanganiswa. Lokhu kwakuyisiqalo sokukhanya.
hypothesis: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amagama amaningi athathwe eJalimane ahlanganiswe. Lokhu kwakuyisisekelo sekuqondwa.

source: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.
reference: Ngokwesiko, indlalifa yobukhosi izoya ngokuqondile emabuthweni empi ngemva kokuqeda isikole.
hypothesis: Ngokwesiko, umuntu owayengumuntu owayekhona emhlabeni wasebenza eziphathimandla waya ngqo emkhosini emuva kokuphothula esikoleni.

source: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).
reference: Noma kunjalo, uChales waya enyuvesi eKolishi LikaZiqu Zintathu, e-Cambridge lapho afundela khona i-Anthropology kanye ne-Archaeology, futhi kamuza eZomlando, ethola u-2:2 (idigiliyi engaphansi yezinga lesibili).
hypothesis: Kepha uCharles waya eYunivesithi eTrinity College, eCambridge lapho wafunda i-Anthropology ne-Archaeology, futhi kamuva i-History, wathola i-2:2 (i-degree eliphansi).

source: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.
reference: UCharles wayeyilungu lokuqala loMkhaya wamaNgisi waseBukhosini lokunikwa idigiliyi.
hypothesis: Charles wayengomunye wabantu abahlonishwayo wendlu yaseBrithani ukuba bamukelwe degree.

source: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.
reference: ITheki yaseYurophu (i-Thrace esempumalanga noma i-Rumelia esenhlonhlweni ye-Balkan) ihlanganisa u-3% wezwe.
hypothesis: U-Europe Turkey (i-Eastern Thrace noma i-Rumelia e-Balkan peninsula) ifaka 3% yezwe.

source: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.
reference: Indawo yaseTheki ingaphezu kwamakhilomitha angu-1,600 (1,000 mi) ubude kanye no-800 km (500 mi) ububanzi, nesibumbeko esicishe sibe ama-angela ayisikwele onke.
hypothesis: Indawo yaseTurkey ibanzi kakhulu, inezilinganiso ezingaphezu kuka 1,600 km (1,000 mi) ubude nobubanzi obuyi 800 km (500 mi), neyakhiwe ngendlela enomumo weqanda.

source: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.
reference: Indawo yaseTheki, kuhlanganise namachibi, ingamakhilomitha skwele angu-783,562 (300,948 sq mi), lapho amakhilomitha skwele angu-755,688 (291,773 sq mi) ase-Asia eseningizimu ntshonalanga futhi amakhilomitha skwele angu-23,764 (9,174 sq mi) aseYurophu.
hypothesis: Indawo yaseTurkey, kuhlanganise amachibi, ithatha 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), okungukuthi 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) eSouth West Asia ne 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) e-Europe.

source: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.
reference: Indawo yaseTheki iyenza izwe elikhulu kakhulu lama-37 emhlabeni, futhi ingalingana neDolobha Elikhulu laseFulansi noMbuso Ohlangene kuhlangene.
hypothesis: Indawo yaseTurkey yenza kube yindawo yesibili enkulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni, kanti inezilinganiso zeMetropolitan France ne-United Kingdom zidityaniswa.

source: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.
reference: ITheki izungezwe izilwandle ezinhlangothini ezintathu: uLwandle i-Aegean ngasentshonalanga, uLwandle Olumnyama ngasenyakatho kanye noLwandle iMedithera ngaseningizimu.
hypothesis: Inhloso yaseTurkey ibandakanyiwe yiziphethu ngezansi, ngasentshonalanga nangasenyakatho: i-Aegean Sea, i-Black Sea, ne-Mediterranean Sea.

source: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.
reference: I-Luxembourg inomlando omude wokuzimela kusukela ngo-1839.
hypothesis: ULuxembourg unesikhathi eside esinomlando, kodwa ukuzimela kwawo kwaqala ngo-1839.

source: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.
reference: Izingxenye zeBheljiyamu yanamuhla beziyingxenye ye-Luxembourg esikhathini esidlule kodwa zaba yingxenye yeBheljiyamu ngemva koShintsho lwaseBheljiyamu lwangawo-1830.
hypothesis: Imizana yamanje eBelgium yayingxenye yeLuxembourg esikhathini esidlule, kodwa yaba yaseBelgium emva kwe1830 Belgian Revolution.

source: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.
reference: ILuxembourg ibihlale iyizwe elizama ukungathathi uhlangothi kodwa beyihilelekile kokubili eMpini Yezwe I kanye neMpi Yezwe II neJalimane.
hypothesis: OLuxembourg uye wazama ukuba ilizwe elingabonakali kodwa yaba yinxalenye yomzabalazo kwiMfazwe Yehlabathi I kanye neMfazwe Yehlabathi II nguJalimane.

source: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.
reference: Ngo-1957 i-Luxembourg yaba yilungu elisungulayo lenhlangano namuhla eyaziwa ngokuthi iNyunyoni yaseYurophu.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka we-1957 Luxembourg waba yilungu lokuqala leqembu elalisanda kusekelwa elibizwa ngokuthi i-European Union.

source: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).
reference: I-Drukgyal Dzong inqaba enkulu echithakele nemonasteli yamaBhuda engxenyeni engenhla yeSigodi saseParo (eMzaneni wasePhondey)
hypothesis: U-Drukgyal Dzong yindlu elahlekile neyomunyezi ezingxenyeni eziphakeme ze-Paro District (ePhondey Village).

source: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.
reference: Kuthiwa ngo-1649, uZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel wenza inqaba ukuze akhumbule ukunqoba kwakhe amabutho aseTibet yaseMongol.
hypothesis: Kuthiwa ngo-1649, uZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel wadala le fortress ukugubha impumelelo yakhe ngokumelene ne-Tibetan-Mongol amabutho.

source: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
reference: Ngo-1951, umlilo ubangele ukuba ezinye nje zezinto ezasala zaseDrukgyal Dzong ukuba zisale, njengomfanekiso kaZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka we-1951, umlilo wenza ukuba kuhlale khona abanye beqiniso lezi ze-Drukgyal Dzong, njenge-simile ye-Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

source: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
reference: Ngemva komlilo, inqaba yasindiswa yaphinde yavikelwa, yasala ingenye yezinto ezihehayo ngokuthinta inhliziyo zase-Bhutan.
hypothesis: Ngemva kwesitsha, i-fortress yagcinwa futhi yagcinwa, ihlala yenye yezinto ezithakazelisayo kakhulu e-Bhutan.

source: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.
reference: Phakathi nekhulu lama-18 leminyaka iKhambhodiya yazithola iminyene phakathi komakhelwne ababili abanamandla, i-Thailand kanye neVietnam.
hypothesis: Ngexesha le-18th century iCambodia yafumaneka phakathi kwezizwe ezibini ezinamandla, iThailand neVietnam.

source: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.
reference: AbaseThailand bahlasele i-Cambodia izikhathi eziningana ngekhulu lama-18 leminyaka kanti ngo-1772 babhubhisa i-Phnom Phen.
hypothesis: Abantu baseThailand bafikelela eCambodia amaxesha amaninzi kwi-18th century, kwaye ngo-1772 bawaphule iPhnom Phen.

source: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.
reference: Eminyakeni yokugcina yekhulu lama-18 leminyaka abantu baseVietnam babuye bahlasela iKhambodiya.
hypothesis: Eminyakeni yokugcina ye-18th, ama-Vietnamese afikelela eCambodia.

source: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.
reference: Amaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili abantu baseVenezuela awasebenzi, futhi iningi lalabo abasebenzayo libambe amatoho.
hypothesis: Inkululeko engamashumi amane kwesigamu seVenezuelans bangasebenzi, futhi abaningi abasebenza embonini engaphansi kwezomthetho.

source: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.
reference: Ingxenye yesithathu kwezimbili yabantu baseVenezuela abasebenzayo basebenza emkhakheni wokukhonza, cishe ingxenye yesine isebenza ezimbonini futhi ingxenye yesithathu isebenza kwezokulima.
hypothesis: Imiphumela yezwe laseVenezuela yabathengi abasebenza kwiindawo zokusebenza, cishe isigamu sabo basebenza kwimboni, kwaye isigamu esinye basebenza emasimini.

source: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.
reference: Imboni ebalulekile yabantu baseVenezuela u-oyela, lapho izwe lithengisa kakhulu kunokuthenga, nakuba iphesenti ililodwa kuphela lisebenza embonini kawoyela.
hypothesis: Umbutho obalulekile waseVenezuela yi-oil, lapho izwe lisebenzisa njenge-exporter, noma kunjalo, kuphela amaphesenti angama-1 abasebenza kule nkampani.

source: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.
reference: Ekuqaleni kokuzimela kwesizwe, ubungoti be-Singapore Botanic Gardens basiza ekuguquleni isiqhingi ukuthi sibe Idolobha leNgadi lasendaweni eshisayo.
hypothesis: Ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokukhululwa kwesizwe, uchwepheshe we-Singapore Botanic Gardens wasiza ekuguquleni i-island ibe yindawo yezitshalo eziqanda.

source: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.
reference: Ngo-1981, uVanda wakhumbula uJoaquim, iorchid hybrid, yakhethwa njengendaba yezwe
hypothesis: Ngonyaka we-1981, uVanda Miss Joaquim, i-orchid hybrid, wakhethwa njengomthubi kazwelonke.

source: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.
reference: Minyaka yonke ngabo-Okthoba izilwane ezidla imifino ezicishe zibe yizigidi ezingu-1,5 ziyahamba zibheke emathafeni aseningizimu, ziwela uMfula i-Mara, zisuka emagqumeni asenyakatho ukuze zitole imvula.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka ngamunye emuva kuka-Okthoba cishe izigidi ezingama-1.5 zezilwane eziyize zizothutha emadlelweni eseningizimu, zicubungula iMara River, evela emadlelweni esenyakatho ngenxa yezimvula.

source: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.
reference: Futhi emuva enyakatho ngasentshonalanga, ukweqa umfula iMara futhi, ngemva kwezimvula cishe zango April.
hypothesis: Kwathi emuva kwesokudla, eNyakatho ngeNtshonalanga, futhi sasiphindela emfuleni iMara, emva kwemvula ngo-Ephreli.

source: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.
reference: Indawo yaseSerengeti ineSerengeti National Park, iNgorongoro Conservation Area kanye neMaswa Game Reserve eTanzania kanye neMaasai Mara National Reserve eKenya.
hypothesis: Umbuso weSerengeti uqukethe iSerengeti National Park, iNgorongoro Conservation Area neMaswa Game Reserve eTanzania neMaasai Mara National Reserve eKenya.

source: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)
reference: Ukufunda ukwenza ezezindaba ezihilelanayo kudinga amakhono avamile nangokwesikho, kanye namathuluzi afundwe kahle emakilasini ahilelanayo (indaba edwetshwe eshadini, ukuhlela umsindo nevidiyo, ukuxoxa izindaba, njll.)
hypothesis: Ukudlulisa ukufunda ukudala imidiya engxoxweni kudinga amakhono ashukumisayo kanye nezinsiza ezifundiswa emakilasini engxoxweni (ukudweba, ukuhlela umsindo nevidiyo, ukudlala, njll).

source: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.
reference: Imiklamo ehlanganisiwe idinga uphinde uhlole ukucabangela kwakho mayelana nokukhishwa kwezindaba futhi ufunde ukucabanga ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene.
hypothesis: Ukudweba okusebenzisana kudinga ukuba uhlaziye kabusha izimiso zakho zokukhiqiza ze-mediya futhi ufunde ukucabanga ngendlela engahleliwe.

source: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.
reference: Imiklamo yekhompyutha idinga izici zephrojekthi zihlangane ndawonye, kodwa futhi zenze ingqondo uma zizimele.
hypothesis: Ukudweba okusebenzisana kudinga ukuthi izakhi ze projekti zixhumane nomunye nomunye, kodwa futhi zivezele inhloso yazo ngokwehlukile.

source: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.
reference: Isici esilahlekelisayo sezibuko zokukhulisa ukuthi ukuphica kwefokasi kanye nesibalo sezici zezibuko ezidingekayo ukufinyelela ububanzi bobude befokasi bukhulu kakhulu kunezibuko ezisemqoka.
hypothesis: Inkathazo ye-zoom lenses yukuthi ukucaciswa kwe-focal nezinombolo ze-lens element ezidingekayo ukuze zifinyelele ezindaweni ezahlukene zokucaca zikhulu kakhulu kunalezi ze-prime lenses.

source: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.
reference: Lokhu kuya ngokuba inkinga elungisekayo njengoba abenza izibuko befinyelela amazinga aphakeme okwenza izibuko.
hypothesis: Lezi zinto zithinta kakhulu njengoba abakhiqizi be-lens bafinyelela kumazinga aphakeme kakhulu ekukhiqizeni i-lens.

source: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.
reference: Lokhu kuvumele ukwakhiwa kwezibuko ezibonisa eduze ukuthi kuphinde kukhiqizwe olunye uhlobo lwezinga eliphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalezi ezinye.
hypothesis: Lezi zivumela izibuko ze-zoom ukukhiqiza izithombe zomgangatho ofanayo nezo zenzelwe zibekwe endaweni ethile.

source: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.
reference: Okunye ukungathandeki kwamalensi okukhulisa iznto ukuthi ubukhulu bemboniso engenisa ukukhaya (isivinini) belensi buphansi ngokuvamile.
hypothesis: Enye inzuzo ye-zoom lenses yukuthi umkhawulo wokukhanya (isivinini) wesibuko yilezi zithi zilinganiselwe.

source: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.
reference: Lokhu kwenza amalensi angabizi kakhulu ka-zoom angasebenziseki kalula endaweni enokukhanya okuncane ngaphandle kwesibani.
hypothesis: Lezi zikhangiso ezingabizi zenza kube nzima ukusebenzisa izibuko zokubuka ezingaphansi kwamandla okukhanya ngaphandle kwe-flash.

source: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.
reference: Inkinga evamile lapho uzama ukuguqula ifilimu ibe uhlobo lwe-DVD ukuthi isithombe siba sikhulu ngokweqile.
hypothesis: Enye yezinkinga ezivamile uma uzama ukuguqula ifilimu ibe DVD ifomethi yi-overscan.

source: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.
reference: Amathelevishini amaningi enziwe ngendlela yokuthokozisa umphakathi ovamile.
hypothesis: Amakhathuni amaningi akhiwa ngendlela yokumkhanyisela umphakathi wonke.

source: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.
reference: Ngenxa yalesosizathu, konke okubona kuTV kusikwe imingcele yakho, phezulu, ezansi kanye nasezinhlangothini.
hypothesis: Ngakho-ke, konke okubonakalayo kwi-TV kwakususwa, phezulu, phansi, nasemikhawulweni.

source: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.
reference: Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isithombe semboza isikrini sonke. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-overscan.
hypothesis: Lezi zinto zenziwa ukuze isithombe sifake wonke isikrini. Lokho kubizwa ngokuthi yi-overscan.

source: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.
reference: Ngeshwa, uma wenza iDVD, imingcele yayo cishe izosikeka nayo, futhi uma ividiyo ibinamazwi abhalwayo eduze nasezansi, angeke avezwe ngokugcwele.
hypothesis: Ngelishwa, lapho usenza iDVD, imingcele yayo izokwehliswa kakhulu, futhi uma ividiyo yayine-subtitles eduze kwesiphetho, awuzukubonwa ngokuphelele.

source: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.
reference: Izinqaba zakudala ezingokwesiko zishukumise umcabango isikhathi eside, zenza izithombe zemiqhudelwano yokulwa ngemikhonto phezu kwamahhashi, imicimbi kanye nemithetho yamaqhawe yenkathi ka-Arthur.
hypothesis: Imbali yaseMedieval castle yasezantsi ithakazelise kakhulu, ebonisa izithombe zamaJousts, amabhasi ne-Arthurian chivalry.

source: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.
reference: Ngisho nokuma phakathi kwamanxiwa ayinkulungwane yeminyaka ubudala kulula ukukhumbula imisindo nephunga lezimpi ezidlule kudala, ukucishe uzwe ukukhenceza kwezinselo ezindaweni ezigandayiwe kanye nokuhogela ukwesaba okuphuma ematilongweni angumgodi.
hypothesis: Ngisho nje ekhona phakathi kwemizi yonke eyadala iminyaka engaphezu kwelikhulu, kulula ukukhumbula izwi nemiphumela yezimpi ezedlule, ukuze uveze ukuduma kwamahhashi emigwaqweni kanye nomusi obumangalisayo obusuka emigodini yezindlu zokubhujiswa.

source: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?
reference: Kodwa ingabe imicabango yethu isekelwe ngokoqobo? Kungani kwakhiwa izinqaba nje kwasekuqaleni? Zaqanjwa kanjani futhi zakhiwa kanjani?
hypothesis: Kodwa ingabe imfihlakalo yethu isekwe ekwenzeni iqiniso? Kungani kwakhiwa amakhosi ekuqaleni? Bawenzelani kanjani futhi bawakha kanjani?

source: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.
reference: Ngokuvamile enkathini, iKirby Muxloe Castle iyindlu eqinile kakhulu kunokuba inqaba yangempela.
hypothesis: Ngokwesiko kwalesi sikhathi, iKirby Muxloe Castle ingaphezu kwendlu evikela inqaba enkulu.

source: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.
reference: Amafasitela wayo wengilazi amakhulu nezindonga ezilula bezingeke zikwazi ukumelana nokuhlaselwa kwangempela isikhathi eside.
hypothesis: Imipheme yayo enkulu yegilazi nemizila yayo emincane engakwazi ukumelana nokuhlaselwa okunamandla isikhathi eside.

source: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.
reference: Ngawo-1480, lapho ukwakhiwa kwayo kuqalwa iNkosi uHastings, izwe belinokuthula kakhudlwana futhi ukuzivikela bekudingeka emaviyweni amancane kuphela wabaphangi.
hypothesis: Kwi-1480s, lapho kwakhiwa khona nguLord Hastings, izwe lalingumxhwele futhi kwadingeka ukuba kutholakale ukuvikela kuphela amabutho amancane aselele.

source: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.
reference: Ukulinganiselwa kwamandla inqubo amazwe aseYurophu ayefuna ukugcina ubukhosi bezwe ngayo kuzo zonke izifunda zaseYurophu.
hypothesis: Ukukulingana kwamandla kwaba uhlelo lapho amazwe aseYurophu ayefuna ukugcina inkululeko yezwe yazo yonke imiphakathi yaseYurophu.

source: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.
reference: Umbono bekuwukuthi zonke izizwe zaseYurophu kwakumelwe zifune ukuvimbela isizwe esisodwa ukuthi sibe namandla, futhi ngenxa yalokho ohulumeni bezwe babeshintsha imifelandawonye yabo kaningi ukuze kube nokulinganisela.
hypothesis: Inqaku lalinga ukuthi zonke izizwe zaseYurophu kumele zifune ukuvimbela enye yazo ukuba ibe namandla, futhi ngaleyo ndlela amahhovisi kazwelonke avalelwe ukuhlangana ukuze balondoloze ibhalansi.

source: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.
reference: IMpi Yokulandelana Kobukhosi baseSpeyini yaphawula impi yokuqala leyo impikiswano yayo enkulu kwakungukulinganiselwa kwamandla.
hypothesis: Umkhankaso we-War of Spanish Succession wawusungula umkhankaso wokuqala wezwe elinomkhankaso we-balance of power.

source: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
reference: Lokhu kube ushintsho olubalulekile, njengoba imibuso yaseYurophi beyingeke isakwazi ukuqasha ngezimpi ezingokwenkolo. Ngakho, iMpi yeMinyaka engaMashumi amaThathu bekuzoba yimpi yokugcina ebizwa ngokuthi yimpi engokwenkolo.
hypothesis: Lezi zinto zenza umehluko omkhulu, njengoba amandla aseYurophu awazange afune isizathu sokuba yimpi yezemfundo. Ngakho-ke, iMpi Yeminyaka Engamashumi Amathathu yaba yimpi yokugcina eyayibizwa ngokuthi yimpi yezemfundo.

source: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
reference: Ithempeli lika-Athemisi e-Efesu labhujiswa ngoJulayi 21, 356, BCE esenzweni sokuthungela ngomlilo esenzwe u-Herostratus.
hypothesis: Inyanga kaJulayi 21, 356 BCE, isonto lika-Artemis e-Ephesus latholakala lusolwa ngomlilo owenziwa nguHerostratus.

source: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
reference: Ngokwendaba, okwakumshukumisa kwakuwukuthola udumo kumnyama kubomvu. Abase-Efesu, bethukuthele begane unwabu, bamemezela ukuthi igama likaHerostratus lingagcinwa ngokubhalwa.
hypothesis: Ngokwesayensi, injongo yakhe yayikho yonke into. Ama-Ephesians, enezinhliziyo zomlilo, abikezela ukuthi igama likaHerostratus ngeke lifakwe emincwadini.

source: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
reference: Isazi-mlando somGreki uStrabo kamuva wabhala igama, okuyindlela esazi ngayo namuhla. Ithempeli labhujiswa ngobusuku obufanayo lobo u-Alexander Omkhulu azalwa ngabo.
hypothesis: Umbhali waseGrike uStrabo wathi kamuva igama, okungukuthi siyazi namuhla. Isonto lalahlwa ngobusuku obufanayo lapho u-Alexander the Great wazalelwa khona.

source: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
reference: U-Alexander, njengenkosi, wacela ukukhokhelela ukwakhiwa kabusha kwethempeli, kodwa isicelo sakhe asivunyelwanga. Kamuva, ngemva kokuba u-Alexander efile, ithempeli lakhiwa kabusha ngo-323 BCE.
hypothesis: USapho, njengokumkani, wazinikela ukuba alungiselele ukwakhiwa kwetempile, kodwa isicelo sakhe asamkelwanga. Emva kokufa kukaSapho, itempile yavuselelwa ngo-323 BCE.

source: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.
reference: Qinisekisa ukuthi isandla sakho sixhekethile ngangokunokwenzeka njengoba usacindezela amanothi afanele – futhi zama ukunganyakazisi iminwe yakho ngokungadingekile.
hypothesis: Qiniseka ukuthi isandla sakho sihlale sihlale sikhululekile ngangokunokwenzeka ngesikhathi usikhipha zonke izindawo ezifanele - futhi zama ukungazenzisi okuningi ngezinwele zakho.

source: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.
reference: Ngalendlela, uzozikhathalisa kancane ngangokunokwenzeka. Khumbula ukuthi asikho isidingo sokucindezela izinkinobho ngamandla amakhulu ukuze kube nomsindo owengeziwe njenge-piano.
hypothesis: Ngale ndlela, uzakuphazamisa kakhulu. Khumbula ukuthi akudingeki ukuthi uphawule izitshixo ngamandla amaningi ukuze uthole umsindo ongenamkhawulo njengomculo wepiano.

source: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.
reference: Ukuze uthole umsindo owengeziwe, ensimbini yomculo ingositini, usebenzisa lokhu okungezansi okunamandla kanye nejubane eliphezulu.
hypothesis: Ngomculo we-accordion, ukuze uthole ivolumu eyengeziwe, usebenzise i-bellows ngenkani noma ngokushesha.

source: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.
reference: UbuMistiki ukufuna ukuhlanganyela, ukuzibonakalisa, noma ukuzazi kahle nokungokoqobo okuphakeme, ubunkulunkulu, iqiniso elingokomoya, noma uNkulunkulu.
hypothesis: Ukucwaninga kwezobuciko yindlela yokufuna ukuhlangana, ukubonakala, noma ukwazi okuphelele, ukungqongqosheka, iqiniso lezwi, noma uNkulunkulu.

source: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.
reference: Lo okholelwayo ufuna okwenzekayo okuqondile, noma ukuqonda izinto ezingokoqobo zaphezulu/zikankulunkulu noma onkulunkulu.
hypothesis: Ukholo luyafuna ukuqonda ngqo, intuition, noma ukuqonda okuphelele kwenzekayo emvelweni/ukuphelela kwezithixo.

source: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.
reference: Abalandeli balandela indlela ezithile zokuphila, noma imikhuba ehloselwe ukukhulisa lezo zinto ezenzekayo.
hypothesis: Abalandeli bafuna izindlela ezithile zokuphila, noma amasiko abekwa khona ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezo zinhlalakahle.

source: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.
reference: Ubumistiki bungahlukaniswa nezinye izinhlobo zezinkolelo ezingokwenkolo nokukhulekela ngokugxila kokwenzekeni kuwe uqobo esimweni sokuba khona esihlukile, ikakhulukazi leso sokuthula, ukuqonda, ukuthokoza, ngisho nokujabula ngokwedlulele.
hypothesis: Ukucocwa kwezakhiwo kungahlukaniswa kwizakhiwo zezinye izinkolo nokukhulekela ngokugcizelela kwi-ubungqina bomuntu ngokwakhe bomxholo othile wokuphumla, okucacileyo, okuhlaza, okuhlaza, okanye okukhuthazelayo.

source: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
reference: UbuSikh inkolo yaphakathi ezwekazini laseNdiya. Buqale endaweni yasePunjab phakathi nekhulu lama-15 leminyaka kusuka ekuhlukaneni kwamahlelo phakathi nesiko lobuHindu.
hypothesis: ISikhism yinkolo evela e-Indian sub-continent. Yavela ePunjab ngenkathi ye-15th century esuselwa esahlukweni esahlukene seHindu tradition.

source: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
reference: AmaSikh athatha ukholo lwawo njengenkolo ehlukile kubuHindu nakuba evuma umsuka wabo wobuHindu namasiko.
hypothesis: Amasikhi abhekisela ekukholweni kwabo njengezinkolo ezahlukene kunezinkolo ze-Hinduism, noma bekhumbula imithetho yayo ye-Hindu.

source: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
reference: Ama-Sikh abiza inkolo yawo ngokuthi yiGurmat, okusho ukuthi “indlela yomfundisi”. NgesiPunjabi umfundisi isici esisemqoka sazo zonke izinkolo zobuNdiya kodwa enkolweni yobuSikh unokubaluleka okwakha umnyombo wezinkolelo zobuSikh.
hypothesis: Amakhosi abiza inkolo yabo ngeGurmat, okuyiPunjabi ye "indlela yeGuru". I-Guru yinto ebalulekile kuzo zonke izinkolo zaseNdiya, kepha eSikhism ibekezelela ukubaluleka okubalulekile kwamakhosi.

source: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
reference: Le nkolo yasungulwa ekhulwini leminyaka lama-15 uMfundisi uNanak (1469–1539). Kwalandela abanye abefundisi abayisishiyagalolunye ngokulandelana.
hypothesis: Inkolo yase Sikh yasekwa ngonyaka ka 15th ngu Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Kwalandela amanye amaguru angamane.

source: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.
reference: Nokho, NgoJuni 1956, izithembiso zavivinywa lapho iziteleka e-Poland, lapho izisebenzi bezibhikishela ukusweleka kokudla nokuncishiselwa iholo, zishintsha ziba ukubhikisha okuvamile ngokumelene nobuKhomanisi.
hypothesis: Kodwa, ngoJuni 1956, izithembiso zikaKrushchev zafakwa test lapho izigameko zokuvukela zenzeka ePoland, lapho abasebenzi bezivumelana nezokudla zokunciphisa imivuzo, zaba yigalelo elikhulu eliphikisana neKhomunisti.

source: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.
reference: Nakuba ekugcineni, uKrushchev ethumele izinqola zempi ukuzodambisa isimo, uye wavumela ezinye izicelo zezomnotho futhi wavuma ukumisa uWladyslaw Gomulka othandwayo njengendunankulu entsha.
hypothesis: Kushushwe nje ekugcineni, uKrushchev wathumela amathangi ukuze ahlelele, kodwa wamukela ezinye izicelo zezomnotho futhi wavuma ukubamisa uWladyslaw Gomulka njengo-Prime Minister omuhle.

source: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.
reference: Umphakathi wesiGodi sase-Indus kwakuwumphakathi Wenkathi yeBhulonze ezweni laseNdiya elisentshonalanga nyakatho elihlanganisa ubuningi bePakistan yanamuhla kanye nezinye izinkolo entshonalanga nyakatho Ndiya nasempumalanga nyakatho Afghanistan.
hypothesis: Umbuso we-Indus Valley waba yindawo yobuciko be-bronze ezingxenyeni ezingaphezulu zomzantsi we-Indian subcontinent, ebandakanya iningi lasePakistan lamanje, nezindawo ezithile ezingxenyeni ezingaphezulu ze-India nase-India nase-Afghanistan.

source: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.
reference: Impucuko ichume ezweni elithuthelela amanzi emfuleni laseMfuleni i-Indus lapho ithole igama layo khona.
hypothesis: Ukukhula kwesintu kwenzeka emachibini eMfuleni ye-Indus, okwenza igama layo.

source: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

hypothesis: Ngisho noma abacwaningi bathi, ngenxa yokuthi isiko lase-Indus-Sarasvati lase-Indus-Sarasvati, noma abanye bathi lase-Harappan, ngoba i-Harappa yayingowesifunda sokuqala esakhiwe e-1920s. Ngisho noma abacwaningi bathi, ngenxa yokuthi isiko lase-Indus-Sarasvati lase-Indus-Sarasvati, noma abanye bathi lase-Harappan, ngoba i-Harappa yayingowesifunda sokuqala esakhiwe e-1920s. source: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
reference: Isimo sokulwa sombusa waseRoma sisizile ekuthuthukisweni kwentuthuko yezokwelapha.
hypothesis: Ukukhuthaza kwempi yomphakathi waseRoma kwathuthukisa izinzuzo zezokwelapha.

source: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
reference: Odokotela baqala ukubizwa uMbusi u-Augustus futhi waze wenza neButho Lezokwelapha laseRoma lokuqala lokusetshenziswa ngemva kwezimpi.

hypothesis: Kuyivumela abafundi ukuba bakwazi ukusebenza ngesikhathi sabo siqu futhi balawule isivinini somsebenzi wokufundisa.

source: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)
reference: Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunokukhawulelwa kwesikhathi okumbalwa ngethuba lamahora okusebenza avumelana nezimo. (Bremer, 1998)
hypothesis: Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezikhathi ezincane zokusebenza ngekhothombe lokusebenza okuguqukayo. (Bremer, 1998)

source: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.
reference: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi neWebhu Yomhlaba Jikelele kuvumela abafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukuthola ukwaziswa abakudingayo ngaso sonke isikhathi.
hypothesis: Ukusetyenziswa kwe-Internet kunye ne-World Wide Web kuvumela abafundi ukuba bafumane ulwazi ngexesha nanini na.

source: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
reference: Abafunda bangabuye bakwazi ukuthumela imibuzo kubafundisi nganoma isiphi isikhathi sosuku futhi balindele ukusabela cishe okusheshayo, kunokulinda umhlangano wobuso nobuso olandelayo.
hypothesis: Abafundi bangasebenzisa futhi ukuthumela imibuzo kubafundisi noma yisiphi isikhathi sonyaka futhi alindele impendulo ephumelelayo, kunokulinda kwaze kwaba khona lapho kuhlangana khona.

source: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.
reference: Indlela yesimanje yokufunda inikeza inkululeko ezintweni ezingenamkhawulo. Ayikho indlela eyodwa kuphela yokufunda.
hypothesis: Ukufunda ngeendlela postmodern kunika inkululeko evela kwi-absolute. Akukho ndlela enye yokufunda enye.

source: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.
reference: Eqinisweni, akuyona eyodwa into umuntu okumele ayifunde. Ukufunda kudinga ulwazi phakathi komfundi nalolo lwazi olusuke lunikezwa.
hypothesis: Ngempela, akukho lutho oluhle ukufunda. Ukufunda kwenzeka emzameni phakathi nomfundi nekhono elinikeziwe.

source: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.
reference: Ulwazi lethu esinalo lokuzenzela izinto nokukhuluma ngokwaziswa, izinhlelo zethelevishini ezisekelwe ekufundeni ziveza leli phuzu.
hypothesis: Ukusuka kwethu okwamanje ngezinye izinto zokuzenza futhi zokubonisa ulwazi, izindaba zokufunda zikashicilelwa zibonisa le ndaba.

source: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.
reference: Iningi lethu sizithola sibukele izinhlelo zethelevishini ezisitshela ngenqubo noma into eyenzekayo esingeke sihlanganyele kuyo noma sisebenzise lolo lwazi.
hypothesis: Ngakho okuningi thina siyafumana siyabukela i-TV show esifundisa inqubo noma umuzwa esingaziphathwa noma singasebenzise ulwazi oluthile.

source: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
reference: Angeke silungise imoto, sakhe umthombo emuva kwegceke, sithathe uhambo oluya ePheru ukuyohlola amanxiwa akudala, noma silungise indlu kamakhelwane wethu.
hypothesis: Asikwazi ukuqubha imoto, ukwakha umthombo engadini yethu, uhambo ePeru ukuze sihlolisise amasela endala, noma siyilungiselele indlu yomakhelwane.

source: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.
reference: Ngenxa yokuxhumana kwekhebuli enemicu yokudlulisa ukukhaya ehamba ngaphansi kolwandle nesiphuphutheki sokuxhumanisa, i-Greenland uxhumene kahle nabantu abangu-93% abanoxhumano lwe-inthanethi.
hypothesis: Ngokuthakazelisayo, Greenland is well connected nge 93% yabantu abane-intanethi. Lokhu kungenxa yezixhumanisi ze-fiber optic cable ezingaphansi kolwandle ne-broadband satellite.

source: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.
reference: Ihhotela lakho noma umbungazi (uma uhlala endlini yezivakashi noma ikhaya lomuntu) cishe uzoba ne-wifi noma ikhompyutha exhunywe kuyi-inthanethi, futhi zonke izindawo zinezitolo ze-inthanethi noma izindawo ze-wifi zomphakathi.
hypothesis: Ukubhalelwa kwakho noma abahlinzeki (uma uhlala endlini yomtholampilo noma ekhaya elisebenzayo) bangase babe ne-wifi noma i-PC exhunywe kwi-intanethi, futhi zonke izindawo zinethuthukiswa nge-cafe ye-intanethi noma indawo etholakala kwi-wifi yomphakathi.

source: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.
reference: Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, nakuba igama elithi "Eskimo" lihlala lamukelekile eMelika, lithathwa njengokweyisa abantu abaningi abangahlali eMelika base-Arctic, ikakhulukazi eCanada.
hypothesis: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

source: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.
reference: Nakuba ungezwa leli gama lisetshenziswa abantu Bendabuko baseZweni Eliluhlaza, kumelwe ligwenywe abantu bakwamanye amazwe.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma ukuva igama elisetshenziswa yizizwe zaseGreenland, kufanele iguqulwe yizivakashi.

source: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.
reference: Abahlali bendabuko baseGreenland bazibiza ngokuthi Inuit eCanada nokuthi Kalaalleq (ubuningi Kalaallit), umuntu waseGreenland, eGreenland.
hypothesis: Abantu abakhulayo eGreenland bathi Inuit eCanada naseGreenland, Kalaalleq (Kalaallit).

source: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."
reference: Ubugebengu kanye nokuphatha kabi abakwamanye amazwe ngokujwayelekile, kuyinto engaziwa e-Greenland. Kanti nasemadolobheni, azikho “izindawo ezinodlame.”
hypothesis: Ukohlakahlaka, kanye nezinhlungu ezingapheli kubafowabo abangaphandle, kuyinto engaziwa kakhulu eGreenland. Ngisho emadolobheni, azikho 'izindawo ezimbi'.

source: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.
reference: Isimo sezulu esibandayo cishe yiyo kuphela ingozi engokoqobo abangazilungiselele abazohlangabezana nayo.
hypothesis: Ukuphazamiseka kwesizini kungenye yezinkinga ezinkulu abantu abangenalwazi bayozithola.

source: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.
reference: Uma uvakashela iZwe Eliluhlaza ngenkathi ebandayo (ngokubona ukuthi uma uya enyakatho nakakhulu, kuya kubanda), kubalulekile ukuphatha okokugqoka okufudumele ngokwanele.
hypothesis: Uma uvakashele iGreenland ngesikhathi sezulu elibandayo (ukucatshangelwa ukuthi okwesokudla nje unyaka wonke, okwesokudla nje uya khona), kubalulekile ukuthi uthwale izingubo ezifudumele.
