source: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.
reference: Phakathi nehlobo, qaphela omiyane base-Nordic. Nakuba bengadlulisi noma iziphi izifo, bangacasula.
hypothesis: Ngexesha lonyaka, khumbula nazo i-Nordic mosquitoes. Nangona azinakudlulisela nanye izifo, zinokubangela ukudideka.

source: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.
reference: Noma umnotho wase-San Francisco uxhumane nawo njengendawo ethandwa yizivakashi emhlabeni wonke, umnotho wayo uyingxubevange.
hypothesis: Kuyilapho umnotho weSan Francisco uxhunyaniswa nokuba yindawo yokuvakasha yomhlaba jikelele, umnotho wawo uhlukahlukene.

source: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.
reference: Umkhakha womsebenzi omkhulu kakhulu izinkonzo zobuchwepheshe, uhulumeni, ezemali, ezokwehweba, kanye nezokuvakasha.
hypothesis: Imiphakathi enkulu kakhulu yezokusebenza yi-professional services, government, finance, trade, ne-tourism.

source: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.
reference: Ukubukiswa kwalo njalo emculweni, kumafilimu, ezincwadini kanye nasemasikweni athandwayo kwenze idolobha kanye nezici ezibonwa ngalo izwe zaziwe emhlabeni wonke.
hypothesis: Ukubonakala kwayo okuvamile emculo, amafilimu, izincwadi nezinkundla zomphakathi kuye kwandise ukwazi kwawo umuzi nezindawo zawo emhlabeni wonke.

source: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.
reference: I-San Francisco izungezwe izakhiwo ezinkulu zezivakashi ezinamahhotela amaningi, izitolo zokudlela, kanye nezakhiwo zemihlangano ezisezingeni eliphezulu.
hypothesis: ISan Francisco isenziwe ngezakhiwo zokuvakasha ezinkulu, amahhotela amaningi, izindawo zokudlela, nezikhungo ze-convention eziphakeme.

source: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.
reference: eSan Francisco nayo ingenye yezindawo ezinhle kunazo zonke esizweni sokupheka ezinye izinto zase-Eshiya: iKorea, iThai, iNdiya, neJapan
hypothesis: San Francisco nayo ingenye yezindawo ezinhle kakhulu emazweni e-Asia cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, ne-Japanese.

source: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.
reference: Ukuvakashela e-Walt Disney World kumelela uhambo olukhulu lokuya endaweni engcwele emindenini eminingi yaseMelika.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba eWalt Disney World kubonisa uhambo olukhulu kumakhaya amaningi aseMelika.

source: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.
reference: Ukuvakasha “okuvamile” kuhlanganisa ukundiza uye eSikhumulweni seziNdiza seZizwe Zonke sase-Orlando, ukuthatha ibhasi eliya ehhotela elise-Disney, ukuchitha isikhathi esingangesonto ngaphandle kokuphuma endaweni yase-Disney, kanye nokubuyela ekhaya.
hypothesis: Ukuvakashela okujwayelekile kuhilela ukundiza e-Orlando International Airport, ibhasi eya esihlalweni se-Disney hotel, ukuhlala khona cishe ngeviki ngaphandle kokushiya impahla ye-Disney, futhi ukuhamba emuva ekhaya.

source: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".
reference: Ziningi Izinto ongakhetha kuzona, kodwa lokhu kuhlala kuyilokho abantu abakushoyo uma bekhuluma "ngokuya e-Disney World."
hypothesis: Kukhona ukuguquguquka okungenamkhawulo okukhona, kodwa lokhu kuhlala kuyinto abantu abaningi abayifisayo lapho bekhuluma nge-"Disney World".

source: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.
reference: Amathikithi amaningi adayiswa nge-inthanethi ngezingosi zezindali njenge-eBay noma i-Craigslist asatshenziswa njengamathikithi okuya emapaki amaningi ngezinsuku eziningi.
hypothesis: Amathikithi amaningi athengiswa online ngezinsizakalo zokuthengiswa kwemisebenzi efana ne-ebay noma i-craigslist yizitikiti ezisebenza ngezinye izikhathi eziningi ze-park-hopper.

source: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.
reference: Nakuba kuwumsebenzi ovamile kakhulu, wenqatshelwe yi-Disney: amathikithi awadluliselwa.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma kunjalo, lokhu kuyinto evamile, kodwa kuyiphazamiseka iDisney: amathikithi awahambelani.

source: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
reference: Noma ikuphi ukukanisa onqenqemeni lweGrand Canyon kufuna imvume yasezintabeni.
hypothesis: Ukuhlala emthunzini eGrand Canyon kudinga i-permit yasekhaya.

source: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
reference: Izimvume zinginganiselwe ukuze kuvikelwe izindonga ezinkulu ezenziwa umfula, futhi zitholakala ngokusuku lokuqala lwenyanga, izinyanga ezine ngaphambi kokuqala kwenyanga.
hypothesis: Amalungelo ayahlukahluka ukuze ahlalele i-canyon, futhi atholakale ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga, izinyanga ezine ngaphambi kwenyanga yokuyiswa.

source: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
reference: Ngakho-ke, imvume yasezintabeni yanoma iluphi usuku lokuqalisa ngoMeyi itholakala ngo-1 Jan.
hypothesis: Ngakho, i-permit ye-backcountry noma yimuphi usuku lokuqala ngoMeyi iyatholakala ku-1 Jan.

source: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
reference: Indawo ezindaweni ezijwayeleke kakhulu, njenge-Bright Angel Campground eseduze kwe-Phantom Ranch, ngokuvamile egwaliswa izicelo ezitholakale ngosuku lokuqala kuvuliwe.
hypothesis: Inkumbulo yezindawo ezithandwayo, njenge Bright Angel Campground elinganiselwe e Phantom Ranch, ivame ukugcwaliswa ngezicelo ezifinyelelwe ngosuku lokuqala lapho ivulwa yizicelo zokubhuka.

source: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.
reference: Kunenani elilinganiselwe lezimvume ezibekelwe izicelo zabafika kungahleliwe ezitholakala kulabo abafike kuqala.
hypothesis: Kukhona inani elilinganiselwe lamalungelo etholakala ngezicelo zokuhamba ngezinyawo, okwamanje okwenzekayo ngezikhathi zokusebenza.

source: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.
reference: Ukungena e-Afrika eseNingizimu kuyindlela amangalisayo yokubona ubuhle bendawo kanye nokuya ezindaweni ezingekho emzileni wezivakashi ovamile.
hypothesis: Ukudla ngezimoto eNingizimu Afrika kuyindlela emangalisayo yokubona ubuhle bomhlaba wonke, kanye nokufinyelela kwezindawo ezingaphandle kwemigwaqo yezivakashi.

source: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.
reference: Lokhu kungenzeka emotweni ejwayelekile uma uhlela ngokucophelela kodwa i-4x4 iyona okutuswa ukuthi uyisebenzise kakhulu futhi ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni eziningi nge-4x4 enamasondo aphakeme kuphela.
hypothesis: Lezi zinto zingenzeka ngezimoto eziqheleleke kakhulu, kodwa i-4x4 ithathwa njengesidingo esibalulekile futhi izindawo eziningi zivulekile kuphela nge-high wheel base 4x4.

source: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.
reference: Ukukhumbula njengoba uhlela ukuthi nakuba i-Afrika eseNingizimu igxilile akuwona wonke amazwe angomakhelwane anjalo.
hypothesis: Qaphela lapho uhlela ukuthi nangona iNingizimu Afrika isezinzile, amazwe amaningi abuyele kuyo awasezinzini.

source: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.
reference: Izimfuneko ze-visa nezindleko kuyahluka emazweni ngamazwe futhi kuthonywa yizwe ovela kulo.
hypothesis: Imfuneko zokuvakasha nezindleko zihluke phakathi kwamazwe kanye nekhodi yezwe olivela kulo.

source: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.
reference: Izwe ngalinye libuye libe nemithetho ehlukile edinga okumelwe kube yizinto zesimo esiphuthumayo okumelwe zibe semotweni.
hypothesis: Ngamunye izwe linemithetho eyahlukene ethi yiziphi izinto eziyisisekelo kumele zibe esikhwameni somthwalo.

source: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.
reference: IMpophoma iVictoria idolobha elisengxenyeni esentshonalanga yaseZimbabwe, ngaphesheya komkhawulo kusuka eTsheni Eliphilayo, eZambia futhi eduze naseBotswana.
hypothesis: UVictoria Falls yidolobha elise esifundeni saseZimbabwe esenyakatho, eduze nomngcele weLivingstone, eZambia, neBotswana.

source: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
reference: Idolobha lakheke eduze kwezimpophoma, futhi ziheha kakhulu, futhi lendawo ethandwayo yezivakashi inikeza kokubili abathandi benjabulo kaye nabathandi bendalo ithuba lokuhlala isikhathi eside.
hypothesis: Imuzi itholakala ngqo eduze ne-falls, futhi yizona ezinkulu zokubukwa, kodwa le ndawo yezokuvakasha ethandwayo inikeza zonke izinsizakalo zokuzilibazisa nezokubukwa zokuhlala isikhathi eside.

source: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
reference: Ngesikhathi semvula (Novemba ukuya kuMashi), izinga lamanzi lizobaphezulu futhi iZimpophoma zizoba namandla kakhulu.
hypothesis: Emkhathini (Novemba kuya ku-Matshi), ivolumu yamanzi izokwandiswa futhi i-Falls izokhuphuka.

source: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
reference: Uyaqinisekiswa ukuthi uzoba manzi uma uwela ibhuloho noma uhamba emizileni eseduze neMpophoma.
hypothesis: Uzokwazi ukuthi uthole amanzi uma udlulele embonweni noma uhambe emigwaqeni ehambayo ezingxenyeni ezingxenyeni zeFalls.

source: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
reference: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kungenxa nje yokuthi amanzi akhona maningi kangangokuba ukubona iMpophoma ngokwayo kuzositheka—yiwo wonke amanzi!
hypothesis: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kuyinto enjalo ngenxa ivolumu amanzi eliphakamileyo ukuba umbono wakho weza amanzi Falls kuyoba yonke amanzi!

source: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.
reference: Ithuna likaTutankhamun (KV62). I-KV63 kungaba yithuna elidume kakhulu eSigodini, indawo yomvubukulo ka-Howard Carter wango-1992 wethuna cishe elisahlangene lasebukhosini lenkosi esencane.
hypothesis: Ityeli likaTutankhamun (KV62). I-KV62 kungenzeka ibe yindawo eyaziwa kakhulu eNtabeni, indawo lapho uHoward Carter etholile khona ukuhlangana kwesigodlo esingcwele sombuso wokugcina wokumkani owayeneminyaka emincane.

source: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.
reference: Uma liqhathaniswa namanye amathuna wasebukhonsini, ithuna likaTutankhamun, kepha, cishe akubalulekanga ukulivakashela, njengoba lilincane kakhudlwana futhi linemihlobiso elinganiselwe.
hypothesis: Ukuqhathaniswa nezinye izigcawu zezinkulungwane, noma kunjalo, ithuna likaTutankhamun lingabonakali luyadingeka, njengoba lincane kakhulu futhi linemibala emincane.

source: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.
reference: Noma ubani onesithakazelo sokubona ubufakazi bomonakalo owenzeke esidumbwini esomiswe ngemithi ngenkathi kuzanywa ukusisusa ebhokisini lomngcwabo uzodumala njengoba kubonakala ikhanda namahlombe kuphela.
hypothesis: Abantu abanomdla wokubona ubufakazi bokulimala kwemummy okwenziwe ngesikhathi kuzama ukuyiphuma emnyango wemnyango bayakwaziswa njengoba kuphela intloko nekhanda elingabonakali.

source: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
reference: Ingcebo emangalisayo yethuna ayisekho kulo, kodwa iyiswe eMnyuziyamu yaseGibhithe e-Khayiro.
hypothesis: Imali enkulu yegumbi elingcwele ayikho kulo, kodwa ithathwe eya eMuseyi waseYiputa eCairo.

source: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
reference: Izivakashi ezinesikhathi esilinganiselwe zingenza kahle ukuchitha isikhathi sazo kwenye indawo.
hypothesis: Abavakashi abanezikhathi ezincane kufanele bahlalele kwelinye indawo.

source: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.
reference: I-Phnom Krom, engu-12 km eningizimu ntshonalanga yeSiem Reap. Leli thempeli eliphezu kwegquma lakhiwa ekugcineni kwekhulu lama-9 leminyaka, phakathi nokubusa kweNkosi uYasovarman.
hypothesis: Phnom Krom, 12 km kuseningizimu-ntshonalanga yeSiem Reap. Lesi sitayela esiphakeme senziwa ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-9, ngesikhathi kubusa uKumkani Yasovarman.

source: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.
reference: Isimo sokungabi nathemba sethempeli kanye nokubona indawo ngaphezu kwechibi leTonle Sap kwenza ukugibela igqube kufanelwe umzamo.
hypothesis: Umbuso wezulu wendlu yomthombo nombono weTonele Sap likhululekile. Ukukhuphuka kwentaba kuyafaneleka.

source: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.
reference: Ukuvakashela indawo kungahlanganiswa ngokufanelekile nohambo lwesikebhe lokuya echibini.
hypothesis: Ukuvakashela kwesayithi kungenziwa ngokuhlanganiswa nekhomishini yasebhishi eya echibini.

source: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
reference: Indawo Yokudlula yase-Angkor iyadingeka ukuze ungene ethempelini ngakho ungakhohlwa ukuza nephasiphothi yakho uma uya eTonle Sap.
hypothesis: Ukukhona kufanele kube ne-Angkor Pass ukuze ungene esontweni ngakho ungakhohlwa ukuthi uthathe iphasiwedi yakho lapho uya eTonle Sap.

source: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.
reference: IJerusalema inhlokodolobha futhi idolobha elikhulu kunawo wonke lakwa-Israyeli, nakuba amanye amazwe amaningi neZizwe Ezihlangene zingayiqapheli njengenhlokodolobha yakwa-Israyeli.
hypothesis: Jerusalem yisikhundla esiyinhloko nesiphakamiso se-Israyeli, noma kunjalo amazwe amaningi ne-United Nations angawamukeli njengesiphakamiso se-Israyeli.

source: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.
reference: Idolobha lamandulo eMagqumeni aseJudiya linomlando othakazelisayo oneminyaka eyizinkulungwane.
hypothesis: Imuzi yendawo yasendulo eJudean Hills inezindaba ezithakazelisayo eziphathelene neminyaka eyinkulungwane.

source: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.
reference: Idolobha lingcwele ezinkolweni ezintathu ezikholelwa kuNkulunkulu oyedwa – ubuJuda, ubuKhristu kanye nobuSulumani, futhi liyisikhungo esingokomoya, esingokwenkolo, kanye nesingokwesiko.
hypothesis: Imizi yisikhumbuzo esingcwele kuzo zonke izinkolo ezintathu zomuntu - iJuda, iKristu ne-Islamu - futhi isebenza njengekhaya elingcwele, elinomlando wokuziphendukela kwabantu, wokuziphendukela kwamasiko, nezomlando wokuziphendukela kwamasiko.

source: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
reference: Ngenxa yokubaluleka okungokwenkolo kwedolobha, futhi ngokukhethekile izindawo eziningi zendawo yeDolobha Lakudala, iJerusalema ingenye yezindawo eziyinhloko izivakashi eziya kuyo kwa-Israyeli.
hypothesis: Ngokuba kubaluleke kakhulu emkhosini waseJerusalem, kanye nezindawo eziningi zaseOld City, iJerusalem yenye yezindawo ezinkulu zokuvakasha e-Israyeli.

source: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
reference: IJerusalema linezindawo eziningi zomlando, zemivubukulo kanye nezamasiko kuhlanganise nezindawo zokuthenga ezinhle neziphithizelayo, amakhefi kanye nezindawo zokudlela.
hypothesis: Jerusalem inezindawo eziningi zembali, zezakhiwo zomlando nezamasiko, kanye nezikhungo zokuthenga ezinomswakama, amakhawulwini nezindawo zokudlela.

source: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
reference: I-Ecuador ilindele ukuthi izakhamuzi zase-Cuba zithole incwadi yesimemo ngaphambi kokungena e-Ecuadore ngezikhululo zezindiza zakwamanye amazwe noma izindawo zokungena ezisephethelweni.
hypothesis: U-Ecuador lidinga ukuthi abantu baseCuba bafumane incwadi yokubiza ngaphambi kokungena e-Ecuador ngezindiza zamazwe omhlaba noma amaphuzu okungena.

source: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
reference: Lencwadi kumelwe yenziwe ibe semthethweni yi-Ecuadore Ministry of Foreign Affairs, futhi yenze ngokuvumelana nezicelo ezidingekayo.
hypothesis: Lezi zincazelo zifanele zilungiselelwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle Wezwe lase-Ecuador, futhi zifanele zizwele izidingo ezithile.

source: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
reference: Lezi zidingo zakhelwe ukunikeza indlela ehlelekile yokuthutha phakathi kwamazwe womabili.
hypothesis: Lezi zidingo zenzelwe ukunikeza ukuhamba okuhleliwe phakathi kwamazwe amabili.

source: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
reference: Izakhamuzi zaseCuba ezinemvume yokuhlala nokusebenza eMelika kumelwe zivakashele Inxusa lase-Ecuadore ukuze zithole ukukhululwa kulemfuneko.
hypothesis: Abantu baseCuba abanezitifiketi ze-US green card kumele vakashela i-Ecuadorian Consulate ukuze bathole isivumelwano kule mfuneko.

source: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
reference: Iphasiphoti yakho kumelwe ibe semthethweni okungenani izinyana ezingu-6 ngaphezu kwezinsuku zakho zohambo. Ithikithi lokuya nokubuya liyadingeka ukufakazela ubude besikhathi ozosihlala.
hypothesis: IPasipoti yakho kumele ibe valid for at least 6 months beyond travel dates. Ticket yomqhudelwano/ukubuyela emuva kumele ibe khona ukuze kubonakale ubude besikhathi sokuhlala kwakho.

source: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.
reference: Ukuvakasha kushibhile emaqenjini amakhulu, ngakho uma uzimele noma unomngane oyedwa, zama ukuhlangana nabanye abantu ukuze nakhe iqembu labantu abane noma abasithupha ukuze nithole amanani aphansi omuntu oyedwa.
hypothesis: Uhambo luyancipha kwiqela elikhulu, ngoko ukuba ungabanye okanye nabanye umhlobo, zama ukubutha nabanye abantu uze wenze iqela le-4 okanye le-6 ngenxa yokunciphisa intengo nganye.

source: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.
reference: Nokho, lokhu akumelwe kukukhathaze, ngoba kaningi izivakashi ziyiswa ngapha nangapha ukugcwalisa izimoto.
hypothesis: Kodwa lokhu akufanele ngempela kube off ukucabanga kwakho, ngoba ngokuvamile izivakashi zihanjiswa emhlabeni ukuze zigcwalise imoto.

source: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
reference: Kubonakala empeleni kuyindlela yokuyengela abantu ekucabangeni ukuthi kumelwe bakhokhele okwengeziwe.
hypothesis: Kubonakala ngempela ukuba kuyindlela yokudukisa abantu ukuze bakholwe ukuba kumele bakhokhe okuningi.

source: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
reference: Ime ngaphezu kwengxenye esenyakatho yeMachu Picchu yilentaba ewummango, kaningi okuyindawo evelayo ngemuva ezithombeni zamanxiwa.
hypothesis: Emuva kwesokudla kweMachupicchu esiphakeme kakhulu, yimaphi amagquma amaningi, okuvame ukubonwa emifanekisweni yezindawo eziyiziphethu.

source: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
reference: Kubukeka kusabisa kancane kusuka ngaphansi, futhi yindawo eyehlelayo nokunzima ukukhuphuka kuyo, kodwa abantu abakulungele ngokwanele kufanele bakwazi ukukwenza cishe ngemizuzu engama-45.
hypothesis: Kubukeka kuyinto enzima kakhulu ezingeni elingaphansi, futhi kuyinto enzima futhi eziyinkimbinkimbi ezingeni eliphakeme, kodwa abantu abaningi abanezimo zokuziphatha kufanele bangene mayelana nemizuzu engu-45.

source: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
reference: Izitebhisizamatshe zibekwa eceleni kwendlela, futhi ezingxenyeni ezinomqansa izintambo zensimbi ziba uthango lokubambelelisa izandla .
hypothesis: Imibhede yamatye yalungiswa emigwaqeni iningi, futhi emigwaqeni enyakazayo, amakhasi e-steel anikeza isandla esisiza.

source: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
reference: Nokho, lindela ukuphelelwa umoya, futhi uziqaphele ezingxenyeni ezehlelayo, ikakhulukazi lapho kumanzi, njengoba kungaba yingozi ngokushesha.
hypothesis: Oku kusho ukuthi, linda uze uphefumle, futhi qaphela emigqeni esheshayo, ikakhulukazi lapho ishushu, njengoba kungaba yingozi ngokushesha.

source: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
reference: Kunomhume omncane eduze nesiqongo okumelwe kudlulwe kuwo, usezansi kakhulu futhi uminyene.
hypothesis: Kukhona igumbi elincane eliseduze phezulu elidinga ukudluliselwa ngaphakathi, kuyinto eliphantsi kakhulu futhi kuyinto ethambile kakhulu.

source: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
reference: Ukubona izindawo kanye nezilwane zasendle zamaGalapago kwenzeka kahle kakhulu ngesikebhe, njengoba nje uCharles Darwin enza ngo-1835.
hypothesis: Ukubona izindawo nezinambuzane zeGalapagos kuhle kakhulu ngezikebhe, njengoba uCharles Darwin wenza ngo-1835.

source: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
reference: Imikhumbi yokuvakasha engaphezu kuka-60 igwedla emanzini wamaGalapago - ihluka ngobukhulu kusukela kwegibeza abantu abangu-8 kuya ku-100.
hypothesis: Ngaphezu kwe-60 izikebhe zikawoyela amanzi aseGalapagos - kusukela emkhawini we-8 kuya kwe-100 abagibeli.

source: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
reference: Abantu abaningi babhukha indawo yabo kusenesikhathi (njengoba izikebhe ziyaye zisheshe ukugcwala ngezikhathi ezimatasa zonyaka).
hypothesis: Iningi labantu bayalwamukela izindawo zabo kusenesikhathi (njengoba izikebhe ivame ukuba iphelele ngesikhathi esiphakeme).

source: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
reference: Qinisekisa ukuthi umuntu okubhukelayo unguchwepheshe wamaGalapago onalwazi oluhle lwezinhlobonhlobo eziningi zemikhumbi.
hypothesis: Qinisekisa ukuthi ummeli owubhukile ungumthombo weGalapagos ongakwazi kahle ulwazi lwezitsha eziningi.

source: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
reference: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi onesithakazelo kukho ngokukhethekile kanye/noma okukucindezelayo kuhambisana nomkhumbi okufanele kakhulu.
hypothesis: Lozoqinisekisa ukuthi izithakazelo zakho ezithile ne/okanye izidingo zakho zifanelwe yizikhulu ezifanele kakhulu kuzo.

source: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.
reference: Ngaphambi kokuba kufike abantu baseSpeyini ngekhulu lama-16 leminyaka, iChile esenyakatho beyingaphansi kokubusa kwama-Inca kuyilapho ama-Araucania wendabuko (Mapuche) ayehlala eChile ephakathi neseningizimu.
hypothesis: Ngaphambi kokuba iSpanish ifike e-16th century, iChile enyakatho yayiphantsi kwe- Inca rule, kanti iAraucanians (iMapuche) yayibekwe eCentral neSouth Chile.

source: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.
reference: Ama-Mapuche bekungamanye wamaqembu omdabu azimele wokugcina waseMelika, ababengangenanga ngokugcwele emthethweni wokukhuluma isiPanishi ngemva kokuzimela kwe-Chile.
hypothesis: Abantu base Mapuche babeyingxenye yezinye izizwe zaseMelika ezazizimele, ezingazange zibuyiselwe phansi kwamagunya aseSpanish kwaze kwaba ngemva kokuzimela kweChile.

source: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.
reference: Nakuba i-Chile yamemezela ukuzimela ngo-1810 (phakathi kwezimpi zikaNapholiyoni ezashiya iSpeyini ngaphandle kohulumeni omkhulu iminyaka embalwa), ukunqoba abantu baseSpeyini okungumnqamulajuqu akwenzekanga kwaze kwaba ngu-1818.
hypothesis: Yize iChile ibizele inkululeko ngo-1810 (ngaphakathi kwempi yeNapoleon yaseSpain engabonakali ngaphandle kwesizwe esisebenzayo iminyaka emibili), ukunqoba okuphawulekayo kwaseSpain kwenzeka kuphela ngo-1818.

source: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti
reference: i-Dominican Republic (iSpanish: República Dominicana) iyisizwe sase-Caribbean esisengxenyeni esempumalanga yesiqhingi sase-Hispaniola, eyabelana ne-Haiti
hypothesis: URiphabhulikhi yeDominican (Spanish: República Dominicana) yindawo yaseCaribbean etholakala eMpumalanga yeIsland of Hispaniola, enesabelomali neHaiti.

source: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.
reference: Ngaphandle kwezihlabathi ezimhlophe zolwandle kanye nezindawo ezinezintaba, lelizwe liyikhaya ledolobha elidala kunawo wonke laseYurophu kuma-Americas, manje okuyingxenye yeSanto Domingo.
hypothesis: Ngaphandle kwamabhishi amhlophe emhlabeni nasemahlathini, leli zwe lizungezwe idolobha elidala laseYurophu eMelika, okwakuyi Santo Domingo.

source: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.
reference: Esiqhingini ekuqaleni bekuhlala ama-Taíno namaCaribe. AmaCaribe bekungabantu abakhuluma isi-Arawaka abafike ngawo-10,000 BCE.
hypothesis: Umkhaya wokuqala waselela esiqhingini i-Taínos ne-Caribes. I-Caribes yayingabantu abase-Arawakan abafikileyo ngo-10,000 BCE.

source: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors
reference: Phakathi neminyaka embalwa ngemva kokufika kwezinhloli zaseYurophu, inani labantu baseTainos lehliswe ngokuphawulekayo abanqobi baseSpeyini
hypothesis: Ngemva kweminyaka embalwa yokufika kwabahambi baseYurophu, inani labantu baseTainos lathuthuka kakhulu ngokwehliswa yabaqhubi baseSpanish.

source: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
reference: Ngokusekelwe kuFray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) phakathi kuka-1492 no-1498 abanqobi baseSpeyini babulala ama-Taíno acishe abe ngu-100,000.
hypothesis: Ngokusho kuka Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) phakathi kuka 1492 no 1498, abaseSpain babulala cishe amakhulu ayisigidi eziyisithupha Taínos.

source: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.
reference: I-Jardín de la Unión. Lesi sikhala sakhiwa njengegceke lesonto ngekhulu le-17, lapho i-Templo de San Diego eyisakhiwo esasindayo kuphela.
hypothesis: Jardín de la Unión. Lesi siqongqo sakhiwa njengesakhiwo esisemkhunjini sekhaya le-17th century, lapho iTemplo de San Diego yaba yedwa esakhiwe.

source: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.
reference: Manje isebenza njengesigcawu esiyinhloko edolobheni, futhi ihlala inezinto eziningi ezenzekayo, emini nasebusuku.
hypothesis: Inhloso yayo manje yisikhungo esikhulu, futhi njalo kunezinto eziningi ezisebenza khona, imini nobusuku.

source: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.
reference: Kunezitolo zokudlela eziningana ezizungeze ingadi, futhi emini nasentambama lapho amakhonsati wamahhala avame ukunikezwa kusuka etendeni eliyinhloko.
hypothesis: Kukhona inombolo ethile zokudlela emhlabeni engadini, futhi emva kwemini nasebusuku khona imikhosi yamahhala evunyelwe kusukela esigodini esisodwa.

source: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.
reference: I-Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Ovulanda ababili abahlukaniswe amasentimitha angu-69 kuphela ikhaya lenganekwana yakudala yothando.
hypothesis: U-Callejon del Beso (I-Alley of the Kiss). Amabhomu amabili ahluke nje nge-69 cm yimithetho yothando endala.

source: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.
reference: Ngemadlana ezinye izingane zizokuzekela indaba.
hypothesis: Ngamaphesenti ambalwa abantwana bazokutshela indaba.

source: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.
reference: ISiqhingi sase-Bowen uhambo losuku oluthandwayo noma uhambo lokungcebeleka lwempelasonto oluhlanganisa izikebhe ezigwedlwayo, ukuqwala izintaba, izitolo, izindawo zokudlela, kanye nokunye.
hypothesis: U-Bowen Island yindawo ethandwayo yokuhamba usuku noma i-weekend, enikeza ukuhamba nge-kayak, ukuhamba ngezintaba, izitolo, nezindawo zokudlela.

source: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.
reference: Lo mphakathi wangempela use-Howe Sound ekuceleni nje kwe-Vancouver, futhi ungaya kuso kalula ngetikisi yasemanzini ehleliwe esuka esiQhingini saseGrandville phakathi edolobheni lase-Vancouver.
hypothesis: Lezi zindawo zomphakathi ziqinile zitholakala eHowe Sound eduze neVancouver, futhi zingafinyelelwa kalula ngezimoto zezokuthutha zomkhumbi ezithunyelwa eGranville Island eVancouver emzini.

source: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.
reference: Kulabo abajabulela imisebenzi yangaphandle, umzila oya emhubheni weSea to Sky ubalulekile.
hypothesis: Kuba abathanda imisebenzi yangaphandle, uhambo oluya eSea to Sky corridor kuyimfuneko.

source: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.
reference: IWhistler (uhambo lwamahora angu-1.5 uma ushayela kusuka eVancouver) iyabiza kodwa iyaziwa kakhulu ngenxa yama-Olimpiki aseBusika ango-2010.
hypothesis: UWhistler (i-1.5 ihora ukusuka eVancouver) inezindleko eziphakeme kodwa idume ngenxa ye-2010 Winter Olympics.

source: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.
reference: Uma kusebusika, ungathokokozela ukushushuluza eqhweni eNyakatho Melika, futhi uma kusehlobo ungazama ukuzijabulisa ngokuqombola izintaba ngamabhayisikili kwangempela.
hypothesis: Emnyakeni, khetha ezinye zezintaba ezingcono kakhulu zaseNyakatho Melika, futhi ehlobo zama ibhayisikili yezintaba eziyiqiniso.

source: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.
reference: Izimvume kumelwe zitholwe kusengaphambili. Kumelwe ube nemvume yokuhlala ubusuku bonke eSirena.
hypothesis: Amalungelo kumele abe yizindlu zokubhukha kusengaphambili. Kumele ube nephutha lokuhlala ebusuku eSirena.

source: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.
reference: ISirena yiso kuphela isiteshi sabanakekeli bamahlathi esinezindawo zokulala zamakamelo alala abantu abaningi nokudla okushisayo ngaphezu kokukanisa. ILa Leona, iSan Pedrillo, kanye neLos Patos zihlinzeka ngokukanisa kuphela ngaphandle kwezinkonzo zokudla.
hypothesis: ISirena yedwa indawo yokuhlala yomqhubi esinikeza indawo yokuhlala ephaketheni nekhishi elinamanzi ashisayo ngaphezu kwokuhamba. La Leona, San Pedrillo, neLos Patos zinikeza indawo yokuhlala ephaketheni kuphela ngaphandle kwesisekelo sezokudla.

source: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards
reference: Kuyenzeka ukuthola izimvume zepaki ngokuqondile Esiteshi Somphathi Wendawo ePuerto Jiménez, kodwa abemukeli wonke amakhadi wokuthenga ngesikweletu
hypothesis: Kungenzeka ukuthi uthole amalayisense esikhumulweni sezilwane ePuerto Jiménez, kodwa awazamukeli amakhadi esikweletu.

source: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.
reference: I-The Park Service (MINAE) ayihlinzeki ngezimvume zokupaka uma kusasele isikhathi esingaphezu kwenyanga eyodwa ngaphambi kosuku ozofika ngalo.
hypothesis: Uma uMnyango wePark (MINAE) awunikezi amalungelo okuphuma emzini okwanele ngenyanga eyodwa ngaphambi kokufika okulindelekile.

source: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.
reference: i-CafeNet El Sol inikezela ngamasevisi okubhuka ngemali engu- US$30, noma u- $10 ngokudlula kosuku olulodwa; imininingwane isekhasini labo le-Corcovado.
hypothesis: ICafeNet El Sol inikeza inkonzo yokubhuka imali engu-US$30, noma $10 yezincwadi zomsebenzi omunye-day; imininingwane kwiCorcovado page.

source: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
reference: Iziqhingi zoMpheki isiqhingi esiyizwe elizihlanganise ngokuzithandela neNyuzilandi, ezisePholinesiya, phakathi Nolwandlekazi iNingizimu Phasifiki.
hypothesis: Imiphakathi ye-Cook Islands yizwe elingaphakathi elihlukaniswe ne-New Zealand, elisePolynesia, ephakathi kwePacific Ocean.

source: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.
reference: Yidlanzana leziqhingi elineziqhingi ezingu-15 ezisabalele endaweni eyizigidi ezingu-2.2 km2 zolwandle.
hypothesis: Kuyinto i-archipelago enezindawo eziyi-15 ezahlukene ezingaphezu kwe-2.2 million km2 yomfula.

source: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".
reference: Ngesikhathi sendawo esifana nesaseHawaii, iziqhingi ngezinye izikhathi zithathwa "njengeziseHawaii".
hypothesis: Ngokufanayo nesikhathi esifanayo ne-Hawaii, amazwe amaningi athiwa "Hawaii phansi phansi".

source: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.
reference: Noma iyincane, ikhumbuza izivakashi ezikhulile i-Hawaii ngaphambi kokumiswa njengombuso ngaphandle kwamahhotela amakhulu wezivakashi kanye nezinye izakhiwo.
hypothesis: Ngisho nje, kuyakhumbuza abanye abadala abavakashile i-Hawaii ngaphambi kokuba babe ne-statehood ngaphandle kwamahhotela amakhulu nezinye izinto zokuthuthukiswa.

source: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
reference: IziQhingi zaseCook azinawo noma imaphi amadolobha kodwa zenziwe yiziqhingi ezingu-15 ezihlukahlukene. Eziyinhloko iRarotong kanye ne-Aitutaki.
hypothesis: Amazwi e Cook Islands awunawo amadolobha kodwa aqukethe amazwe amahlanu. Amazwe amakhulu yi Rarotonga ne Aitutaki.

source: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.
reference: Emazweni aphucukile namuhla, ahlinzeka ngezindawo zokulala nokudla kwasekuseni kwenziwa kwaba indlela ethile yobuciko
hypothesis: In amazwe aseziqinile namuhla, ukunikeza amahhotela eziphambili nezingeni eliphakeme kuye kwaba yindlela yobuciko.

source: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.
reference: Ezingeni eliphezulu, amaB&B ngokusobala ancintisana ngezinto ezimbili eziyinhloko: indawo yokulala nokudla kwasekuseni.
hypothesis: Ngasekupheleni, i-B&Bs ibhekene ngokuqinile ngezinto ezimbili ezinkulu: ukulala nobusuku.

source: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.
reference: Ngakho-ke, ezindaweni ezihle kakhulu umuntu kufanele athole izinto zokulala zikanokusho, mhlawumbe ingube yokwendlala eyenziwe ngezandla noma umbhede wasendulo.
hypothesis: Ngokufanelekile, kuzo zonke izindawo ezifanelekileyo, unokufumana iibhedi eziphambili kakhulu, mhlawumbi iquilt eyenziwe ngesandla okanye ibhedi yendalo.

source: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.
reference: Ukudla kwasekuseni kungahlanganisa ukudla okumnandi kwasendaweni kwenkathi ethile yonyaka noma isidlo esikhethekile sombungazi.
hypothesis: Usuku lwasekuseni lungaba luhlanganisa izinto eziphakathi kwesizini zomndeni noma isidlo esikhethekileyo somnini.

source: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.
reference: Indawo ingaba esakhiweni sakudala esingokomlando esinempahla yamandulo, izingadi ezilungiswe kahle kanye nechibi lokubhukuda.
hypothesis: Ukukhetha kungaba yindlu endala yembali enezinto zangaphakathi eziyisisekelo, amagquma ahleliwe futhi ne-swimming pool.

source: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.
reference: Ukungena emotweni yakho bese uya ohambweni olude kunokuthandeka okungokoqobo kanye nokuba lula kwakho.
hypothesis: Ukungena emoto wakho futhi uhambele endaweni ende yomgwaqo inezincomo zayo zokuthi kube lula.

source: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.
reference: Ngokungafani nezimoto ezinkulu ngokuqinisekile usujwayelene nokushayela imoto yakho futhi uyakwazi ukulinganisela kwayo.
hypothesis: Ngokungafani neezimoto ezinkulu, ungase usaziwayo kakade ukushayela imoto yakho futhi uyazi izimo zayo.

source: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.
reference: Ukumisa itende endaweni enomnikazi noma edolobheni lanoma ibuphi ubukhulu kungabanga ukunakwa okungafunwa.
hypothesis: Ukukhonza indlu yentente kwisakhiwo sangasese noma emzini enkulu kungaholela ekuziphatheni okungafuneki.

source: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".
reference: Kafuphi, ukusebenzisa imoto yakho indlela ekahle kakhulu yokuthatha uhambo olude kodwa akuvamanga ukuthi kube yindlela “yokukanisa”.
hypothesis: Kwesinye isikhathi, ukusebenzisa imoto yakho kuyindlela enhle yokuhamba, kodwa kungavamile ukuthi "ukucocwa" ngokwakho.

source: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.
reference: Ukukanisa emotweni kungenzeka lapho uneveni encane, i-SUV, iSedan noma iStation Wagon esinezihlalo ezikwazi ukulala.
hypothesis: Ukucampera ngeCar kungenzeka uma une-Minivan enkulu, SUV, Sedan noma i-Station Wagon enezihlalo eziyishumi.

source: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
reference: Amanye amahhotela anefa elisuka enkathini yokuchuma yezitimela nemikhumbi ehamba ngamalahle; ngaphambi kweMpi Yomhlaba Yesibili, ngekhulu lama-19 noma ekuqaleni kwelama-20 leminyaka.
hypothesis: Amanye amahhotela anelisekile ngezimpande zomlando wasekhaya wama-steam railways ne-ocean liners; phambi kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, emuva kwekhulu le-19th noma ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-20th.

source: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.
reference: Lawa mahhotela bekuyilapho abacebile nabadumile bangaleyo nkathi ababehlala khona, futhi kaningi ayenokuhla okuphambili nezenzakalo zasebusuku.
hypothesis: Lezi zindawo zezihhotela lapho abacebile nabazomileyo bekhona, futhi banezindawo zokudlela ezinhle nezikhathi zokuzijabulisa.

source: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.
reference: Izindlela zakudala zokugqoka, kanye nokwentuleka kwezakamuva futhi nendlela ethokozisayo abakhula ngayo iveza ububona.
hypothesis: Ukukhanya kwendawo yasekhaya, ukungabikho kwezinto zokuhlobisa zakamuva, kanye nokuhleleka okuhleliwe okudala kuyingxenye yomqondo wawo.

source: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.
reference: Nakuba zinabanikazi ngokuvamile, kwesinye isikhathi zihlalisa iziphathimandla nezinye izikhulu.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma zivalelwe ngokuphathelene, zingase zifakwe ngamakhosi abezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezindlu zezind

source: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.
reference: Umhambi onemali eningi angacabangela uhambo lwendiza oluzungeza umhlaba wonke, olunqunywe ngokuhlala kwamaningi wamahotela lawa.
hypothesis: Umbhobhozane onemali eningi ungacabanga mayelana nokuhamba emhlabeni wonke, okuhambisana nokuhlala emahhotela amaningi.

source: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.
reference: I-hospitality exchange network inhlangano ehlanganisa izihambi nabantu bendawo emadolobheni eziyowavakashela.
hypothesis: Inethiwekhi yobumnandi yinkampani ehlanganisa abahambi nabantu abahlala emadolobheni abo bayohamba.

source: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.
reference: Ukujoyina inethiweki enjalo ngokuvamile kudinga nje ukugcwalisa ifomu eku-inthanethi; nakuba amanye amanethiweki anikeza noma adinga ukudinisekiswa.
hypothesis: Ujoyiningiwe kule nethwekhi ngokuvamile kudinga ukugcwalisa ifomu eliku-intanethi; noma kunjalo, ezinye nethwekhi zinikeza noma zidinga ukuqinisekiswa okwengeziwe.

source: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.
reference: Uhlu lwababungazi abatholakalayolinikezwa ngokushicilelwa kanye/noma ku-inthanethi, kwesinye isikhathi nezinkomba kanye nokubuyekezwa kwabanye abahambi.
hypothesis: Uhlu lwezisebenzi ezitholakalayo luyatholakala noma ngokuphrintiwe noma online, ngezikhathi ngezinye izibuyekezo nezibuyekezo zabahambi abanye.

source: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
reference: I-couchsurfing yasungulwa ngoJanuwari 2004 ngemva kokuba umlobi wezinhlelo zokusebenza zekhompyutha uCasey Fenton athole indiza engabizi yokuya e-Iceland kodwa engenayo indawo yokuhlala.
hypothesis: Ukucubungula kwasekelwa ngoJanuwari 2004 emva kokuthola indiza eshibhile e-Iceland kodwa engenawo indawo yokuhlala.

source: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
reference: Wathumela abafundi benyuvesi yendawo ama-imeyili futhi wathola inani elimangalisayo labantu ababefuna ukumnika indawo yokuhlala mahhala.
hypothesis: Uthumele ama-imeyili kubafundi esikoleni esisedolobheni futhi wathola inani elikhulu lamathuba okuhlala mahhala.

source: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.
reference: Amahostela ahlalisa abantu abasha ngokuyinhloko – isivakashi esivamile siseminyakeni yamashumi amabili – kodwa ungathola nezihambi ezindala kaningi.
hypothesis: Amaholide ajwayele ukukhonza abantu abasebancane – umlingisi ojwayelekile ungaba eminyakeni engaphezu kwemibili ubudala – kodwa ungase uthole abahambi abadala khona futhi.

source: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.
reference: Imindeni enabantwana ayijwayelekile, kodwa amanye amahostela ayayivumela emakamelweni wangasese.
hypothesis: Imbali yabantu abanezingane ayinqabile, kodwa ezinye izindawo zokuhlala zivumela ukuba zibekwe emagumbini ahlukene.

source: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.
reference: Idolabha laseBeijing eShayina lizokwengamela Imidlalo yama-Olimpikhi Asebusika ngo-2022, nokuzoyenza idolabha lokuqala lokubungaza yomibili imidlalo yama-Olimpikhi yasebusika nasehlobo.
hypothesis: Umasipala wase-Beijing eChina uzoba yisikhungo se-2022 Olympic Winter Games, okwenza kube yisikhungo esiyisikhombisa esinomlando wokuba yisikhungo se-Olympic Summer ne-Winter.

source: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
reference: I-Beijing izobungaza imicimbi yokuvula neyokuvala kanye nemidlalo yeqhwa yangaphakathi.
hypothesis: Beijing izokuba yindawo yokubamba imicimbi yokuvula nokuvalela kanye nemicimbi yezindawo zasendlini zokubhukuda.

source: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
reference: Ezinye izehlakalo zokushushuluza eqhweni zizoba sendaweni yase-Taizicheng yokushushuluza eqhweni e-Zhangjiakou, cishe ama-220 km (140 amamayela) kusuka eBeijing.
hypothesis: Omunye imicimbi ski kuzoba Taizicheng ski endaweni Zhangjiakou, mayelana 220 km (140 amamayela) kusuka Beijing.

source: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
reference: Iningi lamathempeli linawo umkhosi Waminyaka Yonke oqala ekupheleni kukaNovemba kuya Phakathi kukaMeyi, okuhluka kuya ngekhalenda laminyaka yonke lethempeli ngalinye.
hypothesis: Iningi lezakhiwo zezintaba zinomkhosi wonyaka oqala ekuqaleni kukaNovemba kuya phakathi naseMay, okuhlukahluka ngokuya ngekhalenda yonyaka yezakhiwo zezintaba nganye.

source: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
reference: Iningi lemikhosi yethempeli ligujwa njengengxenye yesikhumbuzo sethempeli noma ukugujwa kosuku lokuzalwa likankulunkulu ophethe.
hypothesis: Iningi lezikhumbuzo zetempile zilalelwa njengengxenye yomkhosi wempilo yomthombo noma usuku lokuzalwa kwesithombe esihle noma enye imicimbi ebalulekile eyahlobene netempile.

source: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
reference: Imikhosi yasethempelini laseKerala iyathakazelisa kakhulu ukuyibona, kanye nokumasha kwezindlovu ezihlotshisiwe, iqembu le-orchestra lethempeli neminye imikhosi.
hypothesis: Imibukiso yamasonto eKerala yimibukiso emangalisayo ukubona, nezinkampani zokuhamba zezimvu ezihlotsheni, umculo wamasonto nezinye imikhosi.

source: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
reference: IWorld's Fair (ngokuvamile ebizwa World Exposition, noma kalula i-Expo) umkhosi omkhulu kunayo yonke wamazwe onke wobuciko nesayensi.
hypothesis: Umbukiso wezwe (ngokuvamile obizwa nge-World Exposition, noma nje i-Expo) yisikhathi esikhulu sokuhlanganiswa kwamazwe omhlaba wemisebenzi yezobuciko nezesayensi.

source: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
reference: Amazwe athathe ingxenye abemele amaciko kanye nemfundo ebonakaliswa ezindaweni zikazwelonke ukubonisa izinkinga zomhlaba wonke noma isiko lezwe labo kanye nomlando.
hypothesis: Amazwe asebenzisana anikeza imiboniso yobuciko nezemfundo emazweni abo ukuze babonise izinkinga zomhlaba noma isiko nembali yezwe labo.

source: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
reference: Ama-International Horticultural Exposition ezenzakalo ezikhethekile ezikhangisa ngezimbali, izingadi zezimbali kanye nanoma yini ehlangene nezitshalo.
hypothesis: Imibukiso ye-Horticultural ye-International yizenzakalo ezikhethekile ezibonisa izibonakaliso ze-floral, amagugu e-botanical neminye imisebenzi enxulumene neziqhamo.

source: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
reference: Nakuba ngokubonwa ngokucabanga zingenzeka njalo ngonyaka (uma nje zisemazweni ahlukile), ngokoqobo akunjalo.
hypothesis: Ngokomthetho, zingaba zenzeka minyaka yonke (njengoba zingaba zezwe elahlukene), kepha empeleni zingaba zenzeka.

source: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
reference: Lezi zenzakalo ngokuvamile zithatha esikhathi esiphakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu kanye neziyisithupha, futhi zibanjelwa ezindaweni okungenani ezingamahektare angu-50
hypothesis: Lezi zindaba zivame ukuthatha isikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu kuya kwemithathu, futhi zivame ukuba zinamaphesenti angaphansi kwamashumi amahlanu.

source: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
reference: Kunezinhlobo eziningi zamafilimu ebezisentshenziswa kule minyaka edlule. Evamile ifilimu ingu-35 mm (36 uphindaphiwe ka-24 mm) iwona abevamile.
hypothesis: Kunezinhlobo eziningi ze-film format ezisetshenziswe eminyakeni. I-Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) iyona ethandwa kakhulu.

source: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
reference: Ngokuvamile kugcwaliseka futhi kalula kakhulu uma uphelelwa, futhi inikeza okubukeka okulinganiselwa kulokho okukhona kwe-DSLR.
hypothesis: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, futhi linikeza isixazululo okwesilinganiso esifanekisela i-DSLRI yamanje.

source: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
reference: Amanye amakhamera wamafilimi wohlobo oluphakathi asebenzisa ifomethi ye-6 ngo-6, ngokunembile kakhudlwana inegethivu ka-56 ngo-56 mm.
hypothesis: Amanye amakhamera e-film e-format eliphakathi asetshenziselwa ifomethi ye-6 by 6 cm, ngokucacile i-56 by 56 mm enganekwane.

source: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
reference: Lokhu kunikeza ukubonakala cishe okuyizikhathi ezine kunenegethivu ka-35 mm (3136mm2 kuqhathaniswa ne-864) .
hypothesis: Lezi zikusiza ukuba kusetshenziswe isisombululo cishe kathathu okwenzekayo kwi-negative ye-35 mm (3136 mm2 versus 864).

source: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
reference: Izilwane zasendle umhlobiso wezithombe olukhuni kakhulu kwabathatha izithombe, futhi udinga inhlanganisela yenhlanhla, isineke, ulwazi kanye namathuluzi akahle.
hypothesis: Ukudweba iWildlife kuyingxenye enkulu yezinto eziyinkimbinkimbi zokudweba, futhi kudinga inhlanhla, ukubekezela, amava, kanye nekhithi elihle lokudweba.

source: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
reference: Ukuthatha izithombe kwezilwane zasendle kaningi kuthathwa kalula, kodwa njengokuthatha izithombe okuvamile, isithombe sisho okuningi kakhulu.
hypothesis: Ukudweba izilwane kuyahlukumeza kakhulu, kodwa njengokudweba jikelele, isithombe siyafaneleka amawaka amagama.

source: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
reference: Ukuthatha amafotho wasendle ngokuvamile kudinga ilensi yamafotho ende, nakuba izinto ezinjengomhlambi wezinyoni noma izidalwa ezincane zidinga amanye amalensi.
hypothesis: Ukudweba izilwane kudinga lens ende ye-telephoto, noma yini enjalo njengamaphiko wezinyoni noma isilwane esincane kudinga lens ehlukile.

source: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
reference: Izilwane eziningi ezingavamile kunzima ukuzithola, futhi amapaki ngezinye izikhathi anemithetho emayelana nokuthatha izithombe ngenjongo yokuhweba ngazo.
hypothesis: Iningi lezilwane ezithakazelisayo ziyadingeka ukuthola, futhi amapaki ngezinye izikhathi banamathela imithetho mayelana nokuthatha izithombe zokuhweba.

source: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
reference: Izilwane zasendle zingaba namahloni noma zibe nolaka. Indawo ingabanda, ishise, noma ibe yimbi ngenye indlela.
hypothesis: Wild animals bangase bahlale bengabazeki noma bangase baphathe impilo yabo ngenhla. Isimo sangempela singaba esibandayo, esishisayo, noma esingabonakali.

source: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
reference: Umhlaba unezilimi ezihlukene ezingaphezu kuka-5,000, kuhlanganise nezingaphezu kwamashumi amabili ezinezikhulumi eziyizigidi ezingu-50 noma ngaphezulu.
hypothesis: Umbhali wezilimi emhlabeni unemvelaphi ezingaphezu kuka-5,000, kuhlanganise nezingaphezu kuka-20 zezilimi ezinezigidi ezingaphezu kuka-50 zabantu abakhuluma.

source: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
reference: Kaningi kulula ukuqonda amazwi abhaliwe kunakhulunywayo, futhi. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ngokukhethekile ngamakheli, lawo kaningi okunzima ukuwaphimisela kahle.
hypothesis: Amagama abhalelweyo atholakala lula kunamagama asetshenziswa, kakhulu. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ikakhulukazi mayelana nezindawo zokuhlala, ezingaba nzima ukuwazwa ngokucacile.

source: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
reference: Izizwe eziningi eziphelele zisikhuluma kahle isiNgisi, futhi nakwezinye ezengeziwe ungalindela ulwazi olulinganiselwe - ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha.
hypothesis: Amazwe amaningi asezingeni eliphelele lwezilimi zesiNgisi, futhi eminye imizwa ungathola ulwazi oluncane - ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha.

source: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
reference: Cabanga, uma ungakwazi, umuntu wase-Muncunia, e-Boston, e-Jamaica kanye nowase-Sydney behlezi etafuleni bedla idina esitolo sokudlela sase-Toronto.
hypothesis: Imagine, uma ungakwazi, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican, neSydneysider ehlezi etafileni ekudleni kwaseToronto.

source: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
reference: Bebezixoxela bebodwa ngezindaba ezivela emadolobheni akubo, baxoxelwa ngolimi lwesigodi sakubo kanye nangendlela yokukhuluma yangakubo.
hypothesis: Bayazithoba ngezindaba zezindawo zabo zokholo, zithiwa ngezindlela zabo eziyingqayizivele nezingqungqutheleni zabo zendawo.

source: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
reference: Ukuthenga ukudla ezitolo ezinkulu ngokuvamile kuyindlela engabizi kunazo zonke yokondleka. Ngaphandle kwamathuba okupheka, ongakukhetha nokho kulinganiselwe ekudleni okulungele udliwa.
hypothesis: Ukudla okuthengwa emakethe yezitolo ngokuvamile indlela ephansi kunazo zonke yokudla. Ngaphandle kwamathuba okupheka, izinketho zivame ukukhishwa kudla olulungisiwe.

source: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
reference: Izitolo ezinkulu ngokwandayo zithola ingxenye ehlukahlukene kakhulu yokudla okulungele ukudliwa. Ezinye zinikeza ngisho nangohhavini we-microwave noma enye indlela yokufudumeza ukudla.
hypothesis: Imisebenzi yokudla okuklanywe ngaphambi kokuthenga kuyanda kakhulu emakethezweni. Abanye bafaka umshini wokushisa noma ezinye izindlela zokushisa ukudla.

source: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
reference: Kwamanye amazwe noma izinhlobo zezitolo kunendawo yokudlela eyodwa, ngokuvamile engekho emthethweni enamanani akahle.
hypothesis: Emazweni athile noma izitolo ezithile, kunezindawo zokudlela ezisezindaweni, ngokuvamile ezithile okungabizi.

source: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
reference: Enza futhi uphathe amakhophi epholisi yakho kanye neminingwane yenkampani yakho yomshwalensi.
hypothesis: Yenza futhi ugcine izinkomba zomthetho wakho nezokuxhumana nomshini wakho nawe.

source: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
reference: Badinga ukuveza ikheli le-imeyili lomuntu onikeza ngomshwalense kanye nezinombolo zocingo zakwamanye amazwe zesiluleko/ukunikeza imvume nokufaka izicelo.
hypothesis: Ukufaneleka kubalulekile ukuze babonise i-imeyili ye-insurer nezinombolo zomhlaba jikelele zefoni ukuze kutholakale iseluleko/ukuvunywa nokwenza amakhredithi.

source: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
reference: Gcina enye ikhophi emthwalweni wakho naku-inthanethi (zithumelele yona ku-imeyili, noma uligcinwe ku-"cloud").
hypothesis: Yenza i-copha eyengeziwe kwi-luggage yakho kanye online (i-e-mail kuwe nge-attachment, noma igcinwe ku-"i-cloud").

source: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
reference: Uma usohambweni uhamba ne-laptop noma uthebhulethi, faka ikhophi yayo kuyo noma kuyidiski (iyatholakala ngisho noma ungenayo i-inthanethi).
hypothesis: Ukuba uhambo ne laptop okanye tablet, gcinani ikhophi kwi memory okanye disc (ukufikelela ngaphandle kwe-intanethi).

source: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
reference: Futhi nikeza amakhophi epolisi/isivumelwano kohambisana nabo kanye nezihlobo noma abangane emuva ekhaya abafuna ukusiza.
hypothesis: Bonisa futhi amacwecwe enkampani/uxhumano kubazali nabangane abasekhaya abafuna ukusiza.

source: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
reference: Izinyamazane ezinkulu zaseMelika (ngezinye izikhathi ezibizwa ngama-elk) azithandi udlame, kodwa zizozivikela lapho zibona ingozi.
hypothesis: Imbuzi (eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-Elk) ayinamuntu wokuziphatha obuyela emuva, kodwa azonwabisa ukuzivikela uma zibona ukuthi zikude nezingozi.

source: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
reference: Uma abantu bangaboni inyamazane enkulu yaseMelika njengeyingozi, bangasondela kakhulu futhi bazifake engozini.
hypothesis: Ukuba abantu ababonayo i-moose abayibonayo njengento enokubangela ukukhathazeka, bangaba nethuba lokuyifinyelela kufuphi futhi bangenelele emngceleni wabo.

source: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
reference: Phuza iziphuzo ezidakayo ngokulinganisela. Iziphuzo ezidakayo zithinta wonke umuntu ngokuhlukile, futhi ukwazi umkhawulo wakho kubaluleke kakhulu.
hypothesis: Yidla iziphuzo eziyinkimbinkimbi ngokulinganayo. Isiphuzo siyohlupha wonke umuntu ngendlela eyahlukene, futhi ukwazi umkhawulo wakho kubalulekile.

source: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
reference: Izinto ezithinta impilo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yokuphuza ngokweqisa zingahlanganisa ukulimala kwesibindi kanye nobumpumputhe nokufa. Ingozi engaba khona iyakhula lapho umuntu ephuza utshwala obungenziwanga ngokomthetho.
hypothesis: Imiphumela engapheli engaba khona yezempilo evela ekudleni okuningi kungenzeka ibe yimiphumela emibi yezinhlamvu, kanye ne-blindness nasekufeni. Inzuzo engaba khona yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo yenzuzo

source: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
reference: Izipiliti ezingekho emthethweni zinezinto ezingacwengekanga ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa i-methanol, engabangela ubumpumputhe noma ukufa ngisho noma kuthathwe encane.
hypothesis: Umkhuhlane ongaphumeleli ungabandakanywa nemicimbi emibi eyahlukene, kubandakanya i-methanol, engabangela ukungaboni noma ukufa ngisho nangezinye izindawo ezincane.

source: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
reference: Izibuko zamehlo zingabiza kancane kwelinye izwe, ikakhulukazi emazweni aholela imali encane lapho izindleko zokusebenza ziphansi.
hypothesis: Imibhede yezingane ingaba engabizi kwelinye izwe, ikakhulukazi emazweni aphansi emnothweni lapho izindleko zomsebenzi zingaphansi.

source: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
reference: Cabangela ukuhlola amehlo ekhaya, ikakhulukazi uma umshwalense ukhokhelela izindleko, kanye noletha amaphepha aloba imithi ukuba agcinwe kwenye indawo.
hypothesis: Qaphela ukuthi uthole ukuhlolwa kwamehlo ekhaya, ikakhulukazi uma isiqinisekiso siqinisekile, futhi uthathe isilinganiso esifanayo ukuze ifayelwe kwenye indawo.

source: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
reference: Amafulemu aseqophelweni eliphezulu wamagama abizayo atholakala kulezi zindawo angaba nezinkinga ezimbili; amanye kungaba omgunyathi, futhi angempela avela kwamanye amazwe angabiza kakhulu kunasekhaya.
hypothesis: Imibuzo emibili ingaba yenzekayo kwiindawo eziya kwi-brand name eziphezulu; abanye bangaba yiziphawu zokubuyisela, kwaye abanye abafumanekayo abavela kwamanye amazwe bangaba bexabiso eliphakeme kunokuba baphiwe ekhaya.

source: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
reference: Ikhofi lingomunye wemikhiqizo yomhlaba okuhwetshwa ngawo kakhulu, futhi cishe ungathola izinhlobo eziningi endaweni yangakini.
hypothesis: Ukotini yenye yezinto ezithengiswa kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi ungathola izinhlobo eziningi kwindawo yakho.

source: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
reference: Nokho, ziningi izindlela ezihlukile zokuphuza ikofi emhlabeni jikelele okufanele zizanywe.
hypothesis: Kepha kunjalo, kukhona izindlela eziningi zokuphuza ikhofi emhlabeni wonke ezithakazelisayo okufanele zivivinywe.

source: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
reference: I-canyoning (noma: canyoneering) kumayelana nokuya ezansi kwezigodi ezijulile, okungezeka ukuthi zomile noma zigcwele amanzi.
hypothesis: Ukucanyonza (noma: ukuhamba nge-canyon) kuyinto mayelana nokuhamba ezingxenyeni eziphantsi ze-canyon, okungaba yize noma igcwele amanzi.

source: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
reference: Ukuhamba ezindongeni ezinkulu ezibangelwe umfula kuhlanganisa izici zokubhukuda, ukugibela kanye nokweqa-- kodwa kudinga ukuziqeqesha okuncane kakhulu noma isimo somziba ukuze uqale (uma kuqhathaniswa nokugibela amadwala amakhulu, i-scuba diving noma i-alpine skiing, ngokwesibonelo).
hypothesis: Ukucanyonza kuhlanganisa izici zokubhukuda, ukukhwela, nokuphakama-- kodwa kudinga okuningi ukuze uqale (ngokungafani nokukhwela intaba, ukubhukuda okweqile, noma ukushayisana nentaba, isibonelo).

source: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
reference: Ukuhamba ezintabeni umsebenzi wangaphandle ohlanganisa ukuhamba ezindaweni ezingokwemvelo, kaningi emizileni yokuhamba.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba ngebhayisikili yindlela yomsebenzi ongaphandle eyenziwa ngabantu abahamba emvelweni, ngokuyinhloko emigwaqweni yezintaba.

source: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
reference: Ukuhamba emini kuhlanganisa amabanga angaphansi kwemayela kuze kube semabangeni angahlanganiswa ngosuku olulodwa.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba phakathi kwemini kuhilela imigwaqo engaphansi kwemayile kuya kwemigwaqo emide kakhulu engatholakala ngosuku olulodwa.

source: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
reference: Ukuhamba emini emzileni olula kudinga ukuzilungiselela okuncane, futhi noma imuphi umuntu ophile kahle ngokomzimba angakujabulela.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba usuku endaweni elula kudinga amalungiselelo amancane, futhi umuntu onempilo ephakathi angawuthokozela.

source: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
reference: Imindeni enezingane ezincane ingadinga ukulingiselela okwengeziwe, kodwa usuku ngaphandle lungenzeka kalula ngisho nangabantwana abancane kanye nezingane ezingakayi esikoleni.
hypothesis: Imindeni enabantwana abancane bangadinga ukulungiselela okuningi, kodwa usuku olusenyakatho luyakwazi ukwenziwa kahle nabantwana abancane nabantwana abasebancane.

source: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
reference: Emazweni wonke, kunezinhlangano zokuvakasha ezisebenzayo ezicishe zibe ngu-200. Eziningi zazo zizimele.
hypothesis: Emhlabeni jikelele, kukhona cishe amakhasimende angu-200 ahamba phambili. Iningi labo lisebenza ngokuzimela.

source: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
reference: I-Go Running Tours eyalandela i-Global Running Tours iqondisa izinkampani zezingosi emazwekazini amane.
hypothesis: Umkhuphi we-Global Running Tours, uGo Running Tours, unxibelelana amakhasimende amaningi asezingeni elifanele emhlabeni jikelele emhlabeni jikelele.
