source: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
reference: Nemvelaphi yayo Ohambweni Lokugijima lwase-Barcelona Ukugijima kwase-Barcelona ne-Copenhagen, yajoyinwa ngokushesha uHambo Lokugijima lwase-Prague olunesikhungo e-Prague kanye nezinye.
hypothesis: Ngemvelaphi e Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona ne Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, yaba yinyathelo elikhawulezayo elalandelwa yi Running Tours Prague esekelwe ePrague nabanye.

source: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
reference: Kunezinto eziningi okumelwe uzicabangele ngaphambi nalapho uthatha uhambo oluya kwenye indawo.
hypothesis: Kukhona izinto eziningi okufanele uthathele ingqalelo ngaphambi nangokuthatha uhambo kwelinye indawo.

source: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
reference: Uma uthatha uhambo, lindela izinto ukuba zingafani “nasekhaya”. Imikhuba, imithetho, ukudla, ukuminyana kwezimoto, izimiso, ulimi njalonjalo kuzohluka ngandlelathile nalapho uhlala khona.
hypothesis: Ukuthi uhambo, linda izinto zingafani neze lapho uvela khona. Imigomo, imithetho, ukudla, traffic, yokuhlala, amazinga, ulimi nokunye kuzokwehlukana kakhulu kusukela lapho uvela khona.

source: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
reference: Lokhu okuthile okumelwe uhlale ukukhumbula, ukugwema ukudumazeka ngisho nokungathandi izindlela zendawo zokwenza izinto.
hypothesis: Le nto udinga ukuwukhumbula njalo, ukuze uphephe ukudideka noma mhlawumbe ukudideka ngezindlela zendawo zokwenza izinto.

source: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
reference: Izinhlangano zokuhamba bezilokhu zikhona kusukela ngekhulu le-19. Umenzeli wokuhamba ngokuvamile ukhetho oluhle lohambo oludlulela ngaphezu kolwazi lwesihambi lwangaphambili lwendalo, isiko, ulimi noma amazwe aholela imali ephansi.
hypothesis: Amagajethi okuhamba aye evela ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-19. Isikhungo sokuhamba ngokuvamile siyindlela enhle yokuhamba lapho kudlula khona umuntu ngaphandle kwemvelo, isiko, ulimi, noma amazwe aphansi.

source: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
reference: Nakuba ezinye izinkampani zizimisele ukwenza ukubhukha okuningi okuvamile, izinkampani eziningi zingochwepheshe ohlotshweni oluthize lohambo, ubukhulu bamanani noma izindawo.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma izinkampani eziningi ziyavuma ukuthatha izinkontileka ezivamile, abanye abahlinzeki bayakhethe izindawo ezithile zokuhamba, amanani okuhambisa noma izindawo.

source: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
reference: Kungaba lula ukusebenzisa ummeli ovame ukubhukha uhambo olufana nolwakho.
hypothesis: Kungcono ukusebenzisa ummeli owenza amathrekhi afana neyakho ngokuvamile.

source: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
reference: Buka ukuthi inkampani ikhangisa ngaluphi uhambo, kungaba kuyiwebhusayithi noma efasiteleni lesitolo.
hypothesis: Bonisa okuthile mayelana ne-trips ethu ethi agent iyakukhuthaza, noma kwiwebhusayithi noma e-shop window.

source: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
reference: Uma ufuna ukubona umhlaba ngendlela engabizi, ngoba kunesidingo, indlela yokuphila noma inselele, kunezinye izindlela zokwenza lokho.
hypothesis: Uma ufuna ukubona umhlaba ngentengo ephantsi, ngenxa yezidingo, isitayela noma umzamo, kukhona izindlela zokwenza lokho.

source: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
reference: Ngokuyisisekelo, baye bawela ezigabeni ezimbili: okungenzeka ukusebenza phakathi nohambo noma ukuzama ukulinganisela izindleko zakho. Lesi sihloko sigxile kulokho okwenzeka ekugcineni.
hypothesis: Ngokuyisisekelo, zonke zingxenye zingahlukaniswa zibe zimbili: Noma wenze umsebenzi ngenkathi uzokuhambela noma uzame ukunciphisa izindleko. Lesi sihloko sihlose ukuthi siphumelele esinye salezi zimo.

source: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.
reference: Kulabo abazimisele ukudela ukunethezeka, isikhathi kanye nokubikezeleka ukunciphisaizindleko baze bacishe bengakhokhi lutho babona izindawo ezikhokhelwa imali encane.
hypothesis: Kuba abo bayavuma ukusikhupha isisweli, isikhathi, kanye nokwazi ukuze baphathe imali phansi kakhulu, bona i-Minimum Budget Travel.

source: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.
reference: Iseluleko sicabangela ukuthi izihambi azebi, azingeni ezindaweni ngaphandle kwemvume, azihwebi ngokungemthetho, azincengi, noma ziqole abantu ngenye indlela ukuze zizizuzise.
hypothesis: Ukunyuswa kwezokuxhumana kucacisa ukuthi abahambi abanakho ukweba, ukungenelela, ukuthatha inxaxheba emakethe engalunganga, ukucela, noma ukusebenzisa abanye ngendlela engahleliwe ukuze bazuze.

source: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.
reference: Indawo yokuhlola abavela kwamanye amazwe ngokuvamile iyindawo yokuma yokuqala lapho wehla endizeni, emkhumbini, noma kwenye inqola.
hypothesis: Ukungena kwendawo yokuhlola ukungena kwabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe kuyinto evamile lapho usuka emkhunjini, isikebhe, noma ezinye izimoto.

source: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.
reference: Kwezinye izitimela eziya emazweni angomakhelwane ukuhlolwa kwenziwa esitimeleni esihambayo futhi kumelwe uphathe nomazisi ongokomthetho uma ugibela esinye salezo zitimela.
hypothesis: Emazweni ethile ukuhlolwa kwemigwaqo yezwekazi lwezitimela kwenziwa esitimeleni esisebenza futhi kufanele ube nesiqinisekiso esivumelekile uma ungena esitimeleni esinjalo.

source: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.
reference: Kulezi zitimela okulalwa kuzo, iphasiphothi ingathathwa ukhondakta ukwenzela ukuthi ungaphazamiseki uma sewulele.
hypothesis: Ngobusuku, amaphasipoti angahlanganiswa yisigqila ukuze ungaziphazamisele ukulala.

source: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.
reference: Ukubhalisa imfuneko eyengeziwe enqubweni ye-visa. Kwamanye amazwe, kumelwe ubhalise ukuba khona kwakho nekheli lalapho uhlala khona neziphathimandla zendawo.
hypothesis: Ukudalwa kuyadingeka okwengeziwe kwinqubo yovisa. Kwamanye amazwe, kumele ubhalisele ukuthi ungaphakathi kanye nendawo okuyo nomphakathi wasekhaya.

source: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.
reference: Lokhu kungadinga ukugcwalisa ifomu namaphoyisa endawo noma ukuvakashela ihhovisi labaphuma kwamanye amazwe.
hypothesis: Lezi kungenzeka kudinga ukuthi ugcwalise ifomu eliseduze neziphathimandla zomphakathi noma uvakashele amahhovisi okungenzeka.

source: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).
reference: Emazweni amaningi anomthetho onjalo, amahhotela wasendaweni yiwona azobhalisa (qinisekisa ukuthi uyabuza).
hypothesis: Emazweni amaningi anawo umthetho, amahhotela asekhaya azokwenza ukurejista (qinisekisa ukubuza).

source: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.
reference: Kwezinye izimo, yilabo kuphela abahlala ngaphandle kwezindlu zezivakashi okudingeka ukuthi babhalise. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kwenza umthetho uthi ukuqina, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi usheshe wazi.
hypothesis: Kwezinye izimo, kuphela labo abahlala ngaphandle kwemikhandlu yezivakashi abadinga ukubhaliswa. Nokho, lokhu kwenza umthetho uncwadi kakhulu, ngakho khumbula ngaphambili.

source: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.
reference: Ezokwakha zigxile ekuklameni nasekwakheni izakhiwo. Ukuklanywa nokwakheka kwendawo ngokuvamile kudonsa izivakashi ngokwakho.
hypothesis: Ukubumba kuyathintana nomklamo nokwakhiwa kwamakhaya. Ukwakhiwa kwendawo ethile ngokuvamile yindawo yokubukwa yezivakashi.

source: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.
reference: Izakhiwo eziningi zinhle kakhulu ukuzibuka futhi nokubuka indawo usesakhiweni eside noma efasiteleni elibekwe ngobuhlakani kungaba into enhle ukuyibuka.
hypothesis: Amabhuloho amaningi amahle kakhulu ukubukwa, futhi umbono esakhiweni esikhulu noma efasiteleni elilungile elitholakala uyohlale ube yisimangaliso.

source: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.
reference: Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu buhlangana kakhudlwana nezinye izinkundla kuhlanganise nokuhlelwa kwamadolobha, ubunjiniyela bokuklama izakhiwo zomphakathi, ubuciko bokuhlobisa, ukuhlobisa ingaphakathi lezindlu kanye nokuhlobisa amagceke.
hypothesis: Umbutho wokwakha udlulela kakhulu eminye imikhakha, kuhlanganise nolwazi lomzi, ubunjiniyela bomphakathi, imidwebo yezinto eziphathekayo, umklamo wangaphakathi, nomklamo wokubuyisela.

source: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.
reference: Ngendlela imizi yomdabu yaseMelika ikude ngayo, angeke ukwazi ukuthola okwenzekayo ebusuku ngaphandle kokuya e-Albuquerque noma eSanta Fe.
hypothesis: Ngokuthi iningi lezindawo zezindlu zingekho eduze, awunakho ukuthola inani elikhulu lokuhlala ebusuku ngaphandle kokuhamba e-Albuquerque noma eSanta Fe.

source: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).
reference: Noma kunjalo, cishe zonke izindawo zokugembula ezibhalwe phezulu zidayisa iziphuzo, kanti eziningana kuzo zihlinzeka ezokuzijabulisa zohlobo oluthile (ngokuvamile ezinkulu kuzo ezakhelene ne-Albuquerque kanye ne-Santa Fe).
hypothesis: Kodwa, cishe wonke amakhasino ahlelwe ngenhla ahlinzeka iziphuzo, futhi abaningi babo bafaka umculo obizwa ngokuthi "brand" (ngokuyinhloko abakhiwe ngokuyinhloko e-Albuquerque naseSanta Fe).

source: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.
reference: Qaphela: izindawo zokuthiba ukoma zedolobha ezincanezalapha azihlali ziyizindawo ezilungele zivakashi ezivela ngaphandle kwesifundazwe ukuthi zingazipholela kuzo.
hypothesis: Qaphela: amabhikawu amancane asezi asizohlala zihleli endaweni yabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe.

source: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.
reference: Esinye isizathu ukuthi, i-New Mexico esenyakatho inezinkinga ezinkulu ngabashayeli abadakiwe, futhi iningi labashayeli abadakiwe litholakala eduze nezinkantini zamadolobhana.
hypothesis: Ngokwesinye isizathu, iNew Mexico enyakatho inezinkinga eziphawulekayo zokushaywa ibe yizithuthi zine, kanye nezinga labo lapho kushaywa ibe yizithuthi zine eliphakathi kwemizi emincane.

source: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.
reference: Imifanekiso noma imibhalo engafuneki ibizwa nge-graffiti.
hypothesis: Ukubhala okungafunekiyo noma ukudweba okungafunekiyo kuyaziwa nge-graffiti.

source: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.
reference: Nakuba kungesona isimangaliso sanamuhla, abantu abaningi cishe bakuhlobanisa nentsha ecekela phansi izakhiwo zomphakathi nezabantu ngopende ofuthwayo.
hypothesis: Kuyilapho kude kakhulu kwezobuciko zanamuhla, abantu abaningi bavame ukuhlobanisa nalo ngezinsolo zokuziphatha okungahambisani nezenhlalakahle zomphakathi nezangasese ngokudweba izindawo nge-spray paint.

source: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
reference: Nokho, kulezi zinsuku kunezingcweti ze-graffiti ezizimele, izenzakalo ze-graffiti kanye nezindonga "ezingokomthetho". Imidwebo ye-graffiti kulomongo kaningi ifana nomsebenzi wobuciko kunemidwebo engekho emthethweni.
hypothesis: Kodwa manje kukhona abaculi be-graffiti abasebenza, izenzakalo ze-graffiti kanye ne-"legal" emizaneni. Imidwebo ye-graffiti kulezi zindawo ivame ukubonakala njengezobuciko kunokuba zibe zezomthetho.

source: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.
reference: Ukuphonsa i-boomerang ikhono elithandwayo lelo izivakashi eziningi ezifuna ukuba nalo.
hypothesis: Ukudubula i-boomerang kuyaziwa kakhulu futhi abaningi bezivakashi bafuna ukuyithola.

source: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.
reference: Uma ufuna ukufunda ukuphonsa ibhumerangi ebuyela esandleni sakho, qinisekisa ukuthi unebhumerangi efanelekela ukubuya.
hypothesis: Uma ufuna ukufunda ukudubula i-boomerang ebuyela esandleni sakho, qiniseka ukuthi une-boomerang efanelekile yokubuyela.

source: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy
reference: Ama-boomerang amaningi atholakala e-Australia empeleni akuwona abuyayo. Kungcono kwabasaqala ukuthi bangazami ukuphonsa emoyeni
hypothesis: Iningi le-boomerangs etholakala e-Australia ayikho ebuyile. Kungcono ukuba abaqalayo bangazama ukudubula emoyeni.

source: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
reference: ISidlo seHangi siphekelwa emgodini oshisayo.
hypothesis: Ukugcina isidlo esinjenge-Hangi kwenziwa esigodini esishisayo emhlabeni.

source: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
reference: Umgodi ushiswa ngamatshe ashisayo avela emlilweni, noma kwezinye izindawo ukushisa okuvela ngaphansi komhlaba kwenze izingxenye zenhlabathi zishise ngokwemvelo.
hypothesis: Umkhumbi ungenziwa zibhakde ngezitsha ezishisayo evela emlilweni, noma ezinye izindawo, ukushisa kwe-geothermal kwenza izindawo zibe zishisayo ngokwemvelo.

source: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
reference: I-hangi kaningi isetshenziselwa ukupheka ukudla kwakusihla okuthosiwe okungokwesiko.
hypothesis: Le hangi isetshenziswa kaningi ukuze kudle isidlo sangokwezifiso se- roast style.

source: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
reference: Izindawo ezimbalwa e-Rotorua zinikela ngokudla okuphekwe ngokushisa komhlaba, kanti okunye ukudla okunjalo kuyenziwa e-Christchurch, e-Wellington nakwezinye izindawo.
hypothesis: Amaphawu amaningi eRotorua anikeza i-geothermal hangi, kanti amanye hangi angafinyelelwa eChristchurch, eWellington nakwezinye izindawo.

source: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).
reference: IMetroRail inezigaba ezimbili zezitimela zabagibeli eKapa kanye nasezindaweni ezizungezile: iMetroPlus (ebuye ibizwe ngokuthi Isigaba Esiphezulu) kanye neMetro (ebizwa ngeSigaba Sesithathu).
hypothesis: UMetroRail unemigangatho emibili kwiitrains zokuhamba kwabantu abahamba ngeenqwelo zaselwandle eCape Town: iMetroPlus (ebizwa nangokuthi iClass First) neMetro (ebizwa nangokuthi iClass Third).

source: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.
reference: IMetroPlus inethezeke kakhudlwana futhi ayigcwali abantu kodwa ibiza kakhudlwana, nakuba ishibhe kunamathikithi esitimela avamile eYurophu.
hypothesis: UMetroPlus ulula kakhulu futhi ungaphakathi kwezindawo eziningi, kodwa kuncane kancane kunezitiketi zomgwaqo eziqhelekileyo eYurophu.

source: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.
reference: Zonke izitimela ziba nakho kokubili i-MetroPlus kanye nezinqola ze-Metro; izinqola ze-MetroPlus zihlale njalo zisekugcineni kwesitimela eduze kweDolobha lase-Kappa.
hypothesis: Zonke oololiwe zinezikhungo zeMetroPlus neMetro; iikhungo zeMetroPlus zihlala zisezantsi kwesiphatho seololiwe esiseduze neCape Town.

source: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.
reference: Ukunakekela abanye – Ungalokothi ususe amehlo ezikhwameni zakho, ikakhulukazi lapho weqa imingcwele yamanye amazwe.
hypothesis: Ukuthwala kwabanye - Ungazibonakali ngezandla zakho, ikakhulukazi uma usukela imiphakathi yamazwe omhlaba.

source: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.
reference: Ungazithola usetshenziswa njengomuntu othwala izidakamizwa ngaphandle kolwazi lwakho, okuzokufaka enkingeni enkulu.
hypothesis: Ungase uzitholele ukuthi usetshenziswa njengomthwalo wezidakamizwa ngaphandle kokwazi, okuzokwenza ube nezinselelo ezinkulu.

source: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.
reference: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuma eheleni, njengoba izinja ezithungatha izidakamizwa zingasetshenziswa nganoma isiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kwesaziso.
hypothesis: Lozakuzo kuhlanganisa ukulinda emgqeni, njengoba izinja zokuhlola izidakamizwa zingase zisetshenziswe nanoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kwesaziso.

source: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.
reference: Amanye amazwe anezindlela zokujezisa ezinonya kakhulu ngisho nakubantu abaqalayo ukuphula umthetho; lezi zingahlanganisa izigwebo zasejele zeminyaka engaphezu kuka-10 noma ukufa.
hypothesis: Amazwe amaningi anezinkantolo eziphakeme kakhulu, ngisho nasezinzuzweni zokuqala; lawa zingase zibandakanye iminyaka engaphezu kwemashumi ayisishiyagalombili emnyuziyamu noma ukufa.

source: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.
reference: Izikhwama ezinganakwanga zitshontshwa kalula futhi zingadonsa ukunaka kweziphathimandla eziqaphele ukusongelwa ngamabhomu.
hypothesis: Ukukhomba amabhokisi angenalutho kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi kuyoba yisibonelo sokubulala futhi singabangela ukunakekelwa kwamaphoyisa abazimisele ngokudlulisela amathuba okuthiwa amabhomu.

source: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.
reference: Ekhaya, ngenxa yalokhu kuvezwa njalo kwamagciwane endawo, amathuba asephezulu kakhulu okuthi kungenzeka nawe usugomekile kuwo.
hypothesis: Emzini, ngenxa yalezi zingane zomdabu, amathuba okuthi usuke waba nemithi kubo asezingeni eliphakeme.

source: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.
reference: Kodwa kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba, lapho amagciwane e-fauna emasha kuwe, maningi amathuba okuthi ube nenkinga.
hypothesis: Kodwa kwamanye amazwe, lapho i-bacteriological fauna entsha kakhulu kuwe, ungaba nethuba eliphakeme lokubhekana nezinkinga.

source: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.
reference: Futhi, ezindaweni ezifudumele amabhakithiliya kokubili akhula ngokushesha kakhudwlana futhi aphila isikhathi eside kakhudlwana ngaphandle komzimba.
hypothesis: Kunene, emazingeni ashisayo amabhaktheriya aphinde aphumelele ngokushesha futhi aphile isikhathi eside ngaphandle komzimba.

source: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.
reference: Ngakho izishayo zaseDelhi Belly, i-Pharaoh's Curse, iMontezuma's Revenge, kanye nabangane babo abaningi.
hypothesis: Ngakho-ke izifo zeDelhi Belly, iPharaoh's Curse, iMontezuma's Revenge, nabanye abaningi.

source: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.
reference: Njengezinkinga zokuphefumula ezindaweni ezinesimo sezulu ezibandayo, izinkinga zesisu ezindaweni ezinesimo sezulu esishisayo zivamile futhi ezimweni eziningi ziyacika ngokukhethekile kodwa aziyona ingozi empeleni.
hypothesis: Kanye nezinkinga zomzimba ezingaphakathi ezindaweni eziqanda, nezinkinga zomzimba ezingaphakathi ezindaweni ezishisayo ziyafana kakhulu futhi zivame kakhulu, futhi zingaba zingabazeki kodwa zingabazeki.

source: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.
reference: Uma uthatha uhambo oluya ezweni elisathuthuka okokuqala – noma engxenyeni entsha yomhlaba – ungadeleli ukushaqeka ngenxa yesiko okungaba khona.
hypothesis: Ukuba uhambo kwilizwe eliphuhlisa okokuqala – okanye kwiphondo elitsha – musa ukuqaphela amathuba okubonakala kwezakhiwo zobuqu.

source: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.
reference: Izihambi eziningi ezizinzile, ezinamandla zikhungathekiswe ubusha bohambo lomhlabo oluthuthukayo, lapho ukushintsha okuncane okuningi kwesiko kungahlangana ngokushesha.
hypothesis: Inani lamalungu abanekhono okuhamba abasebenza kahle baye baphazanyiswa yinkimbinkimbi yezwe elisha lokuhamba, lapho izinguquko ezincane zezakhiwo zesintu zingahle zenzakale ngokushesha.

source: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.
reference: Ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zakho zokuqala, cabangela ikuchitha imali eningi ezindleleni zaseNtshonalanga zokwenza izinto kanye namahhotela ezinga eliphezulu, ukudla, kanye nezinkonzo ukukusiza ujwayele.
hypothesis: Ngokukhethekile ngezinsuku zakho zokuqala, cabanga ukuhambisa kakhulu emahhotela wesilisa, ukudla, nezinsizakalo zesifazane ukuze usize ukuhlanganiswa.

source: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.
reference: Ungalali kumatilasi noma endwangwini entofontofo phansi ezindaweni ongazi kuzo izilwane zendawo.
hypothesis: Ungahlali phansi ematsheni nasezindaweni eziphakathi kwabantu abangaziwa.

source: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.
reference: Uma uzoya ukuyokhempa ngaphandle, woza ne-camp cot noma ne-hammock ukuze uzivikele ezinyokeni, ofezela nokunye okucishe kufane.
hypothesis: Uma uya emtholampilo, khumbula ukuthi uthathe i-camp cot noma i-hammock ukuze uphephe amanundu, amasele neziqhamo zabo.

source: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
reference: Gcwalisa ikhaya lakho ngekhofi elinothile ekuseni kanye netiye le-chamomile elenza uphumule ebusuku.
hypothesis: Yenza indlu yakho ifunwe ngekhofi elinobunzima ekuseni, neeteyamile ebusuku.

source: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.
reference: Uma uthatha iholide usekhaya lakho, unesikhathi sokuzijabulisa nesokuthatha imizuzu embalwa yokwenza okuthile okubalulekile.
hypothesis: Ukuba uhlala ekhaya, unalo ixesha lokuzenza umntu wakho kwaye wenze okunye okukhethekileyo.

source: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:
reference: Uma uzizwa ufisa ukwenza izigigaba, thatha ithuba lokwenza ijusi noma uhlanganise izithelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kube yisiphuzo:
hypothesis: Uma uzizwa unganele, khona-ke uthathe ithuba lokushaywa noma ukuqubuzana amasamphuleni.

source: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.
reference: mhlawumbe uzothola isiphuzo esilula ongasenza sokudla kwasekuseni uma ubuyela esimisweni sakho sansuku zonke.
hypothesis: Ngabe ungathola ukudla okumnandi okumele wenze ekuseni uma ubuyele emsebenzini wakho?

source: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.
reference: Uma uhlala edolobheni elinesiko lokuphuza elihlukile, yana ezinkantinini noma izindlini zokuphuzela emiphakathini ongavamisanga ukuya kuyo.
hypothesis: Uma uhlala emzini onobudlelwano obuhlukahlukene beziphuzo, yiza emabha noma emaphepheni emazweni ongazaziyo.

source: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
reference: Kulabo abangajwayele amagama asetshenziswa kwezokwelapha, amagama athi ukuthelelana kanye nokuthathelana anezinzazelo ezikhukile.
hypothesis: Kubantu abangazange bayazi izwi lezokwelapha, amagama okuthiwa "infectious" ne "contagious" anezincazelo ezahlukene.

source: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.
reference: Isifo esithelelanayo sibangelwa amabhakithiliya adala izifo, njengegciwane, ibhakithiliya, isikhunta noma ezinye izilwane eziphila ngezinye.
hypothesis: Ukukhathazeka kwesifo esingcolileyo yisifo esenziwa yizifo, ezifana neentsholongwane, iibhaktheriya, iifungi okanye abanye abathintekayo.

source: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
reference: Isifo esithathelanwayo isifo esidluliseka kalula ngokuba seduze nomuntu onalesosifo.
hypothesis: Ukukhathazeka kwezempilo kuyinto yezempilo engathintwa kalula ngokuba khona komuntu otholakala.

source: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.
reference: Ohulumeni abaningi bafuna izivakashi ezingenayo, noma abahlali abahambayo, emazweni abo ukuba bagonyelwe izinhlobonhlobo zezifo.
hypothesis: Amaningi amahhovisi asebenzela abavakashi abangenayo, noma abahlali abaphumayo emazweni abo, ukuba neziguli zokubulawa.

source: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
reference: Lezimfuneko kaningi zingaxhomeka emazweni isihambi esiwavakashele noma esihlele ukuwavakashela.
hypothesis: Lezi zidingo zingase zithintekile kuye ngokuthi izwe lapho umuntu eza kulo, noma lapho eza khona.

source: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.
reference: Enye yezindawo ezinamandla zeCharlotte, eNyakatho Carolina, ukuthi inezinto eziningi ezisezingeni eliphezulu imindeni engakhetha kuzo.
hypothesis: Enye yezinto eziphawulekayo mayelana noCharlotte, eNorth Carolina, wukuthi inezinto eziningi zezinga eliphakeme zezindlu zezindlu.

source: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
reference: Abahlali abavela kwezinye izindawo bavame ukukhuluma ngezinto ezifanele umndeni njengesizathu esiyinhloko sokuthuthela lapho, futhi izivakashi kaningi zithola kulula ukujabulela idolobha nezingane.
hypothesis: Abahlali abavela kwamanye amazwe bathi kakhulu ngenxa yobuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, kwaye abavakashi bafumana umzi lula ukuze ujabulele nabantwana emhlabeni.

source: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.
reference: Eminyakeni engu-20 edlule, inani lezinto eziphephile ezinganeni Phakathi Edolobheni lase-Charlotte lande kakhulu.
hypothesis: Kule minyaka engamashumi amabili edlule, inani lezinketho ezifanele izingane e-Uptown Charlotte lisekhulile kakhulu.

source: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.
reference: Amatekisi awavamisanga ukusetshenziswa imindeni eCharlotte, ngisho noma engaba usizo kwezinye izimo.
hypothesis: Imicabango yezindlu ayivamile eCharlotte, noma kunjalo, ingase isetshenziswe kwezinye izimo.

source: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
reference: Kunenhlawuliso engaphezulu yokuba nabagibeli abangaphezu kuka-2, ngakho lokhu ongakukhetha kungaba okubiza kakhulu kunalokho okudingekayo.
hypothesis: Kukhona imali eyengeziwe yokuhamba ngaphezu kwezimbili, ngakho-ke le khetho ingaba yinkulungwane ephakeme kunokudingekayo.

source: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.
reference: I-Antarctica indawo ebanda kunazo zonke eMhlabeni, futhi izungeze iSouth Pole.
hypothesis: Antarctica yindawo ebandayo kunazo zonke emhlabeni, futhi ivalelwe emaphethelweni eseningizimu.

source: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.
reference: Ukuvakasha kwezivakashi kuyabiza, kudinga ukuphila kahle ngokomzimba, kungenzeka kuphela ngehlobo ngoNovemba kuya kuFebhruwari, futhi kulinganiselwe kakhulu ngokomthetho eNhlonhlweni, Eziqhingini kanye nasoLwandle iRoss.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba kwezivakashi kubiza imali, kudinga ukukhuthazela kwemzimba, kungenziwa kuphela ebusika Nov-Feb, futhi kuyahlonishwa kakhulu ePeninsula, Islands neRoss Sea.

source: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.
reference: Izinkulungwane ezimbalwa zezisebenzi zihlala lapha ehlobo ezikhungweni ezingaba amadazini amane kaningi kulezo zindawo; inani elincane lihlala ebusika.
hypothesis: Abantu ababili emaweni bahlala lapha ehlobo, ezindaweni eziningi eziyisithupha, kakhulu kulawo; inani elincane lihlala ebusika.

source: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.
reference: Phakathi nezwe le-Antarctica inkangala engahlali muntu embozwe u-2-3 km weqhwa.
hypothesis: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau eziqongweni nge 2-3 km yoboya.

source: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
reference: Kwezinye izikhathi ukuvakasha kwasemoyeni kochwephesha kuya phakathi nezwe, ukugibela izintaba noma ukufinyelela kuyiPole, enesiqu esikhulu.
hypothesis: Ukubonakala kwezinye izindawo zezindiza zezindawo zezindawo zifika emaphandleni, ukuze zifinyelele entabeni noma zifike ePole, enezindawo ezinkulu.

source: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.
reference: ISouth Pole Traverse (noma iHighway) umzila ongama-1600 kma kusuka eMcMurdo Station oLwandle lweRosa kuyiPole.
hypothesis: Umgwaqo weSouth Pole Traverse (noma iHighway) ungumgwaqo we-1600 km esuka eMcMurdo Station esifundeni seRoss Sea kuya ePole.

source: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.
reference: Kuyiqhwa elihlangene eligcwele imisele ebekiswe ngamafulegi. Ungahamba kulo kuphela ngogandaganda abakhandelwe lokho, izinqola zokuhamba eqhweni ezinamafutha kanye nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswayo.
hypothesis: Kuyinto ushushu esonweni nge crevasses egcwele futhi okubonakalayo amagquma. Kungaba kuphela ehamba izitsha ezithile, eziqhumayo sleds nge fuel kanye nezinto ezidingekayo.

source: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
reference: Lezi azilula kakhulu ngakho umzila kumelwe uphambukele kude uzungeze iziNtaba zeTransantarctic ukungena enkangaleni.
hypothesis: Lezi asikho namanzi, ngakho-ke umzila kumele uhambe isikhathi eside ukuze udlule eTransantarctic Mountains ukuze afike esiphaleni.

source: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.
reference: Into eyimbangela evamile yezingozi ebusika imigwaqo eshelelayo, imigwaqo egandayiwe (izindawo zokuhamba) futhi ikakhulukazi izitebhisi.
hypothesis: Imvamisa yezinkinga eziyinkinga ebusika yizindlela eziyizinkulungwane, izindlu zokuhamba (izindlu zokuhamba) kanye ngezinye izinyathelo.

source: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.
reference: Ngokwesilinganiso, udinga izicathulo ezinesithende ezifanelekile. Izicathulo zasehlobo ngokuvamile ziyashelela eqhweni kanye nasesithwathweni, ngisho nezinye izicathulo zasebusika azifaneleki.
hypothesis: Ukubaluleka okuphansi, kudinga izicathulo ezinamagqabhukazi afanele. Izicathulo zesizini zivame ukuhamba kakhulu emanzini nasemthunzini, noma ezinye izicathulo zesizini zingaphumeleli.

source: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.
reference: Isifanekiso kumelwe sijule ngokwanele, u-5 mm (1/5 yintshi) noma ngaphezulu, futhi indwangu kumelwe ithambe ngokwanele emazingeni okushisa abandayo.
hypothesis: Inkangeleko yomkhiwane kufanele ibe namanqanaba amade, 5 mm (1/5 intshi) noma ngaphezulu, futhi izinto zifanele zibe zezithambile ezingxenyeni eziphansi.

source: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.
reference: Amanye amabhuzu anezinto ezicijile futhi kezinto ezicijile ezifakwayo zezimo ezishelelayo, ezifaneleke izicathulo namabhuzu, ezezithende noma izithende namasoli.
hypothesis: Amabutho athile anezicucu futhi kukhona izinto ezenziwe ngezicucu zokwenza izimo ezingavamile, ezifanele amabhuzu nezicucu eziningi, zokwenza amahlanza noma amahlanza nezicucu.

source: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
reference: Izithende kumelwe zibe ezansi futhi zibe banzi. Isihlabathi, inhlabathi enamatshana noma usawoti (i-calcium chloride) kuvame ukusakazeka ezindleleni noma emizileni ukuthuthukisa amandla okubamba.
hypothesis: Amagagasi kufanele ahlale aphansi futhi abanzi. Umgqomo, umgqumo noma usawoti (calcium chloride) ivame ukusabalalisa emigwaqweni noma emizileni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukunyakaza.

source: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.
reference: Izikhukhula zeqhwa aziyona into engavamile; izindawo ezehlelayo zingabamba iqhwa elanele nje, futhi elengeziwe lizokwehla njengesikhukhula seqhwa.
hypothesis: Ukukhuphuka amanxeba akuyona into engavamile; amagquma amade aqinisekiswa ukuthi angahlangabezana nje namanani amancane, futhi amavolumu angenawo amanzi aya phansi njengezinkomba.

source: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.
reference: Inkinga ukuthi iqhwa liyanamathela, ngakho-ke lidinga ukuthi ukuthintithwa ukuze lehle, kanti neqhwa elithile elehlayo lingabangela ukuthi lonke elinye lehle.
hypothesis: Inkinga kukuthi iqhwa linyibilikile, ngakho-ke kudinga okuthile ukuze udlule, futhi iqhwa elidlulayo lingaba yisenzakalo esiyigugu sokuthi okuningi kuhlale phansi.

source: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
reference: Kwezinye izikhathi isenzakalo sangempela esishukumisayo ilanga elifudumeza iqhwa, kwesinye isikhathi ukuwa kweqhwa elengeziwe, kwesinye isikhathi ezinye izenzakalo ezingokwemvelo, kaningi umuntu.
hypothesis: Ngamanye amaxesha umcimbi wokuqala wokubhobhoza yisibane esibhakabhaka esibhakabhaka, ngamanye amaxesha amafu amaningi, ngamanye amaxesha imicimbi yemvelo eyengeziwe, ngamanye amaxesha abantu.

source: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
reference: Isivunguvungu insika yokucindezela komoya okungenamandla, emunyela umoya oseduze phakathi kanye naphezulu.
hypothesis: Umbane yisigxobo esincane esiphakathi kwezulu elinomswakama okuncane kakhulu, esibamba umoya ojulile ojongene nayo futhi esiphakamisa uphondo lwawo olusuka emhlabeni.

source: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
reference: Zingenza imimoya ephakeme (ngokuvamile amamayeli angu-100-200/ihora) futhi zingaphakamisa izinto ezisindayo emoyeni, zizithwale njengoba isivunguvungu sihamba.
hypothesis: Abazukulu bakhuphela amafu amakhulu (ngezinye izikhathi amamitha angu-100-200 ngehora), futhi bangakwazi ukukhuphula izinto ezinzima emoyeni, bawathwele njengoba umkhumbi uphuma.

source: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
reference: Ziqala njengamafanela ayehlayo emafwini wesiphepho, bese ziba “izivunguvungu” lapho zifika phansi.
hypothesis: Bayo njengamafu aqubuke emafwini, baba "izindunduma" lapho bethinta umhlaba.

source: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.
reference: Izinkampani ze-VPN Yomuntu Siqu (inethiweki yomuntu siqu ebonakala ingokoqobo) ziyindlela ekahle kakhulu yokugwema ukuhlola okungokwepolotiki kanye zihlungi zendawo ze-IP.
hypothesis: Abathengisi beVPN yomuntu (i-Virtual Private Network) yindlela enhle yokudlula kokubili ukucimeza kwezombusazwe kanye ne-IP-geofiltering yezohwebo.

source: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.
reference: Baphambili kuma proxies eweb ngenxa yezizathu eziningana: Benza umzila wonke wokuthengisa i-Inthanethi, hhayi i-http kuphela.
hypothesis: Bayakukhuphula kakhulu abaphathi be-web proxy ngenxa yezizathu eziningi: Baya kudlulisela zonke traffic ye-intanethi, hhayi kuphela http.

source: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.
reference: Bajwayele ukunikeza izinga eliphezulu bobungakho bokudlulisa futhi nezinga eliphezulu losizo. Bafihle ukwaziswa ngakho kunzima ukwazi ukuthi baphezu kwani.
hypothesis: Bayaninikele ukunikeza bandwidth ephakeme kanye nekhwalithi engcono. Bayekezwe futhi ngakho-ke kunzima ukubhekana nabo.

source: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
reference: Izinkampani zezezindaba kaningi ziqamba amanga ngenjongo yalokhu, zithi kungenxa "yokuvimbela ukuba imfihlo".
hypothesis: Amabhizinisi ezeMidlalo abavame ukuhlasela ngezinto zokuthi lokhu kuyenzeka ngenhloso "yokuvimbela ubudlova".

source: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.
reference: Empeleni, amakhodi wendawo awasebenzi nakancane ekukopeni okungekho emthethweni; ukukopa kwe-bit nge-bit kwediski kuzoyenza idlale kahle kunoma iyiphi idivayisi lapho idiski yangempela ingadlala khona.
hypothesis: Ngempela, amakhodi wesifunda awazenzanga noma yimuphi umehluko ekukopeni okungekho emthethweni; ikhophi ye-bit-for-bit ye-disk izokudlala kahle kunoma iyiphi idivayisi lapho i-original izokudlala khona.

source: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
reference: Injongo yangempela ukwenza lezo zinkampani zilawule kakhudlwana izimakethe zazo; konke kumayelana nokwenza inzuzo.
hypothesis: Inhloso eyiqiniso ukunika lezi zinkampani ukulawula okuningi emakethe yazo; konke kuhlobene nokuqhuba imali.

source: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
reference: Ngenxa yokuthi izingcingo zixhunywa nge-Inthanethi, akumelwe usebenzise ifoni yenkampani esendaweni ohlala kuyo noma oyivakashele.
hypothesis: Ngoba izicelo zivela nge-Internet, awudingi ukusebenzisa inkampani yefoni etholakala lapho uhlala khona noma lapho uya khona.

source: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.
reference: Futhi azikho izimfuneko ozitholayo ngenani emphakathini ohlala kuwo; ungathola ukuxhuma ngesethelithi ku-inthanethi eziNkukhwini zasendle, e-Alska bese ukhetha inani elibonisa ukuthi usekushiseni e-Arizona.
hypothesis: Kukhona futhi akukho mfuneko yokuthi uthole inombolo yesifunda esivela esifundeni esithile; ungathola ukuhlangabezana ne-intanethi ye-satellite emahlathini aseChicken, Alaska futhi ukhethe inombolo ethi ungaphila eArizona elangeni.

source: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
reference: Kaningi, kufanele uthenge inombolo esebenza emhlabeni jikelele ngokuhlukile evumela amafoni we-PSTN ukuba akushayele. Lapho inombolo isuka khona kwenza umehluko kubantu abakushayelayo.
hypothesis: Ngokuvamile, kufanele uthenge inombolo yomhlaba jikelele ngokwehlukana okuyenza izingcingo ze-PSTN zikutholele. Lapho inombolo ivela khona kubalulekile kubantu abakukhuluma.

source: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
reference: Ama-app wokuhumusha we-Real-time – izinhlelo ezikwazi ukuhumusha ngokuzenzakalelayo zonke izingxenye zombhalo kusuka olimini olulodwa kuya kolunye.
hypothesis: Real-time umbhalo uguqulelo apps – izicelo eziphumelela ukuze ngokuzenzekelayo uguqulela amasethingi wonke umbhalo esuka kulwimi olunye oluya elinye.

source: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
reference: Ezinye izinhlelo kulengxenye zingaphinde zihumushe imibhalo ezilimini ezihlukahlukene kanye nakolwezandla noma ezinye izinto emhlabeni wangempela lapho oyisebenzisayo ekhomba umakhalekhukhwini wesimanje kulezo zinto.
hypothesis: Eminye yalezi zicelo zingakwazi nokuguqulela amagama ezingulubezwe kanye nezinye izinto zomhlaba wokwenza izinto emhlabeni lapho umsebenzisi ephakamisa ifowuni yakhe kuyo.

source: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
reference: Izinhlelo zekhompyutha zokuhumusha zithuthuke kakhulu, futhi manje zinikeza ukuhumusha okucishe kunembe (futhi okungavamisile ukuba ubhedo ongachazeki), kodwa kudingeka ukunaka okuthile, njengoba zingenza okunganembile ngokuphelele.
hypothesis: Imiphumela yezilimi zokuguqulela ziye zandiswa kakhulu, futhi manje zivame ukunikeza okuningi noma okuningi okuhambisana nezilimi (futhi okungaphumeleli okungaphumeleli), kodwa ukunakekelwa kuyadingeka, njengoba zingase zibe zonke zibekwe ngokungalungile.

source: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
reference: Olunye lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihamba phambili kulesi sigaba yi-Guguli Humusha, evumela ukuhumusha ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi ngemva kokudawuniloda idatha yolimi olufunwayo.
hypothesis: Enye yezinsiza ezinkulu kulesi sigaba yiGoogle Translate, evumela ukuthi uguqule ngaphandle kwe-intanethi ngemuva kokulanda idatha yezilimi ozifunayo.

source: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.
reference: Ukusebenzisa ama-app wokuqondisa we-GPS kuyi-smartphone sakho kungaba yindlela elula kakhulu newusizo kakhulu yokuthungatha indlela lapho ungekho ezweni lakini.
hypothesis: Ukusebenzisa i-GPS navigation apps kwi-smartphone yakho kungaba lula kakhulu futhi inezela indlela yokuhamba uma ungaphandle kwesizwe sakho.

source: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.
reference: Ingonga imali kunokuthenga amabalazwe we-GPS amasha, noma i-GPS ezimele noma ukuqasha enye enkampanini yokuqashisa izimoto.
hypothesis: Kuyokonga imali uma ungathenga amamaphepha amasha we-GPS, noma i-GPS eyodwa, noma uqeshwe kwenkampani yezimoto.

source: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.
reference: Uma ungenalo uxhumano lwedatha kuyifoni yakho, noma uma ingasebenzi endaweni okuyo, ukusebenza kwazo kungalinganiselwa noma kungabi khona.
hypothesis: Uma ungatholanga uxhumano lwedatha yefoni yakho, noma uma lusebenza ngaphandle kwendawo, ukusebenza kwabo kungaba limited noma kungatholakali.

source: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.
reference: Noma iziphi izitolo ezincane zigcwele ngezinhlobonhlobo ezididayo zamakhadi wefoni akhokhelwa kusengaphambili lawo angasetshenziswa ezingcingweni zomphakathi noma ocingweni oluvamile.
hypothesis: Yonke indawo yezitolo igcwele uluhlu oludidekayo lwezincwadi zekhompyutha zokukhokhela imininingwane ezingafundwa kwiifowuni zokukhokhela noma kwiifowuni eziqhelekileyo.

source: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
reference: Yize amanye amakhadi ekulungele ukufonela noma ikuphi, kodwa amanye enzelwe ukunikeza amanani aphansi wokufona emaqenjini athile wamazwe.
hypothesis: Ngokuvamile amakhadi ayenzelwe ukubiza kuyo nayiphi na indawo, kodwa abanye baye bakhetha ukunikela amanani anencasa okubiza kwiqembu elithile lamazwe.

source: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.
reference: Ukufinyelela kulamasevisikuvame ukutholakala ezinombolweni zocingo zamahhalaezingafonelwa ezingcingweni eziningi ngaphandle koku khokhela.
hypothesis: Ukufinyelela kulezi zinsizakalo kuvame ukwenziwa ngefoni engeyona enobungozi, engenayo intengo, engafinyelelwa kalula kusuka emakhulwini emakhaya.

source: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
reference: Imithetho esebenza ekuthwebuleni isithombe esivamile iyasebenza nesekuqopheni ividiyo, cishe nangokwengeziwe.
hypothesis: Imithetho elandelwayo ngokuthatha izithombe njalo ziyasebenza nasekuboneni kwamavidiyo, mhlawumbe ngisho nakakhulu.

source: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
reference: Uma ukuthatha ifotho yokuthile nje kungavunyelwe, akufanele ucabange ngisho nangokurekhoda ividiyo yakho.
hypothesis: Uma ukuthatha isithombe kuphela kwenzelwe, akufanele ucabange ngokurekhoda ividiyo yalo.

source: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
reference: Uma wenza umsindo obeleselayo, hlola kusengaphambili ukuthi ikuphi ovunyelwe ukukuthwebula nokuthi yiziphi izimvume noma amalayisensi engeziwe edingekayo.
hypothesis: Uma usebenzisa i-drone, qiniseka ngaphambili ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyifilma futhi yini amalayisense okanye amalayisense ezengeziwe adingekayo.

source: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
reference: Ukundizisa izindiza eziqondiswa nge-remote eduze kwesikhumulo sezindiza noma phakathi kwabantu abaningi akuwona umqondo omuhle, ngisho noma kungekho emthwethweni lokho endaweni yangakini.
hypothesis: Ukukhuphela i-drone eduze kwesikhumulo sezindiza noma phezu kwesixuku kuyinto engcono kakhulu, ngisho noma kungahleliwe endaweni yakho.

source: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.
reference: Esikhathini samanje ukuhamba ngendiza akuvile ukubhukhiwa ngokuqondile nenkampani yezindiza ngaphandle kokusesha nokuqhathanisa amanani.
hypothesis: Namuhla, izindiza zezokuthutha zihlala zibhukhwe kakhulu ngaphandle kokuthi zibhukhwe ngqo ngezindiza ngaphambi kokuthi zifune futhi zihlukanise amanani.

source: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.
reference: Kwesinye isikhathi indiza efanayo ingaba namanani ahluke kakhulu ezintweni ezihlukile ezihlanganisayo futhi kuyazuzisa ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokusesha kanye nokubuka iwebhusayithi yenkampani yezindiza ngokwayo ngaphambi kokubhukha.
hypothesis: Ngamanye amaxesha indiza efanayo ingaba neentengo ezahlukene kakhulu kwi-agregators ezahlukeneyo kwaye kuyabonakala ukuba kuyafaneleka ukuthelekiswa kwemiphumela yokukhangela kunye nokujonga kwisiza se-airline ngaphambi kokubhukisha.

source: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
reference: Nakuba ungena kudinga i-visa ukuthatha uhambo olufishane lokuya emazweni athile njengesivakashi noma ngenxa yebhizinisi, ukuya lapho njengomfundi wakwelinye izwekudingeka uhlale isikhathi eside kunomuntu nje ovakashe isikhashana.
hypothesis: Ngelinye izinsuku ungase ungadingi i-visa ukuze uhambele emazweni athile njengomtshali noma ngenhloso yebhizinisi, kodwa ukuhamba njengomfundi wezizwe ngokuvamile kudinga isikhathi eside kunokuhamba njengomtshali noma ngenhloso yebhizinisi.

source: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
reference: Ngokuvamile, ukuhlala kwelinye izwe isikhathi eside kuzodinga ukuthi uthole ivisa kusengaphambili.
hypothesis: Ngokuvamile, ukuhlala kunoma yiliphi izwe langaphandle isikhathi eside kuzodinga ukuthi uthole i-visa ngaphambili.

source: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
reference: Amavisa wabafundi afuna izinto ezihlukahlukene nezindlela zokufaka isicelo ezivakashini ezivamile noma amavisa webhizinisi.
hypothesis: Imvume yabafundi ngokuvamile inezidingo ezahlukene nezinqubo zokusebenza ezingafani nezo zomthetho wokuvakasha noma zebhizinisi.

source: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
reference: Emazweni amaningi, uzodinga incwadi yalokho enivumelene ngakho engxoxweni yenu nesikhungweni ofisa ukufunda kuso, kanye nobufakazi bemali yokuziphilisa okungenani unyaka wokuqala wesifundo sakho.
hypothesis: Kubantu abaningi, uzodinga incwadi yokubhalela kusuka esikoleni ofuna ukuya kuyo, kanye nezipho zokubhala zokuxhaswa yini ukuze uqinisekise unyaka wokuqala wekhosi yakho.

source: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
reference: Hlola nesikhungo, kanye nomnyango wabafuduki wezwe ongathanda ukufundela kulo ukuze uthole imininingwane eminingi.
hypothesis: Qhagamshelana nequmrhu, kwakunye nequmrhu lokungeniswa kwelizwe olithandayo ukuze ufunde imfuneko eneenkcukacha.

source: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.
reference: Ngaphandle kokuba ungusomaqhinga wezindaba zamazwe, ukusebenza phesheya ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi kuzodingeka ukhokhe intela ezweni okulona.
hypothesis: Ngaphandle kokuba ungumthetho wezombusazwe, ukusebenza phesheya kusho ngokuvamile ukuthi kuzodingeka ufake imali yentela kwilizwe olapho uhlala khona.

source: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.
reference: Intela yomholo ihlelwe ngendlela ehlukile emazweni ahlukene, futhi namanani nezingxenye ezehlukile zentelaziyehlukahlukakusuka kwelinye izwe kuya kwelinye.
hypothesis: Imali yesibonelelo yenzelwe ngokwahlukileyo kwilizwe ngalinye, kwaye amaxabiso wokuxhaswa kunye neebhokisi zokuxhaswa zivela kakhulu kwilizwe elinye kwi elinye.

source: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.
reference: Kwamanye amazwe kahulumeni, afana neMelika ne-Canada, kuqoqwa intela kokubili ezingeni likahulumeni nasezingeni lendawo, ngakho amanani namabhulekethi kungahluka endaweni ngendawo.
hypothesis: Emazweni ase federal, afana ne-United States ne-Canada, intela yemali engenayo isetshenziswa kokubili ezingeni le-federal nezingeni le-local, ngakho amanani namanani ayo angahluka kakhulu ezindaweni ezahlukene.

source: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.
reference: Nakuba ukuhlolwa kwabantu abathuthela kwelinye izwe kungenziwa uma ufika ezweni lakho, ukudlula lapho kuhlolwa khona izincwadi kusenzima.
hypothesis: Ngelaphu lokuqinisekisa ukungena kwabantu luhlobene nendawo yasekhaya, ulawulo lwezinto eziphathelene nomthetho luyingozi.

source: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.
reference: Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi ukuthi yini ongeza nayo nongenakuza nayo futhi ubike noma yini kwabomthetho.
hypothesis: Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi ukuthi ungazithathi yini futhi ungazithathi yini futhi ungazithathi yini ngaphezu kwemilinganiselo yomthetho.

source: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.
reference: Indlela elula kakhulu yokuqalisa ebhizinisini lokubhala ngohambo ukuthuthukisa amakhono wakho kuyibhulogi yewebhusayithi yokuhamba emisiwe.
hypothesis: Indlela elula yokuya ekuqaleni kwezohwebo lokuhamba kuyinto yokuhlela amakhono akho kwiwebhusayithi yebhulogi yezokuhamba esekwe.

source: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.
reference: Uma ukhululeka ngokususa nokwenezela izinto kuyiwebhu, kamuva, ungenza eyakho iwebhusayithi.
hypothesis: Emva kokuba uqonde kahle ukubekwa uphawu nokuhlela kwiwebhu, ungakwazi kamuva ukudala iwebhusayithi yakho.

source: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.
reference: Ukuvolontiya njengoba uthatha uhambo indlela ekahle yokwenza umehluko kodwa akuphathelananga nokunikela nje.
hypothesis: Ukuhlinzela ngenkathi uzokwehla kuyindlela enhle yokwenza umehluko, kodwa akusona nje ngokunikeza.

source: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.
reference: Ukuhlala nokuvolontiya kwelinye izwe indlela ekahle yokwazi isiko elihlukile, ukuhlangana nabantu abasha, ukufunda ngawe, ukuthola eminye imibono ngisho nokuthola amakhono amasha.
hypothesis: Ukudla nokuzinikela kwelinye izwe kuyindlela enhle yokwazi isiko elahlukene, ukuhlangana nabantu abatsha, ukufunda ngokwakho, ukuzwa umbono wokungabaza, nokuthola amakhono amasha.

source: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.
reference: Kungabuye kube indlela ekahle yokusebenzisa kahle imali ukukuvumela ukuba uhlale isikhathi eside kakhudlwana kwenye indawo njengoba imisebenzi eminingi yokuvolontiya ihlinzeka indawo yokuhlala nokudla futhi embalwa iholela iholo.
hypothesis: Kungenzeka futhi kube yindlela enhle yokwandisa ibhajethi ukuze uthole isikhathi eside endaweni ethile njengoba amanye amasevisi wokuzithandela anikeza indawo yokuhlala kanye nekhishi, futhi abanye bathole umholo omncane.

source: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.
reference: Ama-viking asebenzisa imisele yaseRashiya ukuya oLwandle Olumnyama noLwandle i-Caspian. Ezinye zalezi zindlela zisengasetshenziswa. Hlola uma kudingeka izimvume ezikhethekile, okungaba nzima ukuzithola.
hypothesis: Amakhosi aseViking asetshenziswa amanzi aseRussia ukuze afike e-Black Sea ne-Caspian Sea. Ezinye zalezi zindlela zingasetshenziswa. Hlola okudingekayo okudingekayo, okungase kube nzima ukuthola.

source: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.
reference: Ulwandle oluMhlophe–Umsele i-Baltic luhlanganisa uLwandlekazi i-Arctic noLwandle i-Baltic, ngendlela yeChibi i-Onega, iChibi i-Ladoga kanye ne-Saint Petersburg, kakhulu ngemifula namachibi.
hypothesis: U-White Sea–Baltic Canal uxhumene ne-Arctic Ocean ne-Baltic Sea, nge-Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga ne-Saint Petersburg, kakhulu nge-rivers ne-lakes.

source: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.
reference: IChibi i-Onega libuye laxhumana ne-Volga, ngakho ukuza usuka oLwandle lwase-Caspian udlula eRashiya kusenzeka.
hypothesis: ULake Onega nalo ixhunywe kwiVolga, ngakho-ke ukuza evela eCaspian Sea ngeRussia kusekhona okusemandleni.

source: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.
reference: Qiniseka ukuthi lapho nje ufika ezikhumulweni zemikhumbi yonke into izoba sobala kakhulu. Uzohlangana nabanye abacela ukugitsheliswa emikhumbini futhi bazokwabelana nawe ngolwazi lwabo.
hypothesis: Qiniseka ukuthi uma udinga amarinas konke kuzoba khona. Uzokhawulela izikebhe ezinye futhi zizokwabelana ngolwazi lwabo nawe.

source: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.
reference: Ngokuyisisekelo uzobe ufaka izaziso zosizo olunikezayo, wehla wenyuka ezikhumulweni zemikhumbi, ulanda bantu abahlanza izikebhe zawoseyili, uzama ukuxhumana namatilosi ezinkantini, njalo njalo.
hypothesis: Ngokuyisisekelo uzokwenza amaphosta ethi ungusizo, udlulisele amabhodi, uyekelele abantu abahlanza ama-yachts, uzama ukuxhumana nabasebenzi besikebhe esibhedlela, njll.

source: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.
reference: Zama ukukhuluma nabantu abaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Ngemva kwesikhashana wonke umuntu uzokwazi futhi uzokunika amacebiso okuthi isiphi isikebhe esifuna umuntu.
hypothesis: Zama ukuxoxa nabantu abaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Ngemuva kwesikhashana wonke umuntu uzokwazi wena futhi uzokunikeza amathiphu mayelana neyakho isikebhe esifuna umuntu.

source: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.
reference: Kufanele ukhethe inkampani yakho yezindiza ye-Fuest Flyer kumfelandawonye ngokucophelela.
hypothesis: Uyakwazi khetha ibhizinisi lakho lokuqhuba izindiza elingabonakali ngokucophelela.

source: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.
reference: Noma ungahle ucabange ukuthi ungazikhethela ukujoyina umzila wezindiza owusebenzisa kakhulu, kumelwe uqaphele ukuthi amalungelo anikezwayo ayashintshashintsha kanti namaphuzu angase abonelele kwezinye izindlela zokundiza ngemali efanayo.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma ungase ucabange ukuthi kuyinto eziyinkimbinkimbi ukuxhuma ne-airline oyikhangelayo, kufanele wazi ukuthi amalungelo anikezwa ngokuvamile ahlukene futhi amaphuzu okuhamba njalo angaba amahle ngaphansi kwezinye izindiza ezifanayo.

source: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.
reference: Izinkampani zezindiza ezifana ne-Emirates, i-Etihad Airways, i-Qatar Airways kanye ne-Turkish Airlines zandise izinkonzo zazo kakhulu e-Afrika, futhi zixhumanisa namanye amadolobha amakhulu wase-Afrika ngamanani aphansi kunezinye izinkampani zezindiza zaseYurophu.
hypothesis: Imiphakathi yezindiza ezifana ne-Emirates, i-Etihad Airways, i-Qatar Airways ne-Turkish Airlines zikhulise kakhulu izinsizakalo zawo e-Afrika, futhi zinikeza uxhumano lwama-cities amakhulu e-Afrika ngezindleko ezikahle kunamanye amaphakathi waseYurophu.

source: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.
reference: Inkampani Yezindiza yaseTheki inezindiza eziya ezindaweni ezingu-39 emazweni angu-30 wase-Afrika kusukela ngo-2014.
hypothesis: Turkish Airlines ihamba ne-39 izindawo kumazwe angama-30 ase-Afrika njengamanje.

source: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.
reference: Uma unesikhathi esengeziwe sohambo, hlola ukuthi lithini inani lokuya e-Afrika uma liqhathaniswa nelokuzungeza umhlaba.
hypothesis: Uma une isikhathi esengeziwe sokuhamba, hlola ukuthi inani eliphelele elivumelekileyo ukuze Afrika lilingane nanini eliphelele elivumelekileyo ukuze uhambe emhlabeni wonke.

source: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.
reference: Ungakhohlwa ukufaka izindleko ezengeziwe zamanye ama-visa, izintela zokuhamba, izinto zokuthutha, njll. kuzo zonke lezo zindawo ngaphandle kwase-Afrika.
hypothesis: Ungakhohlwa ukubandakanya izindleko ezengeziwe zezivumelwano ezengeziwe, izintela zokuphuma, ukuthuthwa komhlaba, njll. kuzo zonke izindawo ngaphandle kwe-Afrika.

source: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.
reference: Uma ufuna ukundiza emhlabeni wonke ngokuphelele eNyakatho Nenkabazwe, ungakhetha izindiza nendawo ofuna ukuya kuyo kuye ngokulinganiselwa kokuntuleka kwemizila yasolwandle.
hypothesis: Uma ufuna ukuhamba emhlabeni wonke ngokuphelele eNingizimu Hemisphere, khetha izindiza kanye nezindawo zokuhamba zithintwe ukukhathazeka kwamanye amazwekazi.

source: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).
reference: Ayikho inhlangano yezindiza ehlanganisa zonke izindlela ezintathu zokuya ngaphesheya kwezilwandle ezinkulu eNingizimu neNkabazwe (futhi IqembuIsibhakabhaka alihlanganisi lezi zindlela).
hypothesis: Akukho isivumelwano se-airline esikwaziyo zonke izindawo zokuhamba eziqhubekayo emazweni aseNingizimu Afrika (futhi i-SkyTeam ayikho yonke indawo).

source: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.
reference: Nokho, Inhlangano yeNkanyezi ihlanganisa yonke into ngaphandle kweNingizimu Phasifiki esempumalanga kusuka eSantiago de Chile kuya eTahiti, okuyindawo yokubalekela Yezwe elilodwa leLATAM.

source: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.
reference: Ngo-1994, uhlanga lwama-Amernian Nagorno-Karabakh esifundeni sase-Azerbaijan yahloma impi ngokumelene no-Azeris.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka we-1994, indawo yaseNagorno-Karabakh yase-Armenian etholakala e-Azerbaijan yahlasela ama-Azeris.

source: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.
reference: Isekelwa i-Armenia, iriphabhuliki entsha yenziwa. Nokho, alikho izwe elizimele - hhayi ngisho ne-Armenia - eliyiqaphele ngokomthetho.
hypothesis: Ngokusekelwa kwe-Armenian, kwakhiwa republic entsha. Kodwa-ke, akukho sizwe esisemthethweni - kungcono ne-Armenia - esikwazisa khona.

hypothesis: Umbindi weCanal (Dutch: Grachtengordel) yindawo eyaziwa kakhulu yase-17th century emhlabeni jikelele weBinnenstad Amsterdam.

reference: ICinque Terre, okusho ukuthi Amazwe Amahlanu, ihlanganisa imizi emincane emihlanu engasogwini yeRiomaggiore, iManarola, iCorniglia, iVernazza kanye neMoterosso esendaweni yaseNtaliyane yaseLiguria.
hypothesis: ICinque Terre, okuthiwa Imizi Eminyakeni Eminyama, yahlanganisa imizi emincane yasezintabeni yaseRiomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza neMonterosso eLiguria, esifundeni sase-Italy.

hypothesis: Bayo kuhlu kwe-UNESCO World Heritage List.

source: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
reference: Ngemva kwamakhulu eminyaka, abantu bebakha ngokucophelela izindawo zokuphola ezindaweni ezingaqondile, izindaweni ezehlelayo emaweni abheke olwandle.
hypothesis: Kwiminyaka eminingi, abantu bekhonza ukuqiniswa kwamagumbi emaweni, emaweni anamandla, aye ezingeni eliphezulu elibheke ulwandle.
